source_report.raw_markdown:
# Actio Biosciences Pipeline Scout Report: **ABS-1230**

This report is prepared for **SKBP Pipeline Finder v3.1**. URLs are included for auditability and downstream evidence tracking.

중요: ABS-1230은 Actio Biosciences의 **oral selective KCNT1 inhibitor**로서 KCNT1-related epilepsy 대상 **Phase 1b/2 KYRON trial**이 시작된 active precision CNS asset이며, Target/MoA/Data fit은 강하지만 ultra-rare market size와 patient efficacy 미확인 때문에 **PASS / Shortlist, 단 commercial upside는 제한적**으로 판단합니다.

---

## 1) Company Profile

| Field | Content | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Company | Actio Biosciences | [1], [2] |
| Legal name / aliases | Actio Biosciences, Inc.; ActioBio | [2], [3] |
| Country | United States | [2], [3] |
| Headquarters | 11202 El Camino Real, Suite 100, San Diego, CA 92130 | [2] |
| Website | https://actiobiosciences.com | [1] |
| Company type / stage | Private, clinical-stage biotechnology company; founded in October 2021; genetics-driven small molecule precision medicine company | [3] |
| Focus areas | Rare genetic diseases with expansion into broader diseases sharing biology; lead areas include KCNT1-related epilepsy and TRPV4-related CMT2C / overactive bladder | [3], [4] |
| Platform summary | “One to many” precision medicine approach: rare Mendelian genetics → target identification → mutation characterization → potent small molecule modulators → expansion into related prevalent indications | [5] |
| Financing / partnership signals | $55M Series A in 2023; $66M Series B in 2025 co-led by Regeneron Ventures and Deerfield Management to advance ABS-1230 and ABS-0871 | [3], [6] |
| Lead pipeline summary | ABS-1230: oral small molecule KCNT1 inhibitor for KCNT1-related epilepsy, Phase 1b/2; ABS-0871: oral small molecule TRPV4 inhibitor, Phase 1 / CMT2C and overactive bladder expansion | [3], [4] |

---

## 2) Pipeline Snapshot

| Field | Content | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Company | Actio Biosciences | [1], [2] |
| Lead asset | ABS-1230 | [4], [7], [8] |
| Target | KCNT1 / Slack sodium-activated potassium channel | [4], [9], [10] |
| Theme / Cluster | Theme: E/I Balance / Cluster: Ion Channel | Internal SKBP mapping + [9], [10] |
| MoA | Selective inhibition of overactive KCNT1 potassium ion channel caused by pathogenic gain-of-function variants | [7], [9], [10] |
| Modality / Platform | Oral small molecule; genetics-driven precision small molecule platform | [4], [5], [9] |
| Indication | KCNT1-related epilepsy; pediatric developmental and epileptic encephalopathy / EIMFS / EOEE phenotype in KYRON eligibility | [8], [9] |
| Stage | Phase 1/2 canonical bucket; specifically KYRON Phase 1b/2 in the U.S.; Phase 1a healthy volunteer trial completed/near-completed with tolerability update disclosed by company | [7], [8], [11], [12] |
| Key data | AES 2025 poster: human/mouse KCNT1 IC50 0.25 / 0.12 nM; pathogenic mutants inhibited at 0.8–8.8 nM; >500 off-target proteins profiled with no meaningful activity except KCNT1; high oral bioavailability and brain penetration; dose-dependent seizure reduction in Kcnt1 mutant mouse model; Phase 1a no serious adverse events at tested doses including multiple 20 mg dosing | [7], [9] |

---

## 3) Scorecard Summary

| Criterion | Score | One-line judgment | Evidence used |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Target Relevance | 3 / 3 | KCNT1 gain-of-function epilepsy is a direct E/I Balance / ion-channelopathy fit with severe pediatric seizure burden and clear genetic driver. | [4], [8], [10] |
| Competitive Landscape | 2 / 3 | Same-target competition exists, especially Servier S230815 intrathecal ASO and Atalanta ATL-201 di-siRNA, but no approved KCNT1-targeted disease-modifying therapy exists and ABS-1230 is differentiated as oral small molecule. | [13], [14], [15], [16], [17] |
| MoA Validity | 3 / 3 | Asset-specific preclinical evidence strongly supports KCNT1 inhibition, mutant coverage, selectivity, brain penetration, and seizure reduction in KCNT1 mouse model. | [7], [9] |
| Platform Attractiveness | 2 / 3 | Oral CNS small molecule modality and mutation-inclusive design are attractive, but Actio’s broader platform reproducibility remains partly company-claim based. | [4], [5], [9] |
| Expansion Potential | 2 / 3 | Company explicitly lists other genetic epilepsies and applies “one to many” expansion logic, but public asset-specific expansion data are still limited. | [3], [4], [5] |
| Data Maturity | 2 / 3 | Phase 1b/2 has started and Phase 1a tolerability is disclosed, but patient efficacy data are not yet public. | [7], [8], [9], [11], [12] |
| Marketability | 1 / 3 | A. TAP ≈ 800 U.S. targetable patients; B. Unrisked Peak Sales ≈ USD 107.5M; C. Obtainable Peak Sales ≈ USD 100.0M, below USD 1B despite orphan pricing and expansion optionality. | [3], [17], [20], [21], [22] |
| **Total** | **15 / 21** | PASS; science-first shortlist with constrained commercial upside. |  |

---

## 4) Criterion Detail Pages

### 4.1 Target Relevance
Score: **3 / 3**  
Evidence Type: **E4_asset_specific_clinical_evidence**  
Main line: **KCNT1 gain-of-function epilepsy is a direct SKBP E/I Balance / Ion Channel fit, and ABS-1230 is clinically positioned against the genetically defined causal target.**

What was checked:
- Target identity: KCNT1 / Slack sodium-activated potassium channel
- Disease/biology relevance: pathogenic KCNT1 variants increase channel activity and are linked to severe early-onset epilepsy
- SKBP Theme / Cluster fit: E/I Balance / Ion Channel
- General epilepsy relevance: severe treatment-resistant pediatric developmental and epileptic encephalopathy

Evidence trail:
- Actio pipeline identifies ABS-1230 as an oral small molecule KCNT1 inhibitor for KCNT1-related epilepsy and lists FDA Fast Track, Rare Pediatric Disease, Orphan Drug, and RDEP acceptance signals. [4], [7]
- CHOP describes KCNT1 as encoding a brain potassium channel and notes pathogenic variants typically increase channel activity, presumed to cause epilepsy by altering neuronal electrical activity. [10]
- Actio’s KYRON trial page describes ABS-1230 as targeting overactive KCNT1 ion channel overactivity to reduce seizures. [8]
- ClinicalTrials.gov lists the Phase 1b/2 trial in KCNT1-related epilepsy. [11]

Investigation note:
- Score 3 is appropriate because target, disease, causal biology, modality, and clinical indication align tightly with SKBP E/I Balance / Ion Channel logic.
- Why not higher: already maximum score.
- Uncertain points: broader relevance beyond KCNT1-related epilepsy into other genetic epilepsies remains unproven clinically.

### 4.2 Competitive Landscape
Score: **2 / 3**  
Evidence Type: **E4_asset_specific_clinical_evidence**  
Main line: **ABS-1230 has a credible first-in-class oral small molecule position, but same-target clinical and preclinical competitors are already visible.**

What was checked:
- Same disease competitors
- Same target competitors
- Same or similar MoA competitors
- Front runner count
- Approved / Phase 3 / clinical / preclinical status

Competitor table:

| Competitor | Company | Modality | Target / MoA | Stage | Why it matters | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| S230815 / KANDLE Study | Servier | Intrathecal ASO, per KCNT1 Foundation; official trial describes intrathecal S230815 | KCNT1 activity reduction / blocking KCNT1 activity | Phase 1b/2 | Direct same-target, same-disease clinical competitor; less convenient delivery than oral ABS-1230 but potentially disease-modifying gene-level approach | [13], [14] |
| ATL-201 | Atalanta Therapeutics | di-siRNA / RNAi | KCNT1 transcript reduction / neuronal excitability normalization | Preclinical; IND submission planned in 2025 per company | Direct same-target genetic epilepsy competitor with durable seizure suppression in mouse model; CNS oligonucleotide delivery could compete if clinical translation succeeds | [15], [16] |
| Quinidine | Generic / off-label | Oral small molecule antiarrhythmic | Partial KCNT1 channel blocker | Off-label / not approved for KCNT1 | Historical same-target pharmacology; mixed efficacy and cardiotoxicity create unmet need for selective KCNT1 inhibitors | [17], [18] |
| Bexicaserin / LP352 | Lundbeck / Longboard | Oral small molecule | 5-HT2C superagonist; not KCNT1 | Phase 3 DEEp Program | Broader DEE seizure competitor; advanced stage could shape payer/clinical expectations but not disease-causal for KCNT1 | [19], [20] |
| FINTEPLA / fenfluramine | UCB | Oral small molecule | Serotonergic antiseizure mechanism; not KCNT1 | Approved for Dravet syndrome and Lennox-Gastaut syndrome | Approved rare epilepsy comparator; demonstrates payer acceptance and seizure-reduction benchmark but not KCNT1-targeted | [21], [22] |
| ZTALMY / ganaxolone | Marinus / Immedica | Oral neuroactive steroid | GABA-A receptor positive allosteric modulator | Approved for CDKL5 deficiency disorder seizures | Approved genetic epilepsy comparator; broad symptomatic antiseizure approach rather than causal KCNT1 modulation | [23] |

Investigation note:
- The competitive search started with same disease / same target and then broadened to DEE and rare genetic epilepsy assets.
- True same-MoA / same-target front runners are **S230815** and **ATL-201**; broader seizure competitors such as bexicaserin, FINTEPLA, and ZTALMY are relevant mainly for clinical and commercial benchmarking.
- Score 2 is selected because there is no approved KCNT1-targeted drug, but direct competitors are active and could compress share.
- Why not higher: not a clean white-space category; at least one same-target Phase 1b/2 program exists.
- Uncertain points: S230815’s exact public modality details are clearer through KCNT1 Foundation as ASO; official Servier trial page confirms intrathecal S230815 and KCNT1 activity blocking but does not prominently describe ASO chemistry.

### 4.3 MoA Validity
Score: **3 / 3**  
Evidence Type: **E3_asset_specific_preclinical_or_technical_evidence**  
Main line: **ABS-1230 has strong asset-specific mechanistic evidence: potent KCNT1 inhibition, broad pathogenic mutant coverage, high selectivity, CNS penetration, and seizure reduction in KCNT1 mutant mice.**

What was checked:
- Journal publication / PMID / DOI
- Mechanistic consistency
- Functional readout
- Disease linkage
- Safety-relevant signal

Evidence trail:
- AES 2025 poster reports ABS-1230 inhibited human and mouse KCNT1-dependent K+ current with IC50 values of 0.25 and 0.12 nM. [9]
- The same poster reports potent inhibition of 63 pathogenic or likely pathogenic mutants with IC50 values of 0.8–8.8 nM. [9]
- The poster reports no meaningful activity against >500 off-target proteins examined and no significant activity against other proteins at 1 µM except KCNT1. [9]
- ABS-1230 demonstrated high oral bioavailability and brain penetration across species and dose-dependent seizure reduction in Kcnt1R409Q/R409Q mice. [9]
- Company press release states preclinical evidence supports Phase 1a and planned Phase 1b/2 progression. [7]

Investigation note:
- Score 3 is justified by quantitative, asset-specific functional and in vivo data that map directly to KCNT1 gain-of-function disease biology.
- Why not higher: already maximum score; however, clinical seizure reduction in patients has not yet been shown.
- Uncertain points: data are currently from company/AES poster rather than peer-reviewed full manuscript; human pharmacodynamic proof is not yet public.

### 4.4 Platform Attractiveness
Score: **2 / 3**  
Evidence Type: **E3_asset_specific_preclinical_or_technical_evidence**  
Main line: **Oral CNS small molecule modality is highly attractive versus intrathecal oligonucleotide competitors, but the broader platform is less independently validated than the asset-level pharmacology.**

What was checked:
- Is the platform real and reproducible?
- Is differentiation supported by data?
- Does modality fit SKBP priorities?
- Preferred modalities: small molecule, ASO, siRNA
- Secondary modalities: AOC, antibody, biologic

Evidence trail:
- Actio describes a genetics-driven approach using target identification, molecule design, mutation characterization, and indication expansion. [5]
- ABS-1230 is an oral small molecule intended to inhibit all disease-causing variants of KCNT1. [4], [7], [9]
- Asset-specific poster supports oral bioavailability, brain penetration, selectivity, and broad mutant inhibition. [9]
- Company pipeline also includes ABS-0871, another oral small molecule ion-channel program, suggesting repeatability at least across two targets. [3], [4]

Investigation note:
- Score 2 is appropriate because small molecule CNS penetration and oral delivery are a practical differentiation point against intrathecal ASO/siRNA competitors.
- Why not higher: the platform is not yet supported by multiple independent clinical validations or a broad disclosed engine; platform reproducibility remains partly company-claim based.
- Uncertain points: no public head-to-head data versus ASO/di-siRNA delivery approaches; long-term KCNT1 inhibition safety margin in developing pediatric brain remains to be established.

### 4.5 Expansion Potential
Score: **2 / 3**  
Evidence Type: **E1_company_claim_or_scientific_rationale_only**  
Main line: **There is credible expansion logic into other genetic epilepsies, but public asset-specific expansion data are not yet sufficient for a 3.**

What was checked:
- Expansion beyond main indication
- Same biology/platform reuse
- Adjacent indications
- Multiple assets from same platform

Evidence trail:
- Actio’s Series B release states ABS-1230 is intended for KCNT1-related epilepsy and other genetic epilepsies. [3]
- Actio’s program page lists “Other genetic epilepsies” in IND-enabling for ABS-1230. [4]
- Actio’s platform logic explicitly seeks expansion from rare Mendelian diseases into more prevalent indications sharing underlying biology. [5]

Investigation note:
- Score 2 reflects plausible but still unvalidated expansion.
- Why not higher: expansion evidence is mostly pipeline positioning and scientific rationale; no public patient or animal data in non-KCNT1 genetic epilepsies was identified during this review.
- Uncertain points: whether KCNT1 inhibition is therapeutically useful outside KCNT1-positive epilepsy is not yet established; expansion could require a different causal mechanism or patient-selection strategy.

### 4.6 Data Maturity
Score: **2 / 3**  
Evidence Type: **E4_asset_specific_clinical_evidence**  
Main line: **ABS-1230 has strong preclinical package and Phase 1a tolerability disclosure, and is now in Phase 1b/2, but lacks patient efficacy readout.**

What was checked:
- In vitro data
- In vivo data
- Quantitative result
- Reproducibility
- IND-enabling / GLP tox / PK/PD / CMC / human data availability

Evidence trail:
- IND clearance and FDA Fast Track were announced in July 2025. [12]
- First participant dosed in Phase 1a healthy volunteer trial was announced in September 2025; the trial was randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled and evaluated SAD/MAD, food effect, safety, tolerability, and PK. [7]
- May 2026 KYRON initiation release states Phase 1a doses, including multiple 20 mg doses, were well tolerated with no serious adverse events reported. [8]
- KYRON Phase 1b/2 is designed to evaluate safety, tolerability, PK, seizure activity, and neurodevelopmental outcomes in children and young adults aged one month through 21 years. [8], [11]
- AES poster includes in vitro potency, selectivity, brain penetration, and seizure reduction in KCNT1 mouse model. [9]

Investigation note:
- Score 2 is driven by active clinical entry plus Phase 1a safety disclosure and robust preclinical evidence.
- Why not higher: there is no public patient efficacy, no dose-response seizure reduction in patients, and no long-term pediatric safety data yet.
- Uncertain points: detailed Phase 1a PK/exposure, dose-proportionality, food effect, and CNS exposure bridging are not fully public.

### 4.7 Marketability
Score: **1 / 3**  
Evidence Type: **E2_indirect_or_class_level_evidence**  
Main line: **A. TAP ≈ 800 U.S. targetable patients; B. Unrisked Peak Sales ≈ USD 107.5M; C. Obtainable Peak Sales ≈ USD 100.0M; orphan pricing helps but KCNT1 is too ultra-rare to reach USD 1B without major expansion.**

What was checked:
- Targetable addressable patient
- Unrisked peak sales
- Competition haircut
- Pricing power adjustment
- Expansion capacity adjustment

Worksheet:

| Step | What to fill | Evidence / assumption |
|---|---|---|
| A. TAP | Total Patient Pool x Diagnosis Rate x Eligibility Rate x Treatable Subgroup Rate = 2,500 x 65% x 70% x 70% = **796**, rounded to **~800 U.S. targetable patients** | Actio estimates U.S. prevalence of approximately 2,500 individuals; KCNT1 Foundation says prevalence is unknown and underdiagnosis remains material. Diagnosis / eligibility / treatable rates are analyst assumptions requiring validation. [3], [17] |
| B. Unrisked Peak Sales | TAP x Annual Net Price x Peak Penetration x Treatment Duration Factor = 796 x USD 300,000 x 45% x 1.0 / 1,000,000 = **USD 107.5M** | Annual net price assumes a rare CNS launch price around USD 300k, informed by ICER 2025 median annual net price for newly launched drugs and rare epilepsy analogs; actual ABS-1230 price is unknown. [20], [21], [22] |
| Entry-order matrix | 3-player example: 1st ~50%, 2nd ~30%, 3rd ~20%; ABS-1230 could be first oral targeted KCNT1, but S230815 and ATL-201 may compete. | Same-target competitor count from Servier and Atalanta sources. [13], [15], [16] |
| C. Obtainable Peak Sales | Unrisked Peak Sales x Competition Haircut x Pricing Power Adjustment x Expansion Capacity Adjustment = 107.5 x 0.65 x 1.10 x 1.30 = **USD 100.0M** | Competition haircut reflects S230815 / ATL-201; pricing power reflects targeted orphan drug; expansion capacity reflects other genetic epilepsy optionality but no clinical validation yet. |
| Final score basis | **1 / 3** because obtainable peak sales are far below USD 1,000M. | Marketability is constrained by ultra-rare TAP despite high unmet need and likely orphan pricing. |

Investigation note:
- Marketability is based on obtainable peak sales, not rNPV.
- This is a U.S.-anchored model because the most explicit population estimate found was U.S. prevalence from Actio; global expansion could increase the figure but remains source-uncertain.
- Why not higher: even with strong pricing and expansion multipliers, obtainable peak sales remain materially below USD 1B.
- Uncertain points: true diagnosed prevalence, treatment duration, payer-accepted price, geographic expansion, and broader genetic epilepsy label are not yet established.

---

## 5) Validation Notes

Cross-checked facts:
- ABS-1230 is consistently linked to Actio Biosciences across official Actio pages, trial pages, and clinical-trial sources. [4], [8], [11], [12]
- ABS-1230 is consistently described as an oral selective small molecule KCNT1 inhibitor. [4], [7], [8], [9]
- KCNT1-related epilepsy is linked to gain-of-function potassium channel pathology and treatment-resistant seizures. [10], [17], [18]
- KYRON Phase 1b/2 trial status is supported by Actio’s May 2026 release, ActioTrials, and ClinicalTrials.gov. [8], [11]
- Direct competitive pressure is supported by Servier S230815 / KANDLE and Atalanta ATL-201 sources. [13], [14], [15], [16]

Uncertain points:
- Patient efficacy data for ABS-1230 are not yet public.
- Detailed Phase 1a PK, exposure-response, food effect, and dose-limiting safety data were not fully disclosed in public sources.
- Long-term impact of KCNT1 inhibition in infants and developing pediatric brain requires patient data.
- Exact worldwide diagnosed/treatable prevalence remains uncertain.
- S230815’s official trial record confirms intrathecal S230815 and KCNT1 targeting; ASO classification is supported by KCNT1 Foundation rather than the official Servier page.
- Rights appear wholly owned by Actio based on pipeline page stating Actio owns full rights to all programs, but confirm via company deck / BD discussion before deal work. [4]

Search log:
- Official company page: Actio homepage, About, Programs, Approach. [1], [2], [4], [5]
- Pipeline page: Actio Programs / ABS-1230. [4]
- Platform page: Actio Approach. [5]
- Publications: ABS-1230 AES poster; JCI Insight KCNT1 ASO proof-of-concept; Epilepsia ATL-201 source. [9], [15], [16]
- Regulatory / trial registry: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07600736, NCT07156201, Servier KANDLE NCT07227857, Actio IND/Fast Track release. [11], [12], [13], [14]
- Competitor sources: Servier, Atalanta, GeneReviews/quinidine, Lundbeck/bexicaserin, UCB/FINTEPLA, Marinus/ZTALMY. [13]–[23]
- Market / epidemiology sources: Actio U.S. prevalence, KCNT1 Foundation prevalence/therapy status, ICER launch-price report, FINTEPLA price page, ZTALMY approval/price analogs. [3], [17], [20], [21], [22], [23]
- Financing / partnership sources: Series A and Series B Actio releases. [3], [6]

---

## 6) Final Take

One-line summary: **ABS-1230 is a high-quality science-first CNS precision medicine asset with strong target/MoA fit and oral small-molecule differentiation, but its commercial case is constrained by ultra-rare KCNT1 prevalence unless broader genetic epilepsy expansion becomes clinically credible.**

Recommendation:
- **Shortlist**

Most important diligence question:
- **Can ABS-1230 demonstrate clinically meaningful seizure reduction and neurodevelopmental benefit in KCNT1-related epilepsy patients while maintaining a safe exposure margin in infants and young children?**

---

**FAIL / Deprioritize:** GXC-303은 실재하는 ALS용 preclinical AAV gene-therapy asset이고 STMN2 biology도 타당하지만, 공개 asset-specific 데이터가 company-claim 수준이며 현 SKBP의 **E/I Balance / Neuroimmune** Theme·Cluster에 직접 부합하지 않아 **11/21, FAIL**로 판정한다.

평가 기준일: 2026-07-13 · 검증 범위: public-only · 공식 stage `In Vivo`는 공개 근거상 `Lead Optimization`으로 보수 매핑.

## 1) Company And Pipeline Snapshot

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Company | GenixCure / 제닉스큐어㈜; Republic of Korea; private preclinical/platform biotech |
| Asset | GXC-303 |
| Target | STMN2 / TDP-43–STMN2 axis |
| Theme / Cluster | **No Theme / N/A** |
| MoA | STMN2 발현 회복을 통해 motor-neuron axonal maintenance/regeneration을 촉진하려는 접근; 정확한 cargo 설계는 비공개 |
| Modality / Platform | AAV gene therapy; CARE/InsightMiner-engineered CNS/neuron-targeted capsid family; 최종 capsid/version 미확인 |
| Main indication | Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis / motor neuron disease |
| Stage | **Lead Optimization** — 회사 표기 `In Vivo`; IND-enabling 근거 미확인 |
| Key visible data | 회사/언론이 세포 축삭 재성장과 BIO USA 2025 동물행동 데이터 공개를 보고했으나 model, dose, n, statistics, durability, biodistribution 및 tox 원자료는 공개되지 않음 [S1–S3] |

## 2) Scorecard

| Criterion | Score | Evidence type | One-line reason | Sources |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Target Relevance | 2/3 | E2_indirect_or_class_level_evidence | ALS/TDP-43–STMN2 연관성은 강하나 SKBP Theme 직접 적합성 없음 | S2, S5, S6 |
| Competitive Landscape | 2/3 | E4_asset_specific_clinical_evidence | QRL-201 한 개의 direct clinical front-runner; one-time AAV는 잠재적 BIC angle | S7–S11 |
| MoA Validity | 2/3 | E2_indirect_or_class_level_evidence | STMN2 restoration의 axonal-repair rationale은 독립 연구로 지지 | S2, S5–S7 |
| Platform Attractiveness | 2/3 | E2_indirect_or_class_level_evidence | AI capsid/CNS targeting 차별화 논리는 명확하나 final-asset 검증 부족 | S4, S12, S13 |
| Expansion Potential | 2/3 | E2_indirect_or_class_level_evidence | TDP-43 proteinopathy와 다자산 AAV 재사용 논리는 있으나 GXC-303 확장계획 없음 | S1, S4, S5 |
| Data Maturity | 1/3 | E1_company_claim_or_scientific_rationale_only | In Vivo 및 효능 주장은 확인되나 공개 정량 package가 stage 대비 약함 | S1–S3 |
| Marketability | 0/3 | E0_not_found_or_not_assessable | Patient eligibility·regimen·price·entry order가 없어 A/B/C 계산 불가 | S1, S2, S7–S10 |
| **Total** | **11/21** |  | REVIEW 점수대이나 `No Theme`가 명시적 FAIL 조건 |  |

## 3) Criterion Notes

### Target Relevance — 2/3
STMN2는 TDP-43 dysfunction과 연계된 ALS axonal-repair target으로 과학적 관련성이 높다. 다만 axonal maintenance/regeneration은 현재 지정된 E/I Balance 또는 Neuroimmune cluster에 직접 포함되지 않는다.

### Competitive Landscape — 2/3
QRL-201은 같은 STMN2 restoration을 표방하며 Phase 1/2에서 target engagement, biomarker 및 ALSFRS-R signal을 공개한 직접 선행자다. GXC-303의 one-time AAV 가능성은 차별화 여지가 있지만 임상 진입시점·용량·안전성·효능 우위가 입증되지 않았다.

### MoA Validity — 2/3
독립 연구는 TDP-43 loss가 STMN2 misprocessing과 axonal-regeneration deficit을 유도하고 STMN2 correction이 이를 rescue할 수 있음을 지지한다. GXC-303 고유 cargo의 disease-model dose-response, functional/survival rescue 또는 human PoC가 없어 3점은 아니다.

### Platform Attractiveness — 2/3
CARE/InsightMiner와 CNS/neuron-targeted AAV는 전달효율·저용량·안전성 차별화 논리를 제공한다. 그러나 final GXC-303 capsid의 head-to-head NHP dataset, route, biodistribution, immunogenicity, therapeutic window 및 CMC는 공개되지 않았다.

### Expansion Potential — 2/3
STMN2/TDP-43 biology는 FTD 등 인접 proteinopathy로 확장 가능하고 회사의 AAV platform은 여러 CNS 자산에 재사용된다. GXC-303 자체의 ALS 외 indication plan은 확인되지 않았다.

### Data Maturity — 1/3
공식 pipeline의 `In Vivo`, 회사가 보고한 세포 축삭 재생 및 동물행동 자료는 asset identity와 early efficacy signal을 뒷받침한다. 그러나 full poster/deck, model, n, controls, statistics, dose/route, durability, target engagement, biodistribution, tox 및 CMC가 없어 `IND-enabling` 또는 2점으로 올릴 수 없다.

### Marketability — 0/3
ALS unmet need만으로 숫자를 만들지 않았다. Exact target geography, STMN2/TDP-43 eligibility, final regimen, one-time net price analogue, launch timing, entry order, manufacturing economics 및 rights가 확보되어야 계산 가능하다.

## 4) Competitors

| Type | Asset | Company | Modality / target | Stage | Similarity | Why it matters | Sources |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Direct | QRL-201 | QurAlis | Intrathecal ASO; STMN2 splicing correction | Phase 1/2 | High | Same-target clinical front-runner; Phase 3 preparation reported | S7 |
| Pathway/modality | CTx1000 | Celosia | Single-dose AAV9; pathological TDP-43 degradation | Phase 1 | Medium | Same TDP-43 axis and one-time AAV; already clinical | S8 |
| Modality risk analogue | AMT-162 | uniQure | Intrathecal AAV-miRNA; SOD1 silencing | Discontinued / inactive | Medium | Dose-limiting toxicity 후 중단되어 AAV dose/route/safety 경고사례 | S11 |
| Genetic ALS benchmark | Qalsody / tofersen | Biogen / Ionis | Intrathecal ASO; SOD1 reduction | Approved / marketed | Low | Biomarker-based accelerated approval and repeat-IT benchmark | S9 |
| Genetic ALS benchmark | Ulefnersen / ION363 | Ionis / Otsuka | ASO; FUS reduction | Phase 3 | Low | Late-stage genetic-ALS development benchmark | S10 |

## 5) Marketability

- **A. TAP:** null — geography와 biomarker/eligibility definition 미확정.
- **B. Unrisked Peak Sales:** null — final regimen, net price, penetration 및 duration factor 미확정.
- **C. Obtainable Peak Sales:** null — launch timing, competition haircut, pricing power, manufacturing capacity 및 expansion factor 미확정.
- **Commercial rationale status:** `insufficient_evidence`; Marketability score **0/3**. 숫자 부재는 시장이 작다는 판정이 아니라 현재 입력으로 재현 가능한 commercial model을 만들 수 없다는 의미다.

## 6) Key Uncertainties And Final Take

- **Hard Filter:** `FAIL` — 총점은 11점이나 `No Theme / N/A Cluster`가 명시적 blocker.
- **Recommendation:** `Deprioritize` for current SKBP scope; axonal repair/proteostasis가 향후 전략축에 포함되면 재평가.
- **가장 중요한 diligence 질문:** 최종 capsid/cargo/route/dose를 사용한 ALS disease model에서 blinded, dose-responsive, statistically powered functional·survival efficacy와 CNS biodistribution·target engagement·toxicity를 동시에 입증한 원자료가 있는가?
- **재평가 trigger:** full preclinical deck/poster, IND-enabling plan, NHP biodistribution/tox, CMC readiness, QRL-201 대비 differentiation 및 rights 확인.

source_report.raw_markdown:
# Astrion Pipeline Scout Report: **AON-PP23**

본 보고서는 GPT instruction 2 — Full Scout v3.4 (schema v3.2)에 따라 user-uploaded company material을 먼저 검토하고, 공개 회사/산학협력 자료, patent, peer-reviewed literature, clinical registry 및 경쟁 pipeline을 교차검증하여 평가했다. 검증 가능한 공개 URL은 auditability를 위해 References와 JSON source registry에 포함했다.

**중요:** AON-PP23는 Astrion의 Parkinson's disease용 α-synuclein aggregation/disaggregation 프로그램으로 identity와 active development는 확인되며, 2026년 7월 자료상 **Lead Optimization** 단계로 판단된다. 다만 BBB/brain PK·in vivo efficacy·DMPK·toxicity가 아직 완료 데이터로 제시되지 않았고, 임상 선행 경쟁군 대비 정량적 차별화와 derivative composition-of-matter IP가 불명확하여 **REVIEW / Watch**로 평가한다.

## 1) Company Profile

|---|---|---|
| Company | Astrion Co., Ltd. / ㈜에스트리온 | Public exhibitor profile에서 Astrion과 AON-PP23의 PD 개발 목적 확인 [1]. |

- **Official company page:** `http://www.astrion.co.kr` 확인 시도; public exhibitor records가 URL을 확인하나 이번 web retrieval에서는 company site 자체가 정상 fetch되지 않아 내용 evidence로 사용하지 않음.
- **Pipeline / identity:** Korea Life Science Week Astrion exhibitor profile [1].
- **Platform:** Korea University TLO PNAC-related technology page [2].
- **Patent:** KR102513116B1 [3].
- **Publications:** AON-PP23 exact-name publication search; asset-specific peer-reviewed paper 미확인. Independent α-syn target biology는 Nature Reviews Neurology [4].
- **Regulatory / trial registry:** AON-PP23 exact-name registry search에서 clinical record 미확인. Competitor trials는 ClinicalTrials.gov [5,7].
- **Competitor sources:** Roche/Prothena prasinezumab, UCB minzasolmin, MODAG anle138b, AC Immune ACI-7104, ABrain AB103 [5–9].
- **Market / epidemiology:** Parkinson's Foundation US/global PD statistics [10].
- **Financing / partnership:** company deck의 national/global collaboration programs 및 Kolon Pharma/Astrion public partnership report [11].
- **Chemical identity check:** deck에 기재된 parent-hit CAS 565-63-9를 public chemical reference [12]와 cross-check.

## 6) Final Take

**One-line summary:** AON-PP23는 **PD × α-synuclein × Protein Homeostasis** 전략 적합성과 초기 biochemical/cellular PoC는 강하지만, 현재는 Lead Optimization 단계로서 brain exposure/in vivo efficacy/toxicity, competitor 대비 differentiation 및 compound IP가 아직 BD-grade로 완성되지 않았다.

**Recommendation: Watch**

**Hard Filter: REVIEW**
- Total = **11/21**
- Target Relevance = 3
- MoA Validity = 3
- Data Maturity = 3
- Identity verified = Yes
- Active program confirmed = Yes
- Lifecycle FAIL signal = No
- 그러나 Total이 9–13 REVIEW range이며, competition/platform/expansion/marketability의 evidence gap이 남아 있다.

**Most important diligence question:**

현재 M2/M8/Top3 중 실제 development candidate의 구조와 composition-of-matter IP status를 공개하고, 동일 candidate에 대한 **BBB/brain PK → in vivo PD efficacy → DMPK/toxicity → mechanism-linked target engagement** raw package를 일관된 compound identity로 연결해 제시할 수 있는가?

### 4.3 MoA Validity

**Score: 2점**

**Main line:** Dopaminergic neural-cell replacement는 human clinical class validation까지 확보했고 연계 academic technology도 functional evidence를 보유하지만, CE223BR17 자체의 engraftment·dopamine production·behavioral recovery는 확인되지 않았습니다.

**Criterion definition / selected-score rule:** MoA Validity 2점은 functional evidence 또는 independent same-target/class validation이 존재할 때 부여합니다.

**What was checked:**
- Midbrain dopaminergic differentiation
- Engraftment 및 neuronal maturation
- Behavioral recovery in PD models
- Astrocyte-mediated neuroprotection
- Human class validation
- Tumorigenicity 및 ectopic-cell risk

**Evidence trail:**
- Midbrain organoid-derived NSC 기술은 hPSC에서 ventral-midbrain-patterned NSC와 TH-positive dopaminergic neuron을 제조할 수 있음을 보고했습니다.[7][8]
- 관련 특허에서는 PD 동물 14마리 중 11마리가 이식 전 대비 50%를 초과하는 rotation recovery를 보였고, 6개월 평가가 가능했던 8마리는 모두 79%를 초과했다고 기술합니다.[7]
- 관련 astrocyte 연구는 ventral-midbrain-patterned astrocyte가 oxidative stress, excitotoxic glutamate, pathological aggregate 및 neuroinflammation을 조절할 가능성을 제시합니다.[9]
- AMCHEPRY 승인과 bemdaneprocel의 human engraftment 및 임상개발은 dop시합니다.[9]
- AMCHEPRY 승인과 bemdaneprocel의 humanaminergic-cell replacement class의 임상적 실행 가능성을 간접 검증합니다.[10][11]

**Investigation note:**
- 1점보다 높은 이유는 theoretical rationale를 넘어 동물 functional data와 independent human class validation이 있기 때문입니다.
- 3점이 아닌 이유는 CE223BR17 자체에서 target engagement, dopamine biomarker, graft-survival imaging 또는 behavioral efficacy가 공개되지 않았기 때문입니다.
- 학술 논문과 특허의 세포가 CE223BR17 최종 drug product와 동일하다고 단정하지 않았습니다.
- Evidence Type: **E2_indirect_or_class_level_evidence**.

### 4.4 Platform Attractiveness

**Score: 3점**

**Main line:** 연계된 3D midbrain-organoid differentiation system은 다수 hESC/iPSC line에서 재현됐고, conventional 2D differentiation 대비 midbrain patterning, expansion 및 storage의 정량적 장점을 보였습니다.

**Criterion definition / selected-score rule:** Platform Attractiveness 3점은 적절한 comparator 대비 quantitative technical advantage가 있고, 그 장점이 복수 조건·cell line·platform-derived output에서 반복 확인될 때 부여합니다.

**What was checked:**
- Reusable differentiation architecture
- Multiple hESC/iPSC line compatibility
- Cell identity and purity
- Conventional 2D comparator
- Expansion and cryostorage
- Dopaminergic and astrocyte outputs
- In vivo functionality
- Manufacturing relevance

**Evidence trail:**
- 특허와 논문은 3개의 hESC line과 4개의 hiPSC line에서 ventral-midbrain-type NSC와 dopaminergic neuron을 생산했다고 보고합니다.[7][8]
- Single-cell RNA sequencing에서 가장 완전하게 midbrain-patterned된 cluster 1 비율은 Og-NSC 71%, conventional 2D-NSC 13%였습니다.[7]
- Og-NSC와 2D-NSC 모두 약 99.7%가 NSC marker를 발현했으나, pluripotency marker POU5F1, NANOG 및 KLF4를 발현한 Og-NSC 비율은 각각 0.09%, 0.45%, 0.91%로 낮았습니다.[7]
- 기술자료는 초기 hPSC culture dish 1개로부터 산술적으로 7,260 vials의 Og-NSC 생산이 가능하고, liquid-nitrogen storage 후에도 dopaminergic differentiation potential이 유지된다고 기술합니다.[7]
- Og-NSC는 organoid와 0.79–0.97, fetal midbrain과 0.70–0.85의 transcriptomic correlation을 보였습니다.[7]
- 별도 연구에서 ventral-midbrain-patterned astrocyte는 forebrain-patterned astrocyte보다 PD·AD 관련 therapeutic function이 강한 것으로 보고됐습니다.[9]

**Investigation note:**
- 2점보다 높은 이유는 하나의 실험이 아니라 여러 hESC/iPSC line, NSC-to-neuron differentiation, astrocyte output, expansion, cryostorage 및 PD animal condition에서 반복된 quantitative advantage가 존재하기 때문입니다.
- 해당 근거는 licensed/related academic platform evidence이며 CE223BR17의 GMP manufacturing validation과 동일하지 않습니다.
- 회사 차원의 lot-to-lot consistency, potency assay, release specification 및 commercial-scale yield는 공개되지 않았습니다.
- Platform evidence를 CE223BR17 Data Maturity에 중복 반영하지 않았습니다.
- Evidence Type: **E3_asset_specific_preclinical_or_technical_evidence**, 단 CE223BR17 final product가 아니라 공식적으로 연계된 technical platform 기준입니다.

| **B. US Unrisked Peak Sales** | **13,500 × 350,600 × 0.10 × 1.00 = 473.3 million USD** | calculation |
| Competition Haircut | 0.30 | AMCHEPRY 승인, bemdaneprocel Phase 3 및 다수 임상 프로그램 반영 |
| Pricing Power Adjustment | 0.80 | NSC/astrocyte differentiation 가능성은 있으나 human efficacy 및 manufacturing differentiation 미입증으로 승인 benchmark 대비 할인 |
| **C. US Obtainable Peak Sales** | **473.3 × 0.30 × 0.80 = 113.6 million USD** | calculation |
| **Calculated Global** | **113.6 × 1.5 = 170.4 million USD** | user-defined global multiplier를 완성된 US output에 1회 적용 |
| External Peak Sales Reference | Not available | CE223BR17-specific reliable forecast 미확인 |
| Final score basis | **1점** | 170.4 million USD는 1,000 million USD 미만 |

**Investigation note:**
- AMCHEPRY 가격은 미국 가격이 아니라 현재 이용 가능한 가장 가까운 승인 cell-product reimbursement benchmark입니다.
- Eligible rate, treatable subgroup, penetration, competition haircut 및 pricing adjustment는 analyst assumptions입니다.
- CE223BR17의 실제 cell dose, 제조원가, 수술비용, 면역억제 필요성 및 지속기간이 확인되면 결과가 크게 달라질 수 있습니다.
- Expansion Capacity Adjustment와 sensitivity analysis는 사용하지 않았습니다.
- 2점이 아닌 이유는 assessed value가 1,000 million USD threshold 미만이기 때문입니다.
- Evidence Type: **E2_indirect_or_class_level_evidence**.

---

## 5) Validation Notes

**Cross-checked facts:**
- CE223BR17 identity와 Parkinson’s disease indication은 2026년 1분기 KRX 공시와 회사 PR에서 확인했습니다.[2][5]
- 공식 현 파이프라인은 iPSC/ESC 및 astrocyte 기반 Parkinson’s disease program을 표시합니다.[1]
- 회사의 현재 법인명, 2022년 합병 및 KOSDAQ 상장은 공식 사업보고서에서 확인했습니다.[4]
- Midbrain-organoid NSC 기술의 정량적 성능은 patent와 peer-reviewed publication에서 교차검토했습니다.[7][8]
- Parkinson’s cell-replacement class의 임상성은 일본 승인자료, Phase 3 sponsor 자료 및 trial sources로 검증했습니다.[10][11][12][13][14][15]

**Uncertain points:**
- CE223BR17의 final cell composition이 NSC 단독, astrocyte 단독 또는 복합제품인지 불명확합니다.
- 최종 donor source와 allogeneic/autologous configuration이 공개되지 않았습니다.
- iPSC와 ESC 중 어떤 source가 clinical candidate에 채택됐는지 확인되지 않았습니다.
- Cell dose, administration site, surgical device 및 dosing procedure가 공개되지 않았습니다.
- CE223BR17-specific animal efficacy, dose response, graft survival 및 dopamine production data가 없습니다.
- Residual pluripotent-cell limit, tumorigenicity, genomic stability, biodistribution 및 ectopic-tissue risk가 공개되지 않았습니다.
- GMP manufacturing process, batch yield, release specification 및 potency assay가 공개되지 않았습니다.
- Immunosuppression strategy와 HLA matching strategy가 확인되지 않았습니다.
- GLP toxicology, IND-enabling CMC, regulatory consultation 또는 IND target date가 확인되지 않았습니다.
- Hanyang University technology-transfer agreement의 exclusivity, territory, sublicensing 및 patent-family rights를 계약 수준에서 확인할 필요가 있습니다.
- Academic Og-NSC/astrocyte technology와 CE223BR17 final drug product의 동일성은 확인되지 않았습니다.
- CE223BR17-specific external peak-sales forecast는 찾지 못했습니다.

**Search log:**
- Official company page: CorestemChemon corporate and pipeline pages
- Regulatory disclosure: 2025 business report and 2026 first-quarter report
- Asset aliases: CE223BR17, Parkinson research program, iPSC/ESC astrocyte, Corestem Parkinson
- Publications: midbrain organoid-derived NSC and ventral-midbrain astrocyte studies
- Patent: WO2021145467A1 and associated family information
- Trial registries: Parkinson dopaminergic-cell replacement programs
- Competitors: approved, Phase 3, Phase 1/2 and IND-cleared iPSC/ESC programs
- Epidemiology: Parkinson’s Foundation
- Pricing: AMCHEPRY Japanese reimbursement information
- External forecast: no reliable CE223BR17-specific forecast identified

---

## 6) Final Take

**One-line summary:** CE223BR17은 공식적으로 확인된 active preclinical Parkinson’s cell-therapy program이며 연계 midbrain-organoid platform은 기술적으로 매력적이지만, 후보 자체의 정량 비임상 package가 공개되지 않았고 경쟁군은 이미 승인 또는 Phase 3에 진입했습니다.

**Recommendation:**
- **Watch**
- Target fit과 platform quality는 높지만 현재 공개근거만으로는 Shortlist에 필요한 assessed-asset Data Maturity가 부족합니다.
- 다음 가치상승 trigger는 후보 확정, final cell composition 공개, CE223BR17-specific efficacy와 tumorigenicity data, GLP tox 개시 및 IND-enabling 일정입니다.

**Most important diligence question:**

**“CE223BR17의 최종 세포 구성·donor source·GMP manufacturing specification은 무엇이며, Hanyang academic platform과 구분되는 후보 자체의 PD 동물효능, engraftment, dopamine restoration, tumorigenicity 및 IND-enabling 결과는 무엇인가?”**

source_report.raw_markdown:
# Threebrooks Therapeutics Pipeline Scout Report: **TRPML1 / 3BT-1 (3BT-1-115)**

본 보고서는 GPT instruction 2 — Full Scout v3.3 (schema v3.2)에 따라 2026-08-07 기준으로 첨부자료를 우선 검토한 뒤 공개자료로 교차검증하고 7개 기준으로 평가했습니다. 감사 가능성을 위해 공개 URL과 첨부자료 provenance를 함께 표시합니다.

**중요:** TRPML1 프로그램의 실재성과 active development는 확인되며 최신 공개자료는 IND-enabling 연구 수행을 명시하므로 **PASS / Shortlist**로 평가합니다. 다만 공개자료의 `3BT-1`과 첨부 IR의 `3BT-1-115`가 정확히 동일한 현재 development candidate인지, 그리고 formal DC nomination이 완료됐는지는 확인되지 않았습니다.

**Identity Gate: PASS.** 2026 Korea Life Science Week 자료는 Threebrooks의 lead program을 `3BT-1`, first-in-class small-molecule TRPML1 agonist로 명시하고 AD/PD를 대상으로 기술하며, 2026-07-21 보도는 lead TRPML1 agonist에 대해 IND-enabling 연구를 수행 중이라고 확인합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

---

## 1) Company Profile

| Field | Content | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Company | Threebrooks Therapeutics | 회사 IR 및 공식 미디어 페이지. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1} :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2} |
| Legal name / aliases | 쓰리브룩스테라퓨틱스(주); Threebrooks Therapeutics | 공식 회사 페이지 및 IR |
| Country | Republic of Korea | 2026 exhibitor profile. :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3} |
| Headquarters | Pohang-si, Gyeongsangbuk-do, Republic of Korea | IR 및 exhibitor profile. :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4} :contentReference[oaicite:5]{index=5} |
| Website | www.threebrooks.net | 공식 회사 자료 |
| Company type / stage | Private early-stage biotech; lead therapeutic program publicly described as IND-enabling in July 2026 | :contentReference[oaicite:6]{index=6} |
| Focus areas | AD, PD, neurodegenerative disease; lysosomal ion channels; electrophysiology/CRO | IR은 TRPML1-AD, TRPML1-PD, TMEM175-PD를 표시. :contentReference[oaicite:7]{index=7} |
| Platform summary | AION™: AI/ion-channel electrophysiology, patch clamp, CNS cell/ex-vivo/animal evaluation; 별도로 lysosomal ion-channel drug discovery | :contentReference[oaicite:8]{index=8} |
| Financing / partnership signals | 2023 POSTECH Holdings seed KRW 0.4B, Deeptech TIPS, 다수 R&D 과제, 2025 BMS Innovation Challenge 우승, MJFF 협력, 2026 JLABS Korea | 회사 IR. :contentReference[oaicite:9]{index=9} 최신 JLABS 보도. :contentReference[oaicite:10]{index=10} |
| Lead pipeline summary | Public name `3BT-1`; 첨부 IR의 profiled pre-candidate는 `3BT-1-115` | Exhibitor profile과 첨부자료를 함께 사용. :contentReference[oaicite:11]{index=11} :contentReference[oaicite:12]{index=12} |

회사 IR상 설립일은 2022-12-19이며, 2026 IR 작성 시점 기준 임직원 10명, 김성영 대표 88% 및 POSTECH Holdings 9%의 주요주주 구성이 기재되어 있습니다. 이는 company-generated evidence이므로 독립적으로 확인된 cap table로 간주하지 않았습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:13]{index=13}

---

## 2) Pipeline Snapshot

| Field | Content | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Company | Threebrooks Therapeutics | [1], [2] |
| Lead asset | **3BT-1 program / 3BT-1-115 pre-candidate** | Public program name과 IR compound code를 병기 |
| Target | **TRPML1 / MCOLN1** | [2], 첨부 IR |
| Theme / Cluster | **Theme: E/I Balance / Cluster: Ion Channel** | SKBP operational mapping. 단, 실제 biology는 classical synaptic E/I보다 lysosomal proteostasis에 가까움 |
| MoA | TRPML1 agonism → lysosomal Ca²⁺ release → autophagy/lysosome function recovery → intracellular aggregate/damaged mitochondria clearance; downstream neuroinflammation reduction | 회사 TPP/MoA. :contentReference[oaicite:14]{index=14} :contentReference[oaicite:15]{index=15} |
| Modality / Platform | **Small molecule** | [2], [3] |
| Indication | Lead: early Alzheimer's disease; additional PD preclinical evidence | TPP 및 PD data. :contentReference[oaicite:16]{index=16} :contentReference[oaicite:17]{index=17} |
| Stage | **IND-enabling** | 2026 exhibitor profile은 lead optimization/DC nomination expected Q2라고 기재했으나, 더 최신인 2026-07-21 자료는 IND-enabling 연구가 진행 중이라고 명시. Canonical rule상 최신 explicit IND-enabling activity를 적용. :contentReference[oaicite:18]{index=18} |
| Key data | direct lysosomal patch-clamp activation, Cryo-EM binding structure, lysosomal function/biogenesis, mitophagy, Aβ/tau clearance, anti-inflammatory effects, mouse PK/BBB, AD/PD in-vivo efficacy, non-GLP safety claim | :contentReference[oaicite:19]{index=19} |

**Mechanistic validation:** 독립 연구에서 APOE4 human cortical neuron의 TRPML1-mediated lysosomal Ca²⁺ release 감소와 ML-SA1에 의한 AD-like endolysosomal phenotype rescue가 보고되어 AD disease linkage를 지지합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:20]{index=20} PD에서도 TRPML1 activation이 α-synuclein-containing autophagosome maturation/degradation을 촉진한다는 독립 연구가 있습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:21]{index=21}

---

## 3) Scorecard Summary

| Criterion | Score (maximum 3 points each) | One-line judgment | Evidence used |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Target Relevance | **3점** | AD가 SKBP interest indication이고 TRPML1-lysosome disease linkage도 독립적으로 검증됨 | IR + [4]-[6] |
| Competitive Landscape | **2점** | comparator 대비 정량 differentiation은 있으나 direct TRPML1 agonist 대비 head-to-head는 없고 LW-1017은 이미 Phase 1 | IR + [6]-[12] |
| MoA Validity | **3점** | 3BT-1-115 direct patch-clamp activation + Cryo-EM binding + downstream functional PD가 존재 | IR + [4]-[6] |
| Platform Attractiveness | **1점** | AION은 reusable platform이나 경쟁 플랫폼 대비 정량적 technical superiority는 미제시 | IR + [2] |
| Expansion Potential | **2점** | 주 적응증 AD 외 PD에서 3BT-1-115 quantitative in-vivo efficacy 존재 | IR |
| Data Maturity | **3점** | target/functional/PK-ADME/in-vivo/safety의 복수 complementary quantitative domains 확보 | IR + [3] |
| Marketability | **3점** | **calculation** 기준, assumption-based global obtainable peak sales **USD 2,211.17M** | [13]-[16] |
| **Total** | **17점 / 21점** | **Hard Filter: PASS** |  |

---

## 4) Criterion Detail Pages

### 4.1 Target Relevance
**Score: 3**

**Main line:** 초기 Alzheimer's disease가 명시된 lead indication이며, TRPML1 dysfunction/activation과 AD lysosomal pathology 간 연결이 독립 실험에서도 확인되어 최고점 요건을 충족합니다.

**What was checked:**
- Target identity: TRPML1/MCOLN1
- Disease/biology relevance
- SKBP Theme / Cluster fit
- AD/PD neurodegeneration relevance

**Evidence trail:**
- 회사 TPP는 early AD/MCI를 target population으로 하고 경구 BBB-penetrant small molecule을 목표로 하며 TRPML1 activation 및 autophagy-lysosome restoration을 MoA로 제시합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:22]{index=22}
- 첨부자료는 AD 환자 뇌에서 TRPML1 감소를 RNA-seq/면역염색으로 제시합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:23]{index=23}
- Independent AD work에서 APOE4 neurons의 TRPML1 activity defect와 pharmacologic rescue가 관찰됐습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:24]{index=24}
- Independent PD work도 α-synuclein clearance와 TRPML1 activation의 functional link를 지지합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:25]{index=25}

**Investigation note:** 3점은 단순 “ion channel”이라는 이유가 아니라, SKBP interest indication인 AD가 특정되고 해당 disease biology와 target/MoA가 독립적으로 연결되기 때문에 부여했습니다.

---

## 6) Final Take

**One-line summary:** **TRPML1 biology와 3BT-1-115의 preclinical data package는 shortlist할 수준이지만, 가치의 핵심은 “TRPML1이 좋은 target인가”보다 “이미 Phase 1에 들어간 LW-1017 등보다 exposure-normalized efficacy/TE/safety가 실제로 우월한가”에 달려 있습니다.**

**Recommendation: Shortlist**

**Most important diligence question:**  
**효능 용량에서 현재 IND-enabling molecule의 unbound brain exposure가 충분한 TRPML1 activation과 in-vivo target engagement를 지속하면서 chronic safety margin을 확보하는가?**

### 의심해볼 포인트 / Drill-down questions
1. **Free-brain exposure vs functional potency:** 첨부자료 p.26의 visual table은 30 mg/kg 투여 후 free-brain concentration이 대략 sub-0.1 µM 범위에 있음을 보여주는 반면, lysosomal patch-clamp 그래프는 0.01/0.1/1/10 µM에서 각각 약 1.49/2.21/3.77/8.45-fold activation을 보입니다. :contentReference[oaicite:63]{index=63} **실제 efficacy가 어느 정도의 channel activation을 필요로 하며, free exposure–TE–efficacy chain이 닫혀 있는가?**
2. **Comparator choice:** 왜 best-in-class 주장을 LRRK2/PINK1/Leqembi/L-DOPA와 비교하고, 가장 중요한 LW-1017/CSM-101/LBR-2950과는 비교하지 않았는가?
3. **Candidate identity:** `3BT-1-115`가 실제 formal development candidate인가, 아니면 current IND-enabling molecule이 다른 backup compound인가?
4. **Chronic TRPML1 activation safety:** 회사 Q&A도 systemic exposure 시 inner-ear/hearing risk를 질문받아 tissue distribution/ABR test 수행을 언급합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:64]{index=64} **ABR, inner-ear exposure, lysosomal Ca²⁺ homeostasis 및 chronic tox margin 결과는 무엇인가?**
5. **Clinical differentiation after Leqembi SC:** 2026년부터 anti-amyloid treatment도 home SC initiation이 가능해졌다면, oral convenience 외에 efficacy, ARIA-free profile, monitoring burden, combination value 중 무엇이 실제 TPP advantage가 되는가?
6. **Translational biomarker:** TFEB/p62, lysosomal/autophagic flux 또는 aggregate-clearance 중 FIH에서 dose selection과 early Go/No-Go를 가능하게 할 human-accessible PD biomarker가 무엇인가?

1) Signal Fidelity
PRX reacts with H₂O₂ with high specificity and sensitivity, maintaining its physiological level. This control 
is essential for preserving the fidelity of signaling pathways that rely on H₂O₂ as a 2nd messenger in their 
feedback regulation. Loss of functional PRX leads to signaling dysregulation through persistent loop 
activation.
2) Signal Modulation
PRX also transfers oxidative equivalents to select proteins with redox-sensitive motifs through a process 
known as Redox Relay. This reversible oxidation modulates the activity and functional state of target 
proteins, allowing precise fine-tuning of signal transduction.

Post-mortem brain tissues from AD patients (n = 4) and age-matched healthy controls (n = 3) 
were stained for hyperoxidized PRX (PRX-SO₂/₃) – the catalytically inactive form of the 
enzyme – by immunohistochemistry. Grey and white matter were assessed separately, 
antibody specificity was confirmed with a blocking-peptide control (+B.P / –B.P), and grey-
matter signal intensity was quantified and compared between groups.
Peroxiredoxins are thiol peroxidase enzymes that regulate cellular H2O2 
as a catalytic substrate. They are essential for all aerobic organisms by 
tuning cellular redox signaling as well as further protecting cells from 
oxidative stress. They are the most sensitive enzyme against cellular 
H2O2 , thus described as the “Redox guardian”. 
In the brain, PRX1 isoform is abundantly expressed in astrocytes, while 
PRX2 isoform is expressed selectively in neurons. Thus, both isoforms 
are believed to be involved in the astrocyte-neuron communication 
network essential for memory and cognitive functions.

To determine whether the PRX hyperoxidation seen in human AD is
recapitulated in vivo, the same analysis was conducted in wild-type and 
5xFAD mice at 4 and 6 months of age. Using the same PRX-SO₂/₃-
specific antibody, hyperoxidized PRX (PRX-SO₂/₃) – the dead enzyme
form – was detected by immunohistochemistry in the cortex and 
hippocampus. Signal was quantified as fold change in mean
intensity/area relative to WT. Antibody specificity was confirmed by a

The level of hyperoxidized PRX (PRX-SO₂/₃) is significantly increased 
in correlation with disease progression in the 5xFAD brain.
Dead PRX levels were slightly detectable at 4 months and rose 
significantly by 6 months in both the cortex and hippocampus.
This demonstrates that PRX inactivation is not a consequence of the 
disease, but a progressive, disease-associated event conserved across
human AD and 5xFAD mouse models.
PRX inactivation accumulates in step with disease progression 
and is conserved across human and mouse models, strengthening 
the rationale for targeting PRX in AD.

PRX reacts with H₂O₂ with high specificity and sensitivity, maintaining its physiological level. This control

proteins, allowing precise fine-tuning of signal transduction.

Post-mortem brain tissues from AD patients (n = 4) and age-matched healthy controls (n = 3)

Peroxiredoxins are thiol peroxidase enzymes that regulate cellular H2O2 
as a catalytic substrate. They are essential for all aerobic organisms by 
tuning cellular redox signaling as well as further protecting cells from 
oxidative stress. They are the most sensitive enzyme against cellular 
H2O2 , thus described as the “Redox guardian”. 
In the brain, PRX1 isoform is abundantly expressed in astrocytes, while 
PRX2 isoform is expressed selectively in neurons. Thus, both isoforms 
are believed to be involved in the astrocyte-neuron communication 
network essential for memory and cognitive functions.

차이가 있으며 PRX 관련 functional activity 에도 차이가 있어 구분하여 개발하고 있다고 언급. 
Q) Disulfide-containing structure 가 체내에서 cleavage 된 후 다른 protein 등 비가역적으로 
결합하는 non-specific covalent binding 가능성은 없는지? 
→ Disulfide 의 redox potential 특성상 plasma 에서는 bond 가 풀리지 않으며 parent

✓  Chemical / Reactivity Stability 
Q) Human albumin 등을 이용하여 irreversible covalent binding / adduct 를 정량적으로

- ClinicalTrials.gov exact-name search에서 VTA-27 interventional record는 확인되지 않았으며, 이는 deck상 pre-IND status와 일치하지만 registry absence 자체가 규제 상태의 완전한 증명은 아닙니다.

- Financing / partnership sources: VASTHERA official news 확인 [4]

---

## 6) Final Take

One-line summary: **VTA-27은 oral PRX-mimetic/astrocyte-STAT3 접근과 stage-appropriate preclinical package가 흥미롭지만, 임상 번역을 좌우할 brain exposure–target engagement–cognition 연결과 경쟁자 대비 우위가 아직 검증되지 않은 13/21점 REVIEW asset입니다.**

Recommendation:
- **Watch**

Most important diligence question:
- **Therapeutically relevant free-brain exposure에서 VTA-27이 PRX/STAT3 pathway target engagement를 재현하고, 그 biomarker 변화가 5xFAD cognition 개선과 exposure-response로 연결된다는 blinded, independently reproducible package가 있는가?**

의심해볼 포인트 / 드릴다운 질문:
- pSTAT3 IC50 162 nM는 VTA-27의 direct PRX-mimetic activity를 입증하는가, 아니면 downstream phenotypic effect만 보여주는가?
- 5xFAD의 세 behavioral assay가 독립적인 efficacy domain인가, 아니면 동일 동물·동일 biological effect를 반복 측정한 결과인가?
- IND 일정이 2026 목표에서 2027년 4분기로 이동했다면 병목은 tox, CMC, PK/ADME, biomarker 또는 financing 중 무엇이며 critical path는 무엇인가?

H                D

Post-mortem brain tissues from AD patients (n = 4) and age-matched healthy controls (n = 3) 
were stained for hyperoxidized PRX (PRX-SO₂/₃) – the catalytically inactive form of the 
enzyme – by immunohistochemistry. Grey and white matter were assessed separately, 
antibody specificity was confirmed with a blocking-peptide control (+B.P / –B.P), and grey-
matter signal intensity was quantified and compared between groups.
Peroxiredoxins are thiol peroxidase enzymes that regulate cellular H2O2 
as a catalytic substrate. They are essential for all aerobic organisms by 
tuning cellular redox signaling as well as further protecting cells from 
oxidative stress. They are the most sensitive enzyme against cellular 
H2O2 , thus described as the “Redox guardian”. 
In the brain, PRX1 isoform is abundantly expressed in astrocytes, while 
PRX2 isoform is expressed selectively in neurons. Thus, both isoforms 
are believed to be involved in the astrocyte-neuron communication 
network essential for memory and cognitive functions.

## 4) Criterion Detail Pages

### 4.1 Target Relevance
Score: **3/3**

Main line: **Alzheimer’s disease가 명시적으로 확인되고, VTA-27이 겨냥하는 reactive astrocyte–STAT3/redox biology가 AD pathology와 독립적으로 연결되어 있어 3점 기준을 충족합니다.**

What was checked:
- Target identity
- Disease/biology relevance
- SKBP Theme / Cluster fit
- General neurodegeneration / neuroinflammation / epilepsy relevance

Evidence trail:
- 회사 deck은 VTA-27을 AD용 경구 small molecule로 정의하고 mild-to-moderate AD를 target population으로 명시합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:29]{index=29} :contentReference[oaicite:30]{index=30}
- AD 환자 post-mortem brain에서 hyperoxidized/inactive PRX signal이 healthy control보다 높았다는 회사자료가 제시됩니다(n=4 AD, n=3 control, p=0.008). 이는 human tissue association이지만 작은 표본의 company-generated evidence입니다. :contentReference[oaicite:31]{index=31}
- 독립적인 EMBO Molecular Medicine 연구는 AD mouse model에서 astrocytic STAT3 억제가 amyloid deposition, neuroinflammation, network dysfunction 및 cognitive impairment를 완화했다고 보고해 disease-biology linkage를 지지합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:32]{index=32}
- SKBP mapping은 Neuroimmune / 교세포 향상성으로 판단했습니다. 이는 reactive astrocyte 조절이 핵심이라는 확인된 MoA에 기반한 internal mapping입니다.

Investigation note:
- 2점보다 높은 이유는 적응증 확인에 더해 target/MoA와 AD biology의 독립적 연결이 있기 때문입니다.
- 다만 “PRX/STAT3 axis”의 정확한 direct molecular target, binding mode, isoform selectivity는 공개자료로 확인되지 않아 asset identity와 target annotation을 혼동해서는 안 됩니다.

### 4.2 Competitive Landscape
Score: **1/3**

Main line: **VTA-27은 oral glial/redox approach라는 개념적 차별성이 있으나, 승인 DMT 및 임상단계 glial/tau 경쟁자 대비 head-to-head 정량 자료가 없어 1점입니다.**

What was checked:
- Same disease competitors
- Same target competitors
- Same or similar MoA competitors
- Front runner count
- Approved / Phase 3 / clinical / preclinical status

Competitor table:

| Competitor | Company | Modality | Target / MoA | Stage | Why it matters | Similarity | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Leqembi (lecanemab) | Eisai / Biogen | Antibody | soluble Aβ aggregates/protofibrils | Approved | Established disease-modifying benchmark, efficacy/safety/monitoring expectations 설정 | Low | FDA [7] :contentReference[oaicite:33]{index=33} |
| Kisunla (donanemab) | Eli Lilly | Antibody | amyloid plaque / pyroglutamate Aβ | Approved | 또 다른 approved anti-amyloid DMT로 commercial access와 clinical bar를 높임 | Low | FDA [8] :contentReference[oaicite:34]{index=34} |
| Diranersen (BIIB080) | Biogen / Ionis | Antisense oligonucleotide | MAPT mRNA lowering | Phase 2, active not recruiting | amyloid 외 downstream pathology를 겨냥하는 advanced competitor | Low | ClinicalTrials.gov [9] :contentReference[oaicite:35]{index=35} |
| SAR448851 / VG-3927 | Sanofi / former Vigil | Oral small molecule | TREM2 agonist; microglial neuroprotection | Phase 2 registered/not yet recruiting | oral, brain-penetrant neuroimmune competitor로 VTA-27의 convenience/glial positioning과 근접 | Medium | Sanofi [10], registry mirror [11] :contentReference[oaicite:36]{index=36} |
| ACI-19764 | AC Immune | Oral small molecule | brain-penetrant NLRP3 inhibitor | Phase 1 ongoing | oral neuroinflammation-targeting program이며 blood PD/target-engagement endpoint를 포함 | Medium | ClinicalTrials.gov [12] :contentReference[oaicite:37]{index=37} |
| AL002 | Alector | Antibody | TREM2 agonist | Phase 2 completed; primary endpoint negative | glial target engagement만으로 clinical benefit이 보장되지 않는다는 cautionary comparator | Medium | ClinicalTrials.gov [13], Nature Medicine [14] :contentReference[oaicite:38]{index=38} |

Investigation note:
- Exact PRX-mimetic/same-target clinical competitor는 공개 검색에서 확인하지 못했지만, 이는 경쟁 부재의 증명이 아닙니다. VTA-27 구조·patent claims 및 비공개 preclinical programs가 공개되지 않았기 때문입니다.
- 회사 deck의 “multi-target” 도표는 서로 다른 프로그램의 기능을 개념적으로 비교한 것이며, 동일 실험에서의 정량 head-to-head 결과가 아닙니다. :contentReference[oaicite:39]{index=39}
- 2점에 필요한 appropriate comparator 대비 정량 differentiation가 없어 1점으로 제한합니다.

### 4.3 MoA Validity
Score: **3/3**

Main line: **Primary astrocyte에서 pSTAT3 IC50 162 nM이라는 asset-specific functional readout이 있고, 5xFAD cognition 결과와 독립 STAT3 biology가 연결되어 3점입니다.**

What was checked:
- Journal publication / PMID / DOI
- Mechanistic consistency
- Functional readout
- Disease linkage
- Safety-relevant signal

Evidence trail:
- VTA-27은 primary astrocyte STAT3 phosphorylation을 IC50 162 nM로 억제한다고 회사 deck에 기재되어 있습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:40]{index=40}
- 회사 MoA diagram은 reactive astrocyte의 active STAT3와 inflammatory cytokines를 낮추고 neuron의 H2O2 burden을 줄이는 dual-action model을 제시합니다. 이는 company mechanistic model이며 직접 binding proof는 아닙니다. :contentReference[oaicite:41]{index=41}
- 8주 5xFAD study에서 Y-maze, NOR, MWM의 복수 memory domain이 평가되었고 2 mg/kg에서 더 일관된 개선이 관찰되었습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:42]{index=42}
- 독립 연구는 astrocytic STAT3가 AD mouse pathology와 cognition에 기능적으로 관여함을 보여 class/target validation을 제공합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:43]{index=43}
- 안전성 초기 package는 Ames 음성, hERG IC50 >200 μM 및 rat/dog 28-day tox 완료로 제시되지만, full NOAEL/exposure margin은 공개되지 않았습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:44]{index=44}

Investigation note:
- 3점은 direct binding이 아니라 rubric상 허용되는 “assessed-asset direct functional validation / mechanism-linked PD”에 기반합니다.
- 점수를 의심할 핵심은 pSTAT3 IC50가 biochemical target engagement인지 downstream functional assay인지, 그리고 brain exposure에서 해당 농도를 지속적으로 달성하는지입니다.

### 4.4 Platform Attractiveness
Score: **1/3**

Main line: **Redoxizyme™는 PRX mimetic을 여러 질환·자산에 적용하는 재사용 가능한 discovery system이지만, platform technical advantage의 comparator 대비 정량 검증이 없어 1점입니다.**

What was checked:
- Is the platform real and reproducible?
- Is differentiation supported by data?
- Is the underlying technical system reusable across candidates, programs, or conditions?

Evidence trail:
- 회사는 Redoxizyme™가 PRX 기능을 모사하는 small-molecule library/nanozyme를 설계한다고 설명하며, VTB-10, VTA-27, VTA-63에 공통 원리를 적용합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:45]{index=45}
- 2026 deck은 세 자산과 40건의 global IP를 주장하고 VTB-10의 first-human dosing을 제시합니다. 이는 재사용성과 execution signal이지만, platform 우위의 정량 comparator test는 아닙니다. :contentReference[oaicite:46]{index=46}
- VTA-27의 IC50·efficacy는 asset data로서 Data Maturity에 반영했으며, 같은 의미로 platform score에 중복 가산하지 않았습니다.

Investigation note:
- 2점에 필요한 조건은 common PRX-mimetic design이 conventional antioxidant, non-mimetic analog 또는 적절한 control 대비 catalytic/redox selectivity, durability, intracellular localization, BBB delivery 등을 정량적으로 개선한다는 자료입니다.
- VTB-10의 FPD만으로는 score 3이 되지 않으며, score-2 수준의 platform technical advantage가 먼저 필요합니다.

Platform vs Data Maturity separation:
- Platform Attractiveness는 공통 기술 시스템의 재사용성과 우위를 평가했습니다.
- Data Maturity는 VTA-27 자체의 potency, efficacy, tox 및 CMC만 평가했습니다.
- VTA-27의 동일 endpoint를 두 항목에서 중복 점수화하지 않았습니다.

### 4.5 Expansion Potential
Score: **0/3**

Main line: **Parkinson’s disease는 “potential expansion”으로만 언급되며 VTA-27-specific biological package나 active development program이 확인되지 않아 0점입니다.**

What was checked:
- Expansion beyond main indication
- Asset-specific quantitative data in additional indications
- Confirmed asset-specific preclinical, IND-enabling, or clinical development programs

Evidence trail:
- 2026 pipeline slide에는 VTA-27의 AD 외 “Potential expansion to PD”만 기재되어 있습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:47]{index=47}
- 제공자료에는 PD model efficacy, PD-relevant biomarker/PD, dose exposure, 별도 timeline 또는 공식 pipeline row가 없습니다.

Investigation note:
- rubric상 future opportunity 또는 indication list는 별도 프로그램으로 간주하지 않습니다.
- 1점이 되려면 최소한 VTA-27에 직접 연결된 PD biological rationale와 공식적으로 정의된 additional indication가 필요하고, 2점 이상에는 asset-specific quantitative data가 필요합니다.

### 4.6 Data Maturity
Score: **3/3**

Main line: **현재 IND-enabling 단계에 적합한 세 가지 상보적 정량 domain—mechanistic potency, in vivo cognition, safety/CMC readiness—이 확인되어 3점입니다.**

What was checked:
- In vitro data
- In vivo data
- Quantitative result
- Reproducibility
- IND-enabling / GLP tox / PK/PD / CMC / human data availability

Evidence trail:
- In vitro domain: primary astrocyte pSTAT3 inhibition IC50 162 nM. :contentReference[oaicite:48]{index=48}
- In vivo efficacy domain: 5xFAD, 8-week dosing, Y-maze/NOR/MWM, 0.5 및 2 mg/kg, group size 약 12–14; 2 mg/kg에서 복수 assay의 개선이 더 일관적입니다. :contentReference[oaicite:49]{index=49}
- Development-readiness domain: rat/dog 28-day repeat-dose tox 완료, Ames 음성, hERG IC50 >200 μM; mouse/rat/dog/monkey PK 및 ADME는 진행 중입니다. :contentReference[oaicite:50]{index=50}
- CMC: synthetic route purity >99%, total impurities <0.5%, DS GMP underway; DP manufacturing은 planned입니다. :contentReference[oaicite:51]{index=51}
- Timeline은 추가 efficacy/immune profiling, ADME, GLP safety 및 documentation 뒤 2027년 4분기 IND 제출을 제시합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:52]{index=52}

Investigation note:
- 3점은 “human-ready” 또는 임상 성공 가능성을 의미하지 않습니다. 현재 stage에 필요한 서로 다른 development question을 다루는 정량 domain이 2개 이상 있다는 의미입니다.
- 가장 큰 gap은 공개된 full PK exposure, brain/plasma ratio, PK/PD relationship, target engagement biomarker, NOAEL 및 safety margin, blinded/randomized study methods, independent replication입니다.

### 4.7 Marketability
Score: **2/3**

Main line: **외부 asset-specific forecast가 없어 assumption-based internal calculation을 사용했으며, global obtainable peak sales를 USD 1,946M로 산정해 2점입니다.**

Marketability A/B/C explanation:
- **A. US Target Addressable Patient (TAP):** Total US patient pool에 diagnosis rate, indication eligibility rate 및 practically treatable subgroup rate를 적용해 실제 표적 환자 수를 산정합니다.
- **B. US Unrisked Peak Sales:** A에서 계산한 TAP에 annual net price, peak penetration 및 treatment-duration factor를 적용해 경쟁 조정 전 미국 최대 매출을 산정합니다.
- **C. US Obtainable Peak Sales:** B에서 계산한 unrisked peak sales에 competition haircut과 pricing-power adjustment를 적용해 현실적으로 획득 가능한 미국 최대 매출을 산정합니다. 이후 US obtainable peak sales에 global multiplier를 한 번 적용해 global obtainable peak sales를 계산합니다.

What was checked:
- Internal A/B/C calculation
- Reliable asset-specific external peak-sales forecast, if available
- Competition haircut and pricing power without double counting

Worksheet:

| Step | What to fill | Evidence / assumption |
|---|---|---|
| A. US TAP | 7,400,000 × 50% × 60% × 70% = **1,554,000** | 2026 US clinical AD dementia population 7.4M [16] :contentReference[oaicite:53]{index=53}. Diagnosis 50%는 disclosure/diagnosis gap의 conservative proxy; 60% mild-to-moderate eligibility와 70% practical treatability는 공개 stage-distribution·label이 없어 명시적 screening assumptions |
| B. US Unrisked Peak Sales | 1,554,000 × USD 26,500/year × 10% × 1.0 = **USD 4,118.1M** | Leqembi annual list-price benchmark USD 26,500 [17] :contentReference[oaicite:54]{index=54}; oral preclinical late entrant의 10% peak penetration은 assumption |
| C. US Obtainable Peak Sales | USD 4,118.1M × 45% × 70% = **USD 1,297.2M** | 45% competition haircut: 2 approved anti-Aβ + multiple tau/glial programs; 70% pricing-power adjustment: oral convenience upside보다 unproven human efficacy/safety 및 likely price pressure를 우선 반영 |
| Calculated Global | USD 1,297.2M × 1.5 = **USD 1,945.8M** | user-defined screening policy, 한 번만 적용 |
| External Peak Sales Reference | **Not found** | 독립 analyst/consensus의 VTA-27-specific numeric forecast를 확인하지 못함 |
| Final score basis | **USD 1,946M → 2점** | 1,000 이상 2,000 미만 threshold |

Investigation note:
- 이 계산은 rNPV가 아니며 probability of technical/regulatory success를 반영하지 않은 peak-sales screen입니다.
- TAP의 stage-share, 실제 diagnosis, contraindication, persistence, net price, launch timing 및 market share가 공개되지 않아 confidence는 low-to-moderate입니다.
- 3점이 아닌 이유는 산정치가 USD 2,000M 미만이고, 핵심 비율이 아직 asset-specific evidence가 아닌 assumptions이기 때문입니다.

---

## 5) Validation Notes

Cross-checked facts:
- Asset identity: 회사 공식 pipeline과 2026 deck 모두 VTA-27을 AD small-molecule program으로 확인합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:55]{index=55}
- Current stage: 공개 데이터베이스는 preclinical로 분류하고, 최신 제공 deck은 completed/ongoing IND-enabling work와 2027년 4분기 IND submission 계획을 제시합니다. 계획만으로 IND filed/cleared로 승격하지 않았습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:56]{index=56} :contentReference[oaicite:57]{index=57}
- MoA: 회사 공식자료의 BBB-penetrant PRX mimetic 설명과 deck의 STAT3 redox-modulation 설명이 일관되지만, exact direct target/binding data는 공개되지 않았습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:58]{index=58} :contentReference[oaicite:59]{index=59}
- Financing: official news의 Series A/B USD 18M와 deck의 개별 round 합계 USD 15.9M가 일치하지 않아 definition/date/currency treatment 확인이 필요합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:60]{index=60} :contentReference[oaicite:61]{index=61}

Uncertain points:
- 2025-12 official news는 “next year” IND submission을 시사하지만, 2026 deck timeline은 2027년 4분기를 표시합니다. 최신 board-approved integrated development plan과 delay root cause가 필요합니다.
- VTA-27 chemical structure, exact PRX isoform interaction, binding kinetics, off-target/selectivity panel, BBB exposure 및 brain free concentration이 비공개입니다.
- 5xFAD study의 randomization, blinding, prespecified analysis, sex balance, exact p-values/effect sizes 및 independent replication report가 필요합니다.
- 28-day tox의 NOAEL, toxicokinetics, exposure multiple, histopathology signal과 longer-duration tox plan이 필요합니다.
- IP는 “PCT ready to file”로 기재되어 있어 filing number, priority date, composition-of-matter scope 및 FTO 확인이 필요합니다.
- ClinicalTrials.gov exact-name search에서 VTA-27 interventional record는 확인되지 않았으며, 이는 deck상 pre-IND status와 일치하지만 registry absence 자체가 규제 상태의 완전한 증명은 아닙니다.

Search log:
- Official company page: About, platform, pipeline, investor news 확인 [1]–[4]
- Pipeline page: VTA-27 AD, oral small-molecule claim 확인 [3]
- Platform page: Redoxizyme/PRX nanozyme 원리 확인 [2]
- Publications: astrocytic STAT3 AD functional validation 및 최신 STAT3 review 확인 [5], [6]
- Regulatory / trial registry: VTA-27 exact-name registry 검색; 주요 competitor trial status 확인 [9], [11]–[13]
- Competitor sources: FDA approvals, ClinicalTrials.gov, Sanofi/AC Immune, Nature Medicine 확인 [7]–[14]
- Market / epidemiology sources: 2026 Alzheimer’s Association population, anti-Aβ price benchmark 확인 [16], [17]
- Financing / partnership sources: VASTHERA official news 확인 [4]

---

## 6) Final Take

One-line summary: **VTA-27은 oral PRX-mimetic/astrocyte-STAT3 접근과 stage-appropriate preclinical package가 흥미롭지만, 임상 번역을 좌우할 brain exposure–target engagement–cognition 연결과 경쟁자 대비 우위가 아직 검증되지 않은 13/21점 REVIEW asset입니다.**

Recommendation:
- **Watch**

Most important diligence question:
- **Therapeutically relevant free-brain exposure에서 VTA-27이 PRX/STAT3 pathway target engagement를 재현하고, 그 biomarker 변화가 5xFAD cognition 개선과 exposure-response로 연결된다는 blinded, independently reproducible package가 있는가?**

의심해볼 포인트 / 드릴다운 질문:
- pSTAT3 IC50 162 nM는 VTA-27의 direct PRX-mimetic activity를 입증하는가, 아니면 downstream phenotypic effect만 보여주는가?
- 5xFAD의 세 behavioral assay가 독립적인 efficacy domain인가, 아니면 동일 동물·동일 biological effect를 반복 측정한 결과인가?
- IND 일정이 2026 목표에서 2027년 4분기로 이동했다면 병목은 tox, CMC, PK/ADME, biomarker 또는 financing 중 무엇이며 critical path는 무엇인가?

## 4) Criterion Detail Pages

### 4.1 Target Relevance
Score: **3**

Main line: **Alzheimer's disease는 SKBP interest indication이며, VTA-27의 astrocyte-STAT3/PRX redox mechanism은 AD neuroinflammation biology에 직접 연결됩니다.**

What was checked:
- Target identity
- Disease/biology relevance
- SKBP Theme / Cluster fit
- General neurodegeneration / neuroinflammation relevance

Evidence trail:
- VASTHERA 공식 pipeline은 VTA-27을 AD candidate로 명시하고 oral small molecule로 astrocyte activation과 neuronal death를 동시에 억제하도록 설계됐다고 설명합니다. [1]
- Aug-2026 deck p.11에서는 human post-mortem AD brain(n=4)에서 healthy control(n=3) 대비 hyperoxidized/inactivated PRX가 증가했다고 제시하며 p=0.008을 보고합니다. 이는 company-generated target rationale입니다. [F1]
- Deck p.14-18에서는 PRX1 loss → pSTAT3 증가/reactive astrogliosis/cytokines 증가와 PRX2의 neuronal protection을 제시합니다. [F1]
- Independent study에서 astrocyte-specific Stat3 deletion 또는 pharmacological inhibition이 APP/PS1 AD model의 amyloid pathology, inflammatory signaling, network dysfunction 및 memory decline을 개선했습니다. [4]
- Independent Nature Neuroscience study는 severe reactive astrocytes가 H2O2를 과생성하며 neuronal death, tauopathy, cognitive impairment에 기여할 수 있음을 보여줍니다. [5]

Investigation note:
- 단순 AD association이 아니라 **asset-specific PRX/STAT3 data + independent astrocyte/STAT3/H2O2 disease validation**이 모두 존재하므로 3점입니다.
- 다만 PRX inactivation 자체가 human AD에서 prospective causal driver라는 임상적 증명은 아직 없습니다.

### 4.2 Competitive Landscape
Score: **2**

Main line: **동일 PRX-mimetic/STAT3-redox AD asset은 확인되지 않았지만, oral astrocyte-targeting 및 broader neuroimmune AD programs와 approved anti-amyloid agents가 이미 경쟁 bar를 높이고 있습니다.**

What was checked:
- VTA-27 / VT-A1 asset name
- PRX mimetic + Alzheimer's disease
- Peroxiredoxin + STAT3 + astrocyte + AD
- Same disease competitors
- Same/similar neuroimmune biology competitors
- Approved / Phase 2 / clinical programs
- ClinicalTrials.gov, FDA, recent clinical publications

Competitor table:

| Competitor | Company | Modality | Target / MoA | Stage | Why it matters | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| KDS2010 | NeuroBiogen | Small molecule, oral | Reversible MAO-B inhibition / reactive astrocyte biology | Phase 2a recruiting | Mild MCI/mild AD에서 oral QD; GFAP, cytokines 등 glial biomarker 평가. 가장 가까운 astrocyte-focused clinical competitor 중 하나 | [6], [7] |
| XPro1595 | INmune Bio | Protein biologic | Dominant-negative TNF / neuroinflammation | Phase 2 completed | Inflammation-biomarker-selected early AD population에서 downstream neuroinflammation strategy 평가 | [8] |
| VG-3927 | Sanofi / Vigil | Small molecule, oral | TREM2 agonist / microglial neuroprotection | Phase 1 completed; Phase 2 planned | Large pharma-backed oral neuroimmune competitor, 이미 human PK/PD stage 진입 | [9], [10] |
| AL002 | Alector | Antibody | TREM2 agonist | Phase 2 completed; negative primary endpoint | CNS target engagement/PD가 있어도 cognitive efficacy로 연결되지 않을 수 있음을 보여주는 translational caution | [11] |
| Leqembi | Eisai/Biogen | Antibody | Anti-Aβ | Approved / marketed | Current disease-modifying efficacy, safety, reimbursement 및 pricing benchmark | [13] |
| Kisunla | Eli Lilly | Antibody | Anti-Aβ | Approved / marketed | 두 번째 approved anti-amyloid benchmark; VTA-27의 future clinical bar를 높임 | [12] |

Search result:
- **High-similarity:** 0 verified
- **Medium-similarity:** 4
- **Low-similarity:** 2
- Direct PRX-mimetic AD competitor가 검색되지 않았으나 이를 exclusivity 증명으로 해석하지 않았습니다.

Investigation note:
- VTA-27은 5xFAD에서 cognition, GFAP, NeuN, amyloid burden 등 quantitative preclinical differentiation을 제시하므로 1점보다는 높습니다.
- 그러나 competitor와의 **head-to-head quantitative comparison이 없고 human efficacy도 없으며**, KDS2010/VG-3927 등 later-stage oral neuroimmune approaches가 있어 3점은 부여하지 않았습니다.

### 4.3 MoA Validity
Score: **3**

Main line: **VTA-27은 proposed PRX-mimetic MoA를 직접 시험하는 H2O2 catalytic activity와 pSTAT3 functional readout을 보유하며, downstream in-vivo phenotype까지 연결됩니다.**

What was checked:
- Journal publication
- Mechanistic consistency
- Functional readout
- Disease linkage
- Safety-relevant signal

Evidence trail:
- Deck p.20: intracellular H2O2 reduction EC50 약 **15.25 nM**.
- 같은 slide에서 Aβ-stimulated primary astrocyte pSTAT3 inhibition IC50 **131.1 nM**으로 표시.
- Candidate Profile p.27은 같은 endpoint를 **IC50 162 nM**으로 기재하여 내부 숫자 discrepancy가 있습니다.
- p.17: PRX1 depletion은 STAT3 oligomerization 감소, phosphorylation 및 inflammatory cytokine 증가와 연계되며 PRX1-STAT3 H2O2-dependent interaction을 제시합니다.
- p.21-23: VTA-27 2 mg/kg에서 5xFAD neuropathology 및 세 가지 cognition-related assays 개선.
- Independent Reichenbach et al. 연구는 STAT3-mediated astrogliosis의 AD pathology/cognition relevance를 직접 실험적으로 뒷받침합니다. [4]
- Chun et al. 연구는 reactive astrocyte-derived H2O2가 AD-like pathology에 기여한다는 독립 biological rationale을 제공합니다. [5]

Investigation note:
- Score 3 rule의 “assessed-asset direct functional validation”을 충족합니다.
- 단, **human target engagement 또는 human PRX/STAT3 PD validation은 아직 없으므로 translational risk는 높습니다.**

### 4.4 Platform Attractiveness
Score: **1**

Main line: **Redoxizyme는 재사용 가능한 PRX-mimetic technical platform으로 확인되지만, 플랫폼 자체의 quantitative superiority가 comparator 대비 검증되지는 않았습니다.**

What was checked:
- Platform reuse across candidates
- PRX-mimetic common technical principle
- Quantitative differentiation
- Appropriate comparator
- Platform-derived clinical progression

Evidence trail:
- 공식 platform page는 Redoxizyme가 PRX의 H2O2 regulation을 재현하는 small-molecule Prx nanozymes를 설계한다고 설명합니다. [2]
- 회사 release는 PRX activity-mimicking compound library에 대한 exclusive IP rights를 주장합니다. [3]
- VTA-27에는 nanomolar H2O2/pSTAT3 activity가 존재합니다. [F1]
- 회사의 다른 Redoxizyme-derived program인 VTB-10은 2026 FIH dosing까지 진입했습니다. [1]

Investigation note:
- **Score 2에는 appropriate comparator 대비 quantitative technical advantage가 필요**합니다.
- 현재 확인된 데이터는 VTA-27 자체 activity를 보여줄 뿐, 다른 redox modulator/benchmark 대비 플랫폼 superiority를 정량 검증하지 않습니다.
- VTB-10 FPD alone은 score 2 prerequisite를 대체하지 않으므로 1점입니다.

Platform vs Data Maturity separation:
- VTA-27의 efficacy/safety package는 Data Maturity에 반영했습니다.
- Redoxizyme의 cross-asset reuse 및 comparative technical advantage만 Platform에서 평가했습니다.
- 동일 endpoint를 두 criterion의 같은 의미로 double-count하지 않았습니다.

### 4.5 Expansion Potential
Score: **0**

Main line: **PD expansion은 company deck에서 가능성으로만 언급되며 현재 VTA-27-specific additional-indication program으로 확인되지 않습니다.**

What was checked:
- Expansion beyond AD
- VTA-27-specific PD data
- Separate pipeline listing
- Active preclinical/IND-enabling/clinical program

Evidence trail:
- Aug-2026 pipeline slide p.32: VTA-27 AD row의 note에 “Potential expansion to PD”.
- Company materials은 PRX dysfunction을 broader neurological disease와 연결하지만 VTA-27 자체의 PD efficacy/PD/biomarker dataset은 확인되지 않았습니다. [3]

Investigation note:
- rubric상 **future/potential opportunity 문구는 confirmed additional indication으로 계산하지 않습니다.**
- VTA-27 PD model data 또는 별도 active pipeline listing이 확인되면 재평가할 수 있습니다.

### 4.6 Data Maturity
Score: **3**

Main line: **VTA-27은 stage-appropriate한 in-vitro mechanism, in-vivo pathology/cognition, GLP safety/PK/CMC의 complementary domains를 보유해 IND-enabling progression을 뒷받침합니다.**

What was checked:
- In vitro data
- In vivo data
- Quantitative results
- Reproducibility
- GLP tox
- PK/ADME
- CMC
- Human data

Evidence trail:
- **In vitro:** H2O2 EC50 ~15.25 nM; Aβ-induced pSTAT3 IC50 ~131.1/162 nM. [F1] pp.20,27
- **In vivo pathology:** 5xFAD, 0.5/2 mg/kg i.p., twice weekly, 8 weeks; 2 mg/kg에서 GFAP 감소, NeuN preservation, Aβ plaque burden 감소. [F1] p.21
- **Behavior:** Y-maze, NOR, MWM에서 2 mg/kg group의 일관된 improvement. [F1] p.23
- **Safety:** rat/dog 28-day repeat-dose GLP toxicology completed; Ames negative; safety pharmacology clear; hERG IC50 >200 µM. [F1] p.27
- **CMC:** purity >99%, total impurities <0.5%; DS GMP production underway, DP manufacturing planned. [F1] p.27
- **Development:** PK/ADME, toxicokinetics, DS/DP, PK modeling, IB development 등 IND-directed work ongoing. [F1] pp.28-29

Investigation note:
- 적어도 두 개의 서로 다른 development question을 다루는 quantitative domains가 존재하여 3점입니다.
- 가장 큰 gap은 **human data 부재**와 주요 efficacy dataset이 i.p. dosing이라는 점입니다.
- Deck은 blinded external CRO에서 **oral dosing 5xFAD efficacy confirmation**을 추가 수행하는 것으로 제시하며, 이는 아직 completed evidence로 계산하지 않았습니다.

- The 0.40 diagnosis input is deliberately labeled a **proxy**, because the cited detection study combines MCI/dementia rather than giving an AD-specific diagnosis rate.
- USD 16,016 is a **screening net-price proxy**, not a disclosed payer net price.
- No efficacy/safety premium was embedded in benchmark price; VTA-27 differentiation is reflected only through Pricing Power Adjustment.
- No Expansion Capacity Adjustment or sensitivity analysis was used.

Investigation note:
- Marketability는 rNPV가 아니라 obtainable peak sales 기준입니다.

## 6) Final Take

One-line summary:

**VTA-27은 differentiated PRX-mimetic/astrocyte-targeting concept, direct nanomolar functional assays, cognition/pathology efficacy 및 비교적 진전된 IND-enabling package를 갖춘 AD program이지만, 투자/BD 관점의 핵심 inflection point는 clinically relevant oral exposure에서 동일 biology가 재현되고 human PRX/STAT3 PD로 translate되는지 여부입니다.**

Recommendation:
- **Shortlist**

Most important diligence question:

**Clinically relevant oral exposure에서 VTA-27이 5xFAD의 pSTAT3/reactive-astrocyte suppression, neuronal preservation 및 cognitive benefit을 재현하며, 이후 human study에서 측정 가능한 PRX/STAT3-linked PD biomarker를 보여줄 수 있는가?**
