data_maturity.evidence_basis: Aug-2026 VTA-27 deck with quantitative assays, 5xFAD efficacy, GLP tox, hERG, CMC, and development status.
data_maturity.main_line_summary: Broad asset-specific preclinical package supports IND-enabling progression.
data_maturity.why_not_higher: 3 is the maximum; no VTA-27 human data are available.
data_maturity.investigation_note: The score is driven only by VTA-27 data, not by VTB-10 or platform-wide evidence.
uncertain_points: Key efficacy studies used i.p. dosing; independent blinded oral 5xFAD confirmation is still ongoing/planned in the deck.

competitive_landscape.evidence_type_reason: VTA-27 has quantitative preclinical differentiation in a realistic AD entry space, but no head-to-head study or clinical differentiation versus current/advanced competitors.
competitive_landscape.evidence_basis: Asset-specific pathology/cognition data plus registry and regulatory review of anti-amyloid and neuroinflammation competitors.
competitive_landscape.main_line_summary: Direct PRX-mimetic competition appears sparse, but AD/neuroinflammation competition is substantial.
competitive_landscape.why_not_higher: No asset-specific head-to-head comparison or clinical leading-position evidence; multiple later-stage alternatives exist.
competitive_landscape.investigation_note: Search covered VTA-27 aliases, PRX/STAT3/astrocyte biology, approved AD drugs, Phase 2 neuroinflammation programs, and TREM2 competitors.
uncertain_points: No public same-PRX-mimetic AD competitor was verified; absence of a found competitor is not treated as proof of exclusivity.

platform_attractiveness.evidence_type_reason: Redoxizyme is a reusable PRX-mimetic platform and VTA-27 has quantitative technical activity, but no appropriate comparator demonstrates platform-level quantitative advantage.
platform_attractiveness.evidence_basis: Official Redoxizyme description, company PRX-mimetic IP claim, and VTA-27 technical data.
platform_attractiveness.main_line_summary: Reusable PRX-mimetic platform is credible, but comparative platform advantage is not yet demonstrated.
platform_attractiveness.why_not_higher: Score 2 requires quantitative advantage versus an appropriate comparator; no such platform-level comparison was verified.
platform_attractiveness.investigation_note: Company-level FIH progress of VTB-10 does not by itself satisfy the score-2 comparator requirement.
uncertain_points: Cross-asset quantitative comparability of Redoxizyme-derived compounds is not publicly established.

expansion_potential.evidence_type_reason: The deck mentions only 'potential expansion to PD'; no confirmed active VTA-27 PD program or asset-specific PD data was found.
expansion_potential.evidence_basis: Aug-2026 deck and company platform rationale.
expansion_potential.main_line_summary: PD is only a potential future expansion, not a confirmed asset-specific program.
expansion_potential.why_not_higher: Score 1 requires a confirmed additional indication with biological rationale; future opportunity wording alone is excluded by the rubric.
expansion_potential.investigation_note: Platform-wide PRX relevance to PD was not counted as VTA-27 expansion.
uncertain_points: A dedicated VTA-27 PD study or pipeline listing could change this score.

marketability.evidence_type_reason: A transparent US-base screening calculation uses independent epidemiology and current anti-amyloid price benchmarks; no asset-specific external peak-sales forecast was found.
marketability.evidence_basis: 7.2M US AD prevalence, diagnosis proxy, Eisai 2026 price list, and explicit analyst penetration/competition/pricing assumptions.
marketability.main_line_summary: Calculated global obtainable peak sales are about 1,220.50 million USD.
marketability.why_not_higher: The result is below 2,000 million USD and relies on screening assumptions rather than clinical VTA-27 uptake evidence.
marketability.investigation_note: Assessment method=calculation; score basis=calculation; chronic prevalence model; no sensitivity analysis.
uncertain_points: Diagnosis rate is a proxy from MCI/dementia detection, not an AD-specific rate.
Benchmark net price uses a 20% gross-to-net screening discount from the 2026 LEQEMBI IQLIK list price.

cross_checked_facts: VTA-27 identity and AD indication are confirmed by both the official VASTHERA pipeline page and Aug-2026 company deck.
PRX-mimetic/astrocyte-neuron mechanism is consistent across the official platform/news materials and the deck.
Independent literature supports STAT3-mediated reactive astrogliosis and astrocyte-derived H2O2 as AD-relevant biology.
Current company location in Seoul, Republic of Korea is consistent across official web pages and the deck.

month-old 5xFAD mice

• Amyloid-β deposition decreased in both the hippocampus and cortex

• RAGE expression remained comparable to wild-type levels
• Astrocyte activation reduced, as indicated by decreased GFAP
• Microglial activation also suppressed by CU71 treatment

source_report.raw_markdown:
# Curacle Pipeline Scout Report: **CU71**

본 보고서는 업로드된 평가 지침에 따라 **GPT instruction 2 — Full Scout v3.4 (schema v3.2)** 기준으로 attachment review, current public-source verification, competitor search, 7개 기준 scoring 및 evidence tracking을 수행했습니다.

**중요:** CU71은 현재 Curacle 공식 pipeline에서 **AD / PO / “Preclinical studies in progress”**로 확인되어 dashboard stage는 **Preclinical unspecified**로 정규화합니다. 다만 업로드된 과거 deck의 “2026 IND planned”는 달성된 milestone으로 간주할 수 없으며, 2026년 5월 Curacle 주주서한은 “CU71 후보물질들 가운데 가장 적합한 물질을 선별하기 위한 최적화 연구”가 진행 중이라고 밝히고 있습니다. 따라서 **active program과 preclinical stage는 확인되지만, 최종 optimized lead의 identity와 기존 5xFAD 데이터의 molecule continuity는 핵심 diligence item**입니다.

## 1) Company Profile

| Field | Content | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Company | Curacle Co., Ltd. | Curacle / KIND-KRX |
| Legal name / aliases | 주식회사 큐라클 / curacle co.,ltd. | 2026 Q1 regulatory filing |
| Location (company HQ) | **Seoul, Republic of Korea** | Official pipeline page 및 KRX filing에 서울 서초구 본점 확인 |
| Headquarters | 23-1, Hyoryeong-ro, Seocho-gu, Seoul | Official company site |
| Website | https://curacle.com/ | Official company site |
| Company type / stage | Public biotechnology company; KOSDAQ-listed since July 2021 | KRX filing |
| Focus areas | Microvascular/endothelial dysfunction 기반 난치성 혈관·대사 및 관련 질환 치료제 개발 | Official company/platform; regulatory filing |
| Platform summary | **SOLVADYS®**: human endothelial-cell multi-phenotypic screening → in vivo efficacy → pathomechanistic validation을 연결하는 proprietary oral small-molecule platform | Official platform page |
| Financing / partnership signals | 상장사. CU71은 public filing에서 preclinical 단계 중 기술이전 추진 계획이 기재되어 있으나, 이번 조사에서 CU71-specific licensing partner는 확인하지 못함 | KRX filing |
| Lead pipeline summary | SOLVADYS-derived Rivasterat/CU06는 DME Phase 2a 완료; CU71은 현재 AD preclinical program | Official platform/pipeline |

업로드된 company deck은 Curacle이 R&D를 “vascular endothelial dysfunction” 중심으로 정의하며 CU71을 “First-in-Class / Next-Generation Endothelial Dysfunction Blocker”로 분류했고 당시 상태를 “Preclinical studies in progress”로 표시했습니다.

## 2) Pipeline Snapshot

| Field | Content | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Company | Curacle Co., Ltd. | Official pipeline / KRX |
| Lead asset | CU71 | Official CU71 page |
| Target | **BBB endothelial dysfunction phenotype; exact molecular binding target undisclosed** | Curacle describes BBB stabilization, but no specific molecular target is publicly identified |
| Theme / Cluster | **Theme: Neuroimmune / Cluster: 손상/질환 면역조절** | Internal SKBP mapping based on confirmed BBB dysfunction + neuroinflammation/glial modulation MoA |
| MoA | Oral BBB/neurovascular stabilizer: endothelial barrier restoration, RAGE normalization, reduced astrocyte/microglial activation and downstream Aβ burden | Company data and official disclosures |
| Modality / Platform | **Small molecule / oral / SOLVADYS®-derived** | KRX identifies CU71 as oral chemically synthesized drug; SOLVADYS is an oral small-molecule platform |
| Indication | **Alzheimer's disease** | Current official CU71 page and pipeline overview |
| Pipeline Stage | **Preclinical unspecified** | Current official pipeline explicitly states “Preclinical studies in progress” |
| Key data | 5xFAD: cognition, Aβ deposition, BBB tight-junction markers, RAGE, GFAP and Iba1 | Uploaded company deck, pp.13–21 |

**Stage note:** 현재 공식 pipeline의 “Preclinical studies in progress”가 가장 직접적인 stage disclosure입니다. 한편 2026년 5월 주주서한은 여러 CU71 candidates 가운데 최적 물질을 선별하기 위한 optimization을 언급합니다. 이는 program termination의 증거는 아니지만, **최종 lead candidate가 아직 완전히 고정되지 않았을 가능성**을 시사합니다.

## 3) Scorecard Summary

| Criterion | Score (maximum 3 points each) | One-line judgment | Evidence used |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Target Relevance | **3점** | AD가 SKBP interest indication이며 BBB/neuroinflammation MoA가 AD biology와 직접 연결 | CU71 data + human BBB literature |
| Competitive Landscape | **2점** | 전체 AD 경쟁은 매우 높지만 exact BBB-stabilizer clinical competition은 제한적; 차별화는 아직 preclinical | 2026 AD pipeline + competitor registries + donepezil comparator data |
| MoA Validity | **3점** | BBB integrity → glial inflammation → Aβ/cognition으로 연결되는 asset-specific functional validation 확보 | 5xFAD quantitative data |
| Platform Attractiveness | **1점** | SOLVADYS는 reusable이지만 외부 benchmark 대비 quantitative platform advantage는 부족 | SOLVADYS page + CU71/CU06 assays |
| Expansion Potential | **1점** | CSVD/vascular dementia rationale은 있으나 active second-indication program/data 미확인 | Curacle official page |
| Data Maturity | **3점** | cognition + pathology + BBB PD + neuroinflammation의 다중 quantitative preclinical domain | 5xFAD deck |
| Marketability | **2점** | calculation basis; assessed Global obtainable peak sales ≈ **1,058.6 million USD** | AD prevalence/diagnosis/price/competition |
| **Total** | **15점** | Maximum total: 21점 | |

**Hard Filter: PASS.** Total ≥14, Target Relevance=3, MoA Validity=3, Data Maturity=3이며 CU71 identity와 active preclinical program은 확인됩니다. Exact target, final optimized lead 및 clinical timing은 diligence gap이지만 현재 공개자료만으로 asset identity/stage/active status를 뒤집는 blocker는 아닙니다.

## 4) Criterion Detail Pages

### 4.1 Target Relevance
**Score: 3**

**Main line:** Alzheimer's disease라는 직접적인 SKBP interest indication에 더해, CU71의 BBB stabilization/neuroinflammation mechanism은 독립적인 human AD literature가 지지하는 disease biology에 연결됩니다.

What was checked:
- Target identity
- Disease/biology relevance
- SKBP Theme / Cluster fit
- General neurodegeneration / neuroinflammation relevance

Evidence trail:
- Curacle은 CU71을 oral “Next-generation Neurovascular Stabilizer”로 정의하며 BBB dysfunction과 neuroinflammation을 타깃으로 하는 AD candidate로 명시합니다.
- KRX filing 역시 CU71을 oral chemically synthesized new drug로 설명하며, 기능 저하된 BBB를 안정화하여 cognition/neuroprotection을 유도하는 MoA를 기재합니다.
- 업로드 deck에서는 BBB dysfunction과 neuroinflammation을 AD의 공통 pathological phenomenon으로 설명하고 있습니다.
- 독립적인 human-study systematic review는 AD에서 BBB damage가 endothelial/intercellular 구조 변화, transporter 변화 및 glial/immune activation과 연관되고, AD-specific brain regions에서 BBB dysfunction이 disease course 초기에 관찰된다고 정리했습니다.

Investigation note:
- **3점 기준 충족:** SKBP interest disease인 AD가 명시적으로 확인되고, confirmed MoA인 BBB stabilization/neuroinflammation modulation이 AD biology와 직접 연결됩니다.
- Theme은 disease name만으로 배정하지 않고 confirmed MoA에 근거하여 **Neuroimmune / 손상·질환 면역조절**로 mapping했습니다.
- Exact molecular target은 미공개이므로 “target-name validation”은 불가능합니다.
- 3점이 maximum score이며, 남은 gap은 human validation 및 molecular target disclosure입니다.

### 4.2 Competitive Landscape
**Score: 2**

**Main line:** 2026년 AD 전체 pipeline은 매우 crowded하지만, CU71과 동일하게 “oral BBB dysfunction stabilizer”를 핵심 therapeutic mechanism으로 하는 임상-stage direct competitor는 이번 검색에서 확인되지 않았습니다. 다만 경쟁우위 증거는 아직 animal-stage입니다.

2026 AD pipeline review는 **158 drugs / 192 trials**, 이 중 **36 Phase 3, 84 Phase 2, 45 Phase 1**을 집계했습니다. Mechanistic classification에서는 28개가 inflammation/immune, 단 3개가 vascular pathology로 분류되었습니다. 따라서 “AD 경쟁 자체가 낮다”는 해석은 부적절하지만, vascular/BBB mechanism 내에서는 상대적으로 좁은 entry space가 확인됩니다.

Competitor table:

| Competitor | Company | Modality | Target / MoA | Pipeline Stage | Why it matters | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fasudil | Helse Stavanger HF | Small molecule | ROCK inhibitor / vasodilator; cerebral vascular approach | Phase 2 | **Medium similarity**: AD + small molecule + vascular biology. BBB repair mechanism은 아님 | ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06362707 |
| Sirolimus | UT Health San Antonio | Small molecule | mTOR inhibitor; cerebral blood-flow / immunosuppressive biology | Phase 2, active not recruiting | **Medium similarity**: AD + oral small molecule + CADRO vascular category | ClinicalTrials.gov NCT04629495 |
| Nivisnebart (GSK4527226/AL101) | GSK / Alector | Antibody | Anti-sortilin; progranulin elevation / neuroimmune-neuroprotection | Phase 2 | **Medium similarity**: AD + non-amyloid neuroimmune biology; modality/target differ | GSK / ClinicalTrials.gov |
| Leqembi (lecanemab) | Eisai | Antibody | Anti-Aβ | Approved / marketed | **Low similarity** by rubric, but key DMT/price/clinical benchmark | FDA |
| Kisunla (donanemab) | Eli Lilly | Antibody | Anti-Aβ | Approved / marketed | **Low similarity**, but approved DMT and efficacy benchmark | FDA |
| Trontinemab | Roche | Antibody | Anti-Aβ bispecific + TfR Brainshuttle | Phase 3 | **Low similarity**: BBB transport technology is relevant, but therapeutic MoA is amyloid removal rather than BBB repair | Roche |

CU71 자체 비교에서는 5xFAD study에 donepezil comparator arm이 포함됐으며, Curacle의 summary는 CU71이 donepezil보다 greater cognitive improvement를 보였다고 기술합니다. MWM에서는 특히 CU71 10 mg/kg에서 final-day latency/distance 및 probe-test correct-quadrant time의 유의한 improvement가 보고됐습니다.

Investigation note:
- **2점:** 적절한 symptomatic comparator인 donepezil을 포함한 quantitative preclinical differentiation과 상대적으로 제한된 vascular entry space가 존재합니다.
- **3점 미부여:** (1) human comparative data 없음, (2) lecanemab/donanemab/trontinemab 또는 실제 future standard-of-care와의 quantitative comparison 없음, (3) “same-MoA competitor가 검색되지 않음” 자체는 3점 근거가 될 수 없음.
- Fasudil registry는 “Recruiting”으로 남아 있으나 registry last-update가 2024-10이고 estimated primary completion이 2025-10이므로 **current recruitment status는 stale 가능성**을 기록합니다.

### 4.3 MoA Validity
**Score: 3**

**Main line:** CU71은 단순 BBB hypothesis를 넘어, asset-specific 5xFAD에서 barrier junction, transporter, glial inflammation, amyloid pathology 및 cognitive function이 연쇄적으로 변화하는 functional validation을 보여줍니다.

What was checked:
- Journal publication / PMID / DOI
- Mechanistic consistency
- Functional readout
- Disease linkage
- Safety-relevant signal

Evidence trail:
- BBB tight-junction: CU71 treatment 후 **ZO-1 및 Claudin-5가 dose-dependent하게 증가**, 정상 mouse 수준으로 회복됐다고 보고됩니다.
- BBB transporter: RAGE expression이 5xFAD vehicle에서 증가했으나 CU71-treated groups에서는 normal group comparable level로 유지됐습니다.
- Neuroinflammation: GFAP 및 Iba1이 감소하여 astrocyte/microglial activation suppression을 보여줍니다.
- Pathology: hippocampus와 cortex에서 모든 CU71 dose group이 vehicle 대비 Aβ plaque deposition을 유의하게 감소시켰습니다.
- Cognition: NOR에서 dose-dependent improvement trend, MWM에서 CU71 10 mg/kg의 significant improvement가 보고됐습니다.
- Independent biology: human AD review는 BBB dysfunction, endothelial changes, carrier dysfunction 및 glial/immune activation이 AD에 존재함을 지지합니다. 다만 BBB dysfunction이 모든 AD에서 primary causal driver라고 확정된 것은 아닙니다.

Investigation note:
- **3점 기준 충족:** assessed asset에서 mechanism-linked functional/PD readouts가 직접 확인됩니다.
- 정확한 molecular target 또는 binding assay가 공개되지 않았지만, rubric상 score 3는 molecular-target disclosure 없이도 direct functional validation으로 충족 가능합니다.
- Maximum score이지만, human target engagement/PD와 primary molecular target identification은 중요한 translational gap입니다.

### 4.4 Platform Attractiveness
**Score: 1**

**Main line:** SOLVADYS는 실제로 복수 후보를 생성하고 임상까지 진입시킨 reusable technical system이지만, rubric상 2점을 요구하는 “appropriate external comparator 대비 quantitative technical advantage”는 확인하지 못했습니다.

What was checked:
- Is the platform real and reproducible?
- Is differentiation supported by data?
- Is the underlying technical system reusable across candidates/programs?

Evidence trail:
- Curacle은 SOLVADYS를 human endothelial-cell multi-phenotypic assays, in vivo efficacy testing, pathomechanistic validation의 3단계 platform으로 설명합니다.
- SOLVADYS-derived CU06/Rivasterat은 10개 이상 disease model에서 efficacy를 보였고 DME Phase 2a를 완료했다고 회사가 공개합니다.
- 업로드 deck p.28은 CU71-2021과 CU06-1004를 in vitro 비교하며 serum-starvation cell viability, VEGF-induced permeability, IL-1β-induced ICAM-1을 평가합니다. 두 물질 모두 activity를 보였고, cell-viability assay에서 CU71-2021이 동일 농도에서 더 높은 efficacy trend를 보였다고 회사가 기술합니다.

Investigation note:
- **1점:** reusable platform은 분명하지만 현재 공개 evidence는 platform rationale/track record 중심입니다.
- **2점 미부여:** CU71-vs-CU06는 같은 platform 내 internal comparison이고, reported “tended greater” result가 external appropriate comparator 대비 robust/statistically established technical superiority를 입증하지 않습니다.
- CU06의 clinical progression 자체는 platform productivity evidence이지만 score-2 technical-advantage rule을 대체하지 않습니다.
- Platform evidence와 CU71 Data Maturity는 별도로 scoring했습니다.

### 4.5 Expansion Potential
**Score: 1**

**Main line:** BBB dysfunction biology를 근거로 vascular dementia 및 cerebral small vessel disease 확장 rationale은 공식적으로 제시됐으나, CU71-specific active second-indication program은 확인되지 않았습니다.

What was checked:
- Expansion beyond main indication
- Asset-specific quantitative data in additional indications
- Confirmed asset-specific preclinical/IND-enabling/clinical programs

Evidence trail:
- Current CU71 page는 broader applicability로 **cerebral small vessel disease 및 vascular dementia**를 명시합니다.
- 과거 Curacle shareholder communication은 Parkinson's disease 등 다른 degenerative disorders까지 potential expansion을 언급한 적이 있지만, current confirmed development indication은 AD입니다.

Investigation note:
- **1점:** 추가 indication의 biological rationale이 공식적으로 존재합니다.
- **2점 미부여:** AD 이외 distinct indication에서 CU71-specific quantitative efficacy/PD data를 확인하지 못했습니다.
- **3점 미부여:** 두 개 이상의 active asset-specific expansion program도 확인되지 않았습니다.
- “potential”, “positioned for”, “검토”와 같은 표현은 active program으로 간주하지 않았습니다.

### 4.6 Data Maturity
**Score: 3**

**Main line:** CU71은 preclinical asset임에도 cognition, amyloid pathology, BBB integrity/transport 및 glial neuroinflammation이라는 서로 다른 개발 질문을 다루는 multiple quantitative domains를 확보했습니다.

What was checked:
- In vitro data
- In vivo data
- Quantitative result
- Reproducibility
- IND-enabling / GLP tox / PK/PD / CMC / human data availability

Evidence trail:
- Study design: male 5xFAD mice, 3 months old; CU71 5/10/20 mg/kg PO QD; n=12/group, NOR와 MWM 후 histology/Western analysis.
- **Cognition domain:** NOR dose-response trend 및 MWM significant improvement.
- **Disease-pathology domain:** hippocampus/cortex Aβ plaque 감소.
- **BBB PD domain:** ZO-1/Claudin-5 restoration 및 RAGE normalization.
- **Neuroinflammation domain:** GFAP 및 Iba1 감소.
- Current Curacle page는 preclinical evidence를 “reduced BBB leakage & neuroinflammation, improved memory, partial β-amyloid reduction”으로 요약하고 있습니다.

Investigation note:
- **3점:** 적어도 cognition과 BBB/pathology라는 독립적인 quantitative domains가 있으며, mechanism-linked progression package를 구성합니다.
- Maximum score이나 “preclinical score 3”가 임상 maturity를 의미하는 것은 아닙니다.
- 공개자료에서 CU71-specific plasma/brain exposure, dose-exposure relationship, formal PK/PD, GLP tox, CMC 또는 human data는 확인되지 않았습니다.
- 특히 과거 deck은 2026 IND와 GLP tox를 **계획**으로 제시했으나, 계획은 완료 evidence가 아니므로 maturity에 가산하지 않았습니다.
- 2026년 Curacle은 “CU71 후보물질들 가운데 가장 적합한 물질”을 고르는 optimization을 언급했습니다. 따라서 **현재 최종 lead와 2025 AAIC/5xFAD dataset compound의 동일성**을 확인해야 합니다.

### 4.7 Marketability
**Score: 2**

**Main line:** Internal screening calculation 기준 **Global Obtainable Peak Sales = 1,058.6 million USD**, 따라서 Marketability **2점**입니다.

**Assessment method:** calculation  
**Score basis type:** calculation  
**Calculation status:** performed  
**Assessed global peak sales:** **1,058.6 million USD**

이번 계산은 chronic AD therapy이므로 annual incidence가 아니라 **US prevalence base**를 사용했습니다. 2026 Alzheimer's Association은 미국 65세 이상 AD 환자를 약 **7.4 million**으로 추정합니다.

Diagnosis rate는 Alzheimer’s Association 자료에서 dementia 환자의 “as many as half”가 진단받지 않았다는 근거를 사용해 **50% diagnosed**로 screening 적용했습니다.

가격 benchmark는 ICER 2025 report의 **Leqembi annual net price best estimate = 26,491 USD/year**를 사용했습니다. 이는 CU71 예상가격이 아니라 현재 승인된 disease-modifying AD therapy의 screening benchmark입니다.

경쟁강도는 2026 AD pipeline의 158 drugs / 192 trials와 36 Phase 3 agents를 반영했습니다.

Worksheet:

| Step | Calculation | Evidence / assumption |
|---|---|---|
| A. US Patient Pool | 7,400,000 | 2026 US AD prevalence, age ≥65 |
| Diagnosis Rate | 0.50 | Source-grounded approximation: up to half may remain undiagnosed |
| Eligibility Rate | **0.50** | **Analyst assumption**: CU71 eventual clinical stage/label is undefined |
| Treatable Subgroup Rate | **0.60** | **Analyst assumption**: oral access broadens use, but biomarker/stage criteria unknown |
| **A. US TAP** | 7,400,000 × 0.50 × 0.50 × 0.60 = **1,110,000 patients** | Chronic prevalence approach |
| Benchmark Annualized Net Price | **26,491 USD/year** | ICER best-estimate Leqembi annual net price |
| Peak Penetration | **0.08** | **Analyst assumption**: very crowded AD development landscape |
| Treatment Duration Factor | **1.0** | Chronic annualized therapy; no evidence supporting another factor |
| **B. US Unrisked Peak Sales** | 1,110,000 × 26,491 × 0.08 × 1.0 = **2,352.4 million USD** | Calculation |
| Competition Haircut | **0.40** | **Analyst assumption**: approved anti-Aβ agents + large late-stage pipeline |
| Pricing Power Adjustment | **0.75** | **Analyst assumption**: oral convenience positive, but no human efficacy/safety evidence yet |
| **C. US Obtainable Peak Sales** | 2,352.4 × 0.40 × 0.75 = **705.7 million USD** | Calculation |
| Global multiplier | **1.5** | User-defined screening policy, applied once |
| **D. Global Obtainable Peak Sales** | 705.7 × 1.5 = **1,058.6 million USD** | Calculation |
| External Peak Sales Reference | **Not found** | No reliable CU71-specific external quantitative peak-sales forecast identified |
| Final score basis | **1,058.6 million USD → 2점** | ≥1,000 and <2,000 million USD |

Investigation note:
- 본 값은 **rNPV가 아니라 obtainable peak-sales screening estimate**입니다.
- CU71은 preclinical이므로 eligibility, penetration, future price, competition haircut에 불확실성이 큽니다.
- Expansion indication은 commercial formula에 추가하지 않았습니다.
- Anti-amyloid therapy와 비교한 oral convenience/monitoring advantage는 potential benefit이지만, 아직 human efficacy/safety가 없으므로 pricing adjustment를 premium이 아닌 **0.75 discount**로 적용했습니다.
- Sensitivity analysis는 수행하지 않았습니다.

## 5) Validation Notes

### Cross-checked facts
- **Asset identity:** current Curacle pipeline과 regulatory filing 모두 CU71을 active oral neurovascular/AD program으로 확인합니다.
- **Current stage:** official pipeline은 “Preclinical studies in progress”로 명시합니다.
- **MoA:** current company page와 KRX filing 모두 BBB stabilization / neuroinflammation을 일관되게 설명합니다.
- **Independent biology:** human systematic review에서도 BBB dysfunction이 AD-specific regions에서 early disease course에 나타날 수 있고 endothelial/glial pathology와 연결됨을 확인했습니다.
- **Platform:** CU71의 SOLVADYS origin은 current official materials에서 확인됩니다.

### Uncertain points
- **Exact molecular target:** 공개되지 않음.
- **Final molecule identity:** 2026년 5월 회사는 CU71 candidates 중 적합한 molecule을 고르는 optimization 연구를 언급함.
- **Historical-to-current data continuity:** 2025 5xFAD/AAIC efficacy package가 현재 최적화 중인 최종 lead와 동일 compound인지 공개자료만으로 확인 불가.
- **IND status:** uploaded deck의 “IND planned in 2026”는 계획이었으며, current search에서 CU71 IND filing/clearance를 확인하지 못함. 현재 official stage는 preclinical.
- **Translational package:** human PK/PD, brain exposure, GLP tox, formal CMC/clinical formulation 결과 미확인.
- **Expansion:** vascular dementia/CSVD는 potential applicability이나 active asset-specific second-indication program 미확인.
- **Commercial forecast:** CU71-specific independent peak-sales forecast 미확인.

### Search log
- Official company page: checked
- Pipeline page: checked, including CU71-specific and overview pages
- Platform page: checked
- Publications: searched for BBB/AD independent validation and CU71-specific publication
- Regulatory / trial registry: KRX/KIND, FDA, ClinicalTrials.gov checked
- Competitor sources: 2026 AD development review, FDA, ClinicalTrials.gov, GSK and Roche checked
- Market / epidemiology sources: Alzheimer's Association and ICER checked
- Financing / partnership sources: current Curacle disclosures checked; no CU71-specific partner identified

## 6) Final Take

**One-line summary:** CU71은 **oral BBB stabilizer라는 분명한 strategic differentiation, AD 직접 relevance, 그리고 unusually broad한 preclinical cognition/BBB/neuroinflammation dataset**을 갖고 있어 관심도가 높지만, final lead identity와 molecular target, PK/brain exposure 및 IND-enabling package가 아직 공개적으로 연결되지 않은 것이 핵심 risk입니다.

**Recommendation: Shortlist**

Hard-filter 관점에서는 **PASS**입니다. 다만 다음 diligence 단계에서는 “좋은 5xFAD program”을 평가하는 수준에서 멈추지 말고, **현재 licensing 대상이 될 exact molecule이 어떤 compound인지**와 그 compound에 기존 efficacy data와 safety/PK package가 실제로 귀속되는지를 확인해야 합니다.

**Most important diligence question:**

현재 최적화 중인 **final CU71 lead가 2025 AAIC/5xFAD dataset을 생성한 molecule과 동일한가?** 동일하다면 그 exact molecule에 대해 **oral PK, brain exposure, exposure-response/PK-PD, off-target/selectivity, GLP tox, clinical formulation/CMC 및 IND-enabling timeline**이 어느 수준까지 완료되어 있는가?

# 1ST Biotherapeutics Pipeline Scout Report: **1ST-104**

본 보고서는 GPT instruction 2 — Full Scout v3.4 (schema v3.2)에 따라 attachment review, public-source verification, competitor search 및 7개 criterion scoring을 수행했으며, auditability를 위해 확인한 URL을 포함합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

**중요: 1ST-104는 공식 pipeline과 제공자료에서 Parkinson's disease용 LRRK2/c-Abl dual inhibitor 프로그램으로 확인되고 active lead-optimization program으로 판단되나, 총점 12/21로 REVIEW / Watch입니다. Preclinical target/PK profile은 흥미롭지만 candidate가 아직 공식 nomination되지 않았고, in vivo efficacy·1ST-104 자체 반복독성·human data가 없으며, 최근 LRRK2 및 c-Abl 임상 실패 사례와 시장성 산정 불확실성이 남아 있습니다.**

---

## 1) Company Profile

| Field | Content | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Company | 1ST Biotherapeutics, Inc. | [1], [3] |
| Legal name / aliases | 1ST Biotherapeutics, Inc. / 1STBIO / 주식회사 퍼스트바이오테라퓨틱스 | [3] |
| Country | Republic of Korea | [3] |
| Headquarters | Yongin-si, Gyeonggi-do, Republic of Korea | [3] |
| Website | https://www.1stbio.com/ | [3] |
| Company type / stage | Private, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company | [2], [3] |
| Focus areas | Neurodegenerative diseases, oncology, rare diseases | [2] |
| Platform summary | 1ST-501 AI Drug Discovery Engine을 보유하며, 1ST-104 자료에서는 AI-driven in-house discovery를 활용해 671개 이상의 compound를 합성하고 multiple lead series를 도출했다고 설명. 다만 platform 자체의 quantitative superiority versus conventional discovery는 제시되지 않음. | [1], attachment |
| Financing / partnership signals | 2026-01 Series D 317억원 조달, 누적 투자금 약 1,080억원. MJFF LITE consortium 참여를 통한 LRRK2 연구 협력도 확인됨. | [2], [4] |
| Lead pipeline summary | Oncology 및 neurodegeneration에서 clinical/preclinical pipeline을 운영. 1ST-104는 공식 pipeline상 LRRK2/c-Abl → Parkinson's disease program으로 등재됨. | [1] |

1STBIO 공식 홈페이지는 Yongin 소재와 company identity를 확인하며, 공식 pipeline에는 1ST-104가 LRRK2/c-Abl을 표적하는 Parkinson's disease program으로 현재 등재되어 있습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1} 2026년 1월 회사는 317억원 Series D 및 누적 약 1,080억원의 투자 유치를 발표했습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

Attachment에서는 671 compounds를 합성하고 multiple lead series가 lead optimization 단계에서 진행되고 있다고 명시합니다. :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}

---

## 2) Pipeline Snapshot

| Field | Content | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Company | 1ST Biotherapeutics, Inc. | [1], [3] |
| Lead asset | 1ST-104; representative optimized compounds include FB-3538A and FB-4853A. Final development candidate is not yet confirmed in reviewed evidence. | Attachment |
| Target | LRRK2 / c-Abl | [1], attachment |
| Theme / Cluster | **Theme: Neuroimmune / Cluster: Cytokine 신경조절** | Asset-specific iPSC-derived microglia target/ cytokine experiments + LRRK2 biology; internal SKBP mapping |
| MoA | Brain-penetrant dual LRRK2/c-Abl kinase inhibition. Lead series suppresses pRab10 and pCrkL while relatively preserving LRRK2 pS935, supporting a Type II-like LRRK2 pharmacology. Type II binding is structurally confirmed for c-Abl by co-crystal; LRRK2 structural confirmation was still planned. | Attachment, [5]-[8] |
| Modality / Platform | Small molecule | [1], attachment |
| Indication | Parkinson's disease | [1] |
| Stage | **Lead Optimization**. Official public pipeline uses broader “Discovery” labeling; the March 2026 attachment specifically states active lead optimization. Candidate nomination in 3Q 2026 was a plan, not a completed milestone. | [1], attachment |
| Key data | FB-4853A: LRRK2 biochemical IC50 11.12 nM; c-Abl IC50 0.93 nM; stimulated pRab10 IC50 12.41 nM; unstimulated pRab10 IC50 44.73 nM; pS935 IC50 >5,000 nM. Mouse PO F 62.08%, Kp,brain 0.91, Kp,uu,brain 0.31. hERG IC50 8.75 μM is a liability requiring follow-up. | Attachment |

공식 pipeline에서 1ST-104의 target/indication은 LRRK2/c-Abl 및 Parkinson's disease로 명확히 확인됩니다. :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4} 제공자료에서는 candidate selection을 향한 lead optimization이 진행 중이며 candidate nomination은 3Q 2026, Phase I initiation은 3Q 2027의 **계획**으로 표시되어 있어 이를 완료된 milestone으로 취급하지 않았습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:5]{index=5}

대표 compound FB-4853A는 LRRK2 11.12 nM 및 c-Abl 0.93 nM biochemical potency와 12.41 nM stimulated pRab10 potency를 보였습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:6]{index=6} :contentReference[oaicite:7]{index=7} Unstimulated A549 assay에서는 pRab10 IC50 44.73 nM인 반면 pS935 IC50가 >5,000 nM으로 나타나 Type II-like profile을 지지했습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:8]{index=8} :contentReference[oaicite:9]{index=9}

Mouse PK에서 FB-4853A는 5 mg/kg PO 기준 F 62.08%, Kp,brain 0.91, Kp,uu,brain 0.31을 보였습니다. :contentReference[oaicite:10]{index=10} 반면 hERG IC50는 8.75 μM으로, 자료 내 자체 기준상 10 μM 미만에 해당하여 development candidate 선정 시 exposure margin 확인이 중요한 safety diligence item입니다. :contentReference[oaicite:11]{index=11}

---

## 3) Scorecard Summary

| Criterion | Score (maximum 3 points each) | One-line judgment | Evidence used |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Target Relevance | **3점** | PD는 SKBP interest indication이며 LRRK2는 human genetics로 직접 연결되고, 1ST-104는 LRRK2/c-Abl을 실제 pharmacology로 조절함. | [1], [5]-[7], attachment |
| Competitive Landscape | **2점** | Type II-like/pS935-preserving profile이라는 quantitative differentiation은 있으나 NEU-411, BIIB122, BT-267 등 clinical LRRK2 competitors가 앞서 있으며 LUMA 및 c-Abl clinical failures가 존재. | [9]-[17], attachment |
| MoA Validity | **3점** | Asset-specific biochemical potency, pRab10/pCrkL cellular PD, pS935 conformational profile 및 c-Abl co-crystal로 직접 기능 검증. | Attachment, [7], [8] |
| Platform Attractiveness | **1점** | AI discovery platform과 반복 가능한 chemistry workflow는 확인되나 platform-vs-comparator quantitative advantage는 없음. | [1], attachment |
| Expansion Potential | **0점** | 1ST-104 자체의 PD 외 추가 active indication/program은 확인되지 않음. | [1], attachment |
| Data Maturity | **3점** | Biochemical/cellular pharmacology + selectivity/ADME/brain PK + microglia data 등 복수 quantitative domain이 존재. | Attachment |
| Marketability | **0점** | Asset-specific forecast가 없고, broad PD vs biomarker-selected PD label과 적절한 DMT price benchmark가 확정되지 않아 신뢰 가능한 A/B/C/D 계산을 수행하지 않음. | [10], [18] |
| **Total** | **12점** | Maximum total: 21점 → **REVIEW** | |

---

## 4) Criterion Detail Pages

### 4.1 Target Relevance
Score: **3점**

Main line: **Parkinson's disease는 SKBP의 핵심 interest indication이며, LRRK2는 human genetic causality가 가장 강한 PD target 중 하나이고 1ST-104는 LRRK2와 c-Abl을 동시에 실제 pharmacology로 조절합니다.**

### 4.2 Competitive Landscape
Score: **2점**

Main line: **1ST-104의 pS935-preserving Type II-like profile은 기존 Type I LRRK2 inhibition과 차별화 가능성이 있으나, clinical-stage LRRK2 경쟁이 이미 상당히 진행되었고 LRRK2 및 c-Abl monotherapy의 최근 efficacy failures가 진입장벽을 높였습니다.**

What was checked:
- Same disease competitors
- Same target competitors
- Same or similar MoA competitors
- Front runner count
- Approved / Phase 3 / clinical / preclinical status
- ClinicalTrials.gov, official company pipelines, recent primary clinical publications
- Type II LRRK2 competitors

Competitor table:

| Competitor | Company | Modality | Target / MoA | Stage | Why it matters | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NEU-411 | Neuron23 | Small molecule | Selective LRRK2 inhibitor | Phase 2, recruiting | Most advanced active precision-LRRK2 competitor; genotype-selected LRRK2-driven early PD | [9] |
| BIIB122 / DNL151 | Denali / Biogen | Small molecule | LRRK2 inhibitor | Phase 2a BEACON active in LRRK2-PD; idiopathic PD program discontinued | Direct target/modality comparator; Phase 2b LUMA failed primary/secondary endpoints in idiopathic PD | [10], [19] |
| BT-267 | Brenig Therapeutics | Small molecule | Brain-penetrant selective LRRK2 inhibitor | Phase 1 | Direct oral small-molecule LRRK2 competitor with CNS/selectivity positioning | [11] |
| FinsnoBio Type II LRRK2 program | FinsnoBio | Small molecule | Type II / G2019S-focused LRRK2 inhibition | Preclinical/IND-directed; exact asset stage undisclosed | Particularly relevant to 1ST-104's proposed Type II differentiation | [14] |
| ARV-102 | Arvinas | PROTAC | LRRK2 degradation | Phase 1 PD data | Different modality but clinically demonstrated CNS LRRK2 modulation; >50% CSF degradation reported | [12] |
| BIIB094 | Ionis/Biogen | Antisense oligonucleotide | LRRK2 lowering | Phase 1 completed | Clinical human validation of an alternative LRRK2-modulating modality | [13] |
| Vodobatinib | SPARC | Small molecule | c-Abl inhibitor | Phase 2 completed; negative | Shares c-Abl component of 1ST-104; trial did not show clinical benefit and had tolerability/dropout issues | [17] |

NEU-411 is currently in a randomized Phase 2 trial in genetically selected LRRK2-driven early PD. :contentReference[oaicite:16]{index=16} BIIB122's Phase 2b LUMA study in broader early PD failed its primary and secondary efficacy endpoints in May 2026; development in idiopathic PD was discontinued, although the LRRK2-variant BEACON Phase 2a remains active. :contentReference[oaicite:17]{index=17}

Additional clinical competition includes Brenig's BT-267 Phase 1 LRRK2 inhibitor and Arvinas' ARV-102, which reported ≥50% LRRK2 reduction in CSF in Phase 1 PD patients. :contentReference[oaicite:18]{index=18} FinsnoBio is independently developing Type II LRRK2 inhibitors, making the "Type II" concept itself non-exclusive competitively. :contentReference[oaicite:19]{index=19}

For c-Abl, the 2026 PROSEEK Phase 2 publication reported that vodobatinib did not demonstrate clinical benefit over placebo; this is relevant because c-Abl is the second pharmacologic component of 1ST-104. :contentReference[oaicite:20]{index=20}

Asset-specific differentiation:
- Internal DNL151 comparison showed DNL151 pRab10 IC50 46.14 nM and pS935 IC50 66.92 nM, whereas later 1ST-104 compound FB-4853A showed pRab10 IC50 44.73 nM with pS935 IC50 >5,000 nM. This supports substantially greater pS935 preservation at similar cellular pRab10 potency, consistent with Type II-like differentiation. :contentReference[oaicite:21]{index=21} :contentReference[oaicite:22]{index=22}
- However, this is company-generated preclinical comparison, not externally reproduced or clinical head-to-head evidence.

Investigation note:
- **2점 rule:** asset-specific quantitative differentiation versus an appropriate comparator or a credible differentiated entry space.
- pRab10/pS935 data provide this threshold.
- **Not 3:** multiple high-similarity clinical competitors are ahead; Type II LRRK2 is not unique; no human data or independent head-to-head evidence exists, and both broad LRRK2 inhibition and c-Abl inhibition have recent negative Phase 2 efficacy precedents.

Uncertain points:
- **Development candidate:** FB-3538A and FB-4853A are representative optimized compounds, but no reviewed source confirms which compound has been formally nominated as the 1ST-104 development candidate.

final_insight.most_important_diligence_question: Can the nominated 1ST-104 candidate demonstrate in vivo efficacy and durable CNS target coverage with adequate hERG and lung safety margins, and what biomarker-defined Parkinson's population will be targeted after the BIIB122 LUMA and c-Abl Phase 2 failures?

- Market / epidemiology sources: market size was not used for scoring because no defensible peak-sales method was established.
- Financing / partnership sources: Astrogen-Cigalah MENA transaction. [10]

---

## 6) Final Take

One-line summary: **AST-001은 direct SK-channel functional validation, randomized clinical efficacy, PK/PD, 장기 안전성 및 Registration stage를 갖춘 성숙한 ASD core-symptom asset이지만, 현재 SKBP 6개 interest indication 밖이라는 단일 portfolio-fit hard blocker 때문에 FAIL입니다.**

Recommendation:
- **Deprioritize** under the current Full Scout rule.
- 단, 이는 scientific quality FAIL이 아니라 **indication-scope FAIL**입니다. ASD가 전략 관심영역으로 편입될 경우 가장 먼저 재평가할 만한 요소는 unpublished Phase 3 package입니다.

Most important diligence question:

**“SKBP가 indication hard filter를 예외 처리한다고 가정할 때, 공개되지 않은 Phase 3 전체 데이터와 MFDS 심사자료에서 Phase 2의 비교적 modest한 효과가 clinically meaningful하고 재현 가능하게 확인되며, ASD heterogeneity·고용량 투여·글로벌 규제/상업화 리스크를 상쇄할 정도인가?”**

드릴다운 검증 질문: (1) Phase 3 primary endpoint effect size와 multiplicity-adjusted p-value는 무엇인가? (2) 2–6세 vs older subgroup 효과가 재현되는가? (3) 체중별 고용량 L-serine의 장기 adherence와 GI burden은 실제 launch 환경에서 감당 가능한가? (4) SK-channel mechanism과 clinical response를 잇는 human biomarker가 있는가? (5) AST-001-GP가 current syrup의 dose/BBB 한계를 해결한다면, 최초 PAMPA·brain PK 데이터가 proposal의 2–5x expectation을 실제로 재현하는가?

특이한건 중국 푸싱제약과 판권 deal을 체결하긴 함.

MOA(public_source): MOA 3점: AR1001 자산특이 전임상 연구에서 PDE5 관련 target engagement와 downstream 기전 효과가 보고됩니다. pipeline_metadata.comment:
Genuv는 환자 뇌 내 신경줄기세포(neural stem cell)의 분화를 유도해 새로운 신경조직을 생성하고, 이를 통해 뇌 기능을 근본적으로 회복하는 새로운 접근법을 취한다.

동시에 신경계 항상성(homeostasis)을 회복·유지하는 것을 치료 핵심 개념으로 삼고 있다.

주력 파이프라인 SNR1611은 ALS(근위축성 측삭경화증)와 알츠하이머병 전임상 모델에서 중추신경계 기능 회복 효과를 입증했다.

특히 경구 투여가 가능한 약물로, 환자 편의성과 실제 치료 적용 가능성이 높다.

# SKBP Fast Triage Result

> Version statement: This result was researched and scored with GPT instruction 1 — Fast Triage v3.3. Full Scout v3.4 has not been run.

중요: 20개 입력 중 SELECT 7건, REJECT 11건, UNVERIFIED 2건입니다. SELECT는 1ST-103/NLY02, SNR1611, SRN-008, ISU203(중복 2행), AB-12 (IV)이며, inactive hard blocker·현재 activity 불명·정확한 asset identity 불명·또는 MOA/Data threshold 미달은 보수적으로 REJECT/UNVERIFIED 처리했습니다.

| # | Asset | Company | Target/MoA | Modality | Main indication | Stage | Country | TR | MOA | Data | Triage | Why | Source |
|---:|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | BEY4101A | BeyondBio | Unknown | Unknown | Alzheimer's disease | Discontinued / inactive | Republic of Korea | 2 | 0 | 0 | REJECT | Exact asset identity is supported, but it is listed as discontinued/inactive; lifecycle hard blocker. | BeyondBio current pipeline + Synapse |
| 2 | SJP1801 | Samjin Pharmaceutical | Unknown | Unknown | Parkinson's disease | Discontinued / inactive | Republic of Korea | 2 | 0 | 0 | REJECT | KRX disclosure reports failure to derive a candidate; inactive program. | Samjin KRX filing |
| 3 | S701 | Amyloid Solution | Aβ/APP; tau | Small molecule | Alzheimer's disease | Discontinued / inactive | Republic of Korea | 3 | 1 | 0 | REJECT | Canonicalized to AS-S701/AS-701; biologically relevant but current database status is terminated/inactive. | KHIDI + Synapse |
| 4 | M801 | Amyloid Solution | TLR2 | Antibody | Unknown | Unknown | Republic of Korea | 3 | 1 | 0 | REJECT | AS-M801 mechanism/AD-PD identity is supported, but current 2026 activity and stage are unresolved. | KHIDI + BioSpectator |
| 5 | AR1002 | AriBio | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | 0 | 0 | 0 | UNVERIFIED | Exact AR1002 could not be verified as an AriBio asset; do not substitute AR1001 without evidence. | Exact-name verification failed; related AriBio public program is AR1001 |
| 6 | 1ST-103 | 1ST Biotherapeutics | RIPK2 | Small molecule | Unknown | IND-enabling | Republic of Korea | 3 | 2 | 2 | SELECT | Current alias 1ST-103/NLY02 and 2026 IND-enabling status support Full Scout. | 1ST pipeline + D&D 2026 IR |
| 7 | CKD-513 | Chong Kun Dang | HDAC6 | Small molecule | Unknown | Preclinical unspecified | Republic of Korea | 1 | 1 | 0 | REJECT | Active HDAC6 neurological-disease program, but no specific SKBP interest indication or asset result was verified. | CKD current pipeline |
| 8 | SNR1611 | GENUV | MEK1/2 | Small molecule | Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis / motor neuron disease | Phase 1/2 | Republic of Korea | 2 | 2 | 1 | SELECT | Current Phase I/IIa ALS program plus asset-specific preclinical functional evidence meets threshold. | GENUV pipeline + platform |
| 9 | S301 | Amyloid Solution | TAU | Gene therapy | Alzheimer's disease | Hit Discovery | Republic of Korea | 3 | 1 | 0 | REJECT | Canonicalized to AS-301; active tau/AD discovery program but functional/data maturity is insufficient. | Synapse current AS-301 profile |
| 10 | YHC2133 | Yuhan | Unknown | Unknown | Alzheimer's disease | Hit Discovery | Republic of Korea | 2 | 1 | 0 | REJECT | Active discovery-stage CNS immunomodulation program; target and asset-specific data remain undisclosed. | Yuhan current pipeline + official report |
| 11 | intractable brain diseases therapy, Dong-AST | Dong-A ST | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | Republic of Korea | 0 | 0 | 0 | UNVERIFIED | The phrase maps to a research collaboration topic, not a specific named pipeline asset. | Dong-A ST collaboration report |
| 12 | LB-P4 | LISCure Biosciences | Unknown | Other | Unknown | Preclinical unspecified | Republic of Korea | 2 | 1 | 1 | REJECT | Active PD/AD microbiome program, but specific target and quantitative public data are insufficient. | LISCure current materials |
| 13 | SRN-008 | siRNAgen Therapeutics | BACE1; MAPT | RNA therapy | Alzheimer's disease | Preclinical unspecified | Republic of Korea | 3 | 3 | 1 | SELECT | Dual-target RNAi patent provides asset-specific mechanism-linked in-vivo evidence; current preclinical identity is supported. | Patent + current database |
| 14 | ISU203 | ISU ABXIS | ASM | Antibody | Alzheimer's disease | Preclinical unspecified | Republic of Korea | 3 | 3 | 2 | SELECT | Anti-ASM asset has direct preclinical neuroinflammation/plaque/cognition evidence and current pipeline support. | ISU ABXIS + peer-reviewed abstract + 2025 IR |
| 15 | ISU203 | Kyungpook National University | ASM | Antibody | Alzheimer's disease | Preclinical unspecified | Republic of Korea | 3 | 3 | 2 | SELECT | Duplicate/related row for the same joint ISU203 program; collaboration and functional evidence are supported. | ISU ABXIS + peer-reviewed abstract + 2025 IR |
| 16 | AB-12 (IV) | AUTOTAC Bio | Tau oligomers/aggregates | Other | Alzheimer's disease | Preclinical unspecified | Republic of Korea | 3 | 3 | 2 | SELECT | Active preclinical tau-degrader with asset-specific tau degradation and functional rescue in animal models. | Nature Biopharma Dealmakers + AdisInsight |
| 17 | Alzheimer’s disease vaccine | EuBiologics | Amyloid; tau antigens | Other | Alzheimer's disease | Preclinical unspecified | Republic of Korea | 3 | 1 | 1 | REJECT | Current AD vaccine program is active, but planned IND timing and qualitative primate updates do not establish Data ≥2. | EuBiologics + current database |
| 18 | NLY02 | 1ST Biotherapeutics | RIPK2 | Small molecule | Unknown | IND-enabling | Republic of Korea | 3 | 2 | 2 | SELECT | Officially the alias of 1ST-103; same active IND-enabling RIPK2 program and same triage outcome. | 1ST pipeline + D&D 2026 IR |
| 19 | NG201 | Neuracle Science | Unknown | Gene therapy | Pain | Preclinical unspecified | Republic of Korea | 2 | 0 | 0 | REJECT | Neuropathic-pain asset is linked to Neuracle Genetics, a Neuracle Science subsidiary; target/MoA and public data are insufficient. | Neuracle Science history + BIO-Europe agenda |
| 20 | MDH-014 | MD Healthcare | Unknown | Other | Unknown | IND filed/cleared | Republic of Korea | 2 | 1 | 1 | REJECT | Australian IND/Phase 1 clearance milestone is supported, but current 2026 activity/trial start and human results are unresolved. | MD Healthcare deck + Edaily |

## Notes
- BEY4101A, SJP1801, AS-S701/AS-701은 lifecycle hard blocker 때문에 관련성 점수가 높더라도 REJECT입니다. M801과 MDH-014는 exact identity/milestone은 확인되지만 **현재 2026 activity**가 확정되지 않아 REJECT입니다.
- 1ST-103와 NLY02는 공식적으로 같은 asset alias이며, ISU203 두 행도 같은 joint program의 duplicate/related input입니다. Dashboard join을 위해 `input.company_input`/`input.asset_input`은 원문 그대로 유지했습니다.
- AR1002는 AriBio의 AR1001로 자동 보정하지 않았고, Dong-A ST 항목도 특정 candidate code가 없어 UNVERIFIED로 유지했습니다.
- 드릴다운 질문 1: 1ST-103/NLY02의 `IND-enabling`은 2026 partner IR에 기반합니다. 실제 IND 제출/clearance가 이미 일어났는지 최신 규제/registry에서 다시 확인하면 SELECT 우선순위가 바뀔 수 있습니까?
- 드릴다운 질문 2: M801·MDH-014처럼 과거 개발 milestone은 있으나 현재 activity가 불명확한 자산을 REJECT로 두는 것이 맞는지, 혹은 내부 BD 정보로 `active_asset=true`를 보완할 근거가 있습니까?
- 드릴다운 질문 3: S701→AS-S701/AS-701, S301→AS-301, NG201→Neuracle Genetics처럼 code/company normalization이 들어간 행은 원본 database key와 실제 법적 owner를 다시 매칭해야 하지 않습니까?

pages_or_slides.text:
Company / 
Location 
CKRegeon / Korea 
Date / Venue 
2026.07.22 (수), SKBP 9F 중회의실1 14:00~15:00 
Delegates 
Partner: 최강열 CEO, 양지선 수석, 김범수 부장 
SKBP: 정영찬 수석, 서지영 책임, 주연주 선임, 이정태 책임 
Discussion 
⚫ 
Discussion History 
- Intro meeting 
⚫ 
간략 회사 소개 
- CXXC5-Dvl(PPI)를 target하는 regenerative medicine 기반 Biotech 
- 조직 재생(Wnt signaling) 연구를 기반으로 Alzheimer's disease를 포함
한 난치성 재생 질환 치료제 개발 
- Series A(18’): 약 60억원 투자 유치 
- Series B(21’): 약 135억원 투자 유치 
⚫ 
Agenda 
- CXXC5 biology 및 AD program 소개 
- CKR-334 / CKR-519 개발 현황 소개 
⚫ 
논의 내용 
✓ 
Target Biology 
- 
AD 환자 hippocampus에서 cytosolic CXXC5 증가 및 Wnt/β-
catenin signaling 저하 확인 
- 
5xFAD × CXXC5 KO mouse에서 AD phenotype이 소실되어 
genetic validation 확보 
- 
CXXC5-Dvl interaction을 차단하여 Wnt signaling을 회복시키는 
것이 핵심 MoA 
✓ 
CKR-334 (Proof-of-Concept) 
- 
5xFAD mouse에서 경구 투여 시 amyloid pathology 감소 및 
cognitive function 개선 확인  
- 
KO mouse 결과를 pharmacological inhibition으로 재현 
✓ 
CKR-519 (Next-generation candidate) 
- 
CKR-334의 낮은 solubility를 개선한 차세대 후보물질

- 
Solubility, permeability, oral bioavailability 및 물질특허 확보 
- 
10개월령 5xFAD mouse에서 16주 경구 투여 후 behavioral 
improvement 및 pathology 개선 확인 
- 
현재 GLP tox 이전 단계이며 IND 진입 준비 중 
✓ 
Safety / Selectivity 
- 
정상 조직에서는 cytosolic CXXC5가 증가하지 않아 정상 조직 
영향이 제한적 
- 
Normal mouse 및 CXXC5 KO mouse에서 종양 발생은 관찰되지 
않음 
- 
hERG, Ames 등 초기 안전성 시험은 완료되었으며 negative 결
과 확보 
✓ 
질의응답 
- 
CXXC5 증가 원인 및 Human validation 
→ Aging만으로는 증가가 제한적이며, Aging과 AD 
mutation이 함께 존재할 때 cytosolic CXXC5가 크게 증
가한다고 설명. Human hippocampus tissue(AD 4명, 정
상 4명)에서도 동일한 경향을 확인했다고 답변. 
- 
APOE biology 등 Human translation 가능성 
→ APOE model에서는 아직 검증하지 않았음을 인정. 다만 
Human tissue와 추가 disease model(MASH model)에서
도 동일한 결과를 확인하여 다양한 AD pathology에서
도 적용 가능할 것으로 기대한다고 설명. 
- 
BBB penetration, Brain-to-plasma ratio 및 ADMET 진행 현황 
→ BBB penetration 관련 정량 데이터(Brain-to-plasma 
ratio)는 아직 정리 중이라고 답변. hERG, Ames test 등 
초기 ADMET는 완료되었으며 negative 결과를 확보했
다고 설명. ADMET package는 후속 공유 예정. 
- 
Wnt signaling activation에 따른 Oncogenic risk 
→ CXXC5 KO mouse 및 정상 마우스에서 종양 발생은 관
찰되지 않았으며, 정상 조직에서는 cytosolic CXXC5가 
증가하지 않아 약물이 선택적으로 작용한다고 설명. 본 
기전은 Wnt를 과활성화하는 것이 아니라 억제된 Wnt 
signaling을 정상 수준으로 회복(restoration)시키는 접근

임을 강조. 
- 
Amyloid clearance mechanism 및 Tau efficacy 
→ Wnt/GSK3β pathway 조절을 통해 Aβ 생성 억제 및 감
소가 가능하다고 설명하였으나, 기존 amyloid 
aggregate가 제거되는 직접적인 clearance mechanism
은 아직 규명하지 못했다고 답변. Tau는 직접 평가하지 
않았으며 GSK3β 조절을 통해 개선 가능할 것으로 설
명. 
- 
Clinical biomarker(Target engagement) 전략 
→ CXXC5 자체는 조직 내(cytosolic)에서 확인해야 하므로 
임상 biomarker로 활용하기 어렵다고 설명. 대신 Wnt 
signaling 회복에 따라 증가하는 GLP-1을 target 
engagement biomarker 후보로 고려하고 있다고 답변. 
Next Step 
⚫ ADMET checklist 전달 예정 
⚫ List 검토 후 필요시 CDA 체결 
Takeaway 
⚫ Novel target(CXXC5)를 이용한 regenerative AD 접근으로 biology는 차별
화되어 있음 
⚫ 5xFAD 기반 genetic/pharmacological validation은 확보되었으나 human 
translation data는 제한적 
⚫ CKR-519는 CKR-334 대비 solubility 및 developability를 개선한 후보물질
이나 PK/BBB 및 ADMET package 추가 확인 필요

target_indication.rationale: The document explicitly discusses Alzheimer's disease (AD) as the target indication.

evidence.text: CXXC5 biology 및 AD program 소개

small_molecule.rationale: The document describes small molecule candidates (CKR-334, CKR-519) with oral administration and mentions solubility, permeability, oral bioavailability, and hERG/Ames tests, which are typical for small molecules.

evidence.text: CKR-334 (Proof-of-Concept) - 5xFAD mouse에서 경구 투여 시 amyloid pathology 감소 및 cognitive function 개선 확인
Solubility, permeability, oral bioavailability 및 물질특허 확보

ind_enabling.rationale: The document states the candidate is at a pre-IND-enabling stage: '현재 GLP tox 이전 단계이며 IND 진입 준비 중' (currently before GLP tox and preparing for IND entry). This is before IND-enabling.

evidence.text: 현재 GLP tox 이전 단계이며 IND 진입 준비 중

in_vivo_efficacy.rationale: The document explicitly states positive in vivo efficacy results: amyloid pathology reduction and cognitive function improvement in 5xFAD mice for CKR-334, and behavioral improvement and pathology improvement for CKR-519.

evidence.text: 5xFAD mouse에서 경구 투여 시 amyloid pathology 감소 및 cognitive function 개선 확인
10개월령 5xFAD mouse에서 16주 경구 투여 후 behavioral improvement 및 pathology 개선 확인

in_vitro_efficacy.rationale: The document mentions in vitro experiments (e.g., hERG, Ames) but does not state any positive efficacy or activity result from an in vitro assay. The mention of 'CXXC5-Dvl interaction을 차단하여 Wnt signaling을 회복시키는 것이 핵심 MoA' is a mechanism description, not an explicit positive result from an in vitro experiment.

evidence.text: CXXC5-Dvl interaction을 차단하여 Wnt signaling을 회복시키는 것이 핵심 MoA

admet_at_least_25.rationale: The document mentions that hERG and Ames tests are completed with negative results, and that an ADMET package will be shared later. However, it does not provide a complete list of 25 standard ADMET studies with their statuses, so the ADMET score cannot be determined.

evidence.text: ADMET package는 후속 공유 예정

result.concise_summary: The document describes a small molecule program targeting Alzheimer's disease with in vivo efficacy evidence in 5xFAD mice. The candidate is at a pre-IND-enabling stage (before GLP tox). In vitro efficacy is not explicitly reported, and ADMET data is incomplete (only hERG and Ames mentioned). Therefore, the classification is 'value_up' (target indication, small molecule, pre-IND-enabling, in vivo O, in vitro unknown, ADMET unknown).

Developed a novel cell-penetrating peptide that specifically blocks the CXXC5–Dishevelled (Dvl) PPI and subsequently
restores suppressed WNT/β-catenin signaling 
2. Establishment of a novel screening platform monitoring the CXXC5-Dishvelled PPI-Platform 
By using the PTD-DBM peptide, an innovative screening system to identify small molecules that specifically 
disrupt the CXXC5–Dvl interaction was established.
3. Primary small-molecule screening; CXXC5-Dvl PPI Inhibitors
Screened small molecule libraries containing approximately 8,000 compound, therefore, identified initial hit compounds 
through multiple analytical approaches.
4. WNT signaling activator screening
Selected compounds that restore WNT/β-catenin signaling using cells harboring pTPOPLASH-WNT signaling reporter & 
further analyzed their functions with pharmacological analyses.
5. Lead optimization
Synthesized and evaluated over 300 derivatives of lead compounds through repeated cycles of MOA confirmation, 
in vitro testing, and in vivo efficacy studies for multiple metabolic studies.
6. Drug candidate nomination
Advanced optimized compounds into drug development as regenerative small-molecule candidates.

Histological findings correlated with the observed behavioral improvements, based on the assessment of multiple


Novel Targeting Approach; CXXC5-Dishvelled PPI   
Our first-in-class, orally administered small molecule targets the CXXC5–Dishevelled (Dvl) protein–protein interaction (PPI) by selectively disrupting the binding 
of cytosolic CXXC5 to the upstream Wnt pathway mediator Dvl. This restores Wnt/β-catenin signaling that is otherwise pathologically suppressed in Alzheimer’s 
Disease (AD). The therapeutic relevance of targeting cytosolic CXXC5 through CXXC5–Dvl PPI inhibition is strongly supported by the observation that 
overexpression of cytosolic CXXC5 in the hippocampal and prefrontal cortex neurons of AD patients and 5xFAD model mice correlates with marked suppression 
of Wnt signaling. This was further validated geneƟcally: crossing 5xFAD mice with Cxxc5⁻/⁻ mice completely prevented the pathological phenotypes of the 
5xFAD model, including synaptic dysfunction and cognitive deficits. These findings establish cytosolic CXXC5 as a critical disease-driving factor and confirm the 
therapeutic potential of CXXC5–Dvl PPI inhibitors for Alzheimer’s Disease.
Long-Lasting Therapeutic Effect

The WNT pathway is closely associated with AD, particularly its suppression, and restoration has been suggested by others as a promising 
therapeutic strategy. Key pathological features of AD—including β-amyloid accumulation, tau phosphorylation, and GLP-1 suppression—are strongly 
linked to WNT signaling inactivation. 

Therefore, our approach, which restores suppressed WNT signaling by blocking the function of a disease-driving negative regulator, represents a 
highly attractive therapeutic strategy.

Through repeated administration  into the mouse developed AD phenotypes, the candidate demonstrates therapeutic effects by regenerating and 
replacing damaged tissue cells, thereby restoring multiple pathological features of AD—unlike other available or investigational therapies
Oral Delivery

Oral formulation.
Safe Wnt Pathway Targeting

Our approach restores suppressed Wnt/β-catenin signaling rather than pathologic overstimulating it, which is often caused by mutations such as APC 
loss or CTNNB1 (β-catenin) activation, provide a safe approch targeting WNT pathway in multiple diseases suppressed WNT signaling by CXXC5.. 
Disease-Tissue Specific Action

The drug candidate specifically targets diseased cells with high cytosolic CXXC5 expression while sparing normal tissue cells. 

Administration to healthy mice revealed no significant abnormalities in any organs or tissues.

therapeutic potential of CXXC5–Dvl PPI inhibitors for Alzheimer’s Disease.
Long-Lasting Therapeutic Effect

The WNT pathway is closely associated with AD, particularly its suppression, and restoration has been suggested by others as a promising 
therapeutic strategy. Key pathological features of AD—including β-amyloid accumulation, tau phosphorylation, and GLP-1 suppression—are strongly 
linked to WNT signaling inactivation. 

Therefore, our approach, which restores suppressed WNT signaling by blocking the function of a disease-driving negative regulator, represents a 
highly attractive therapeutic strategy.

Through repeated administration  into the mouse developed AD phenotypes, the candidate demonstrates therapeutic effects by regenerating and 
replacing damaged tissue cells, thereby restoring multiple pathological features of AD—unlike other available or investigational therapies
Oral Delivery

Oral formulation.
Safe Wnt Pathway Targeting

Our approach restores suppressed Wnt/β-catenin signaling rather than pathologic overstimulating it, which is often caused by mutations such as APC 
loss or CTNNB1 (β-catenin) activation, provide a safe approch targeting WNT pathway in multiple diseases suppressed WNT signaling by CXXC5.. 
Disease-Tissue Specific Action

The drug candidate specifically targets diseased cells with high cytosolic CXXC5 expression while sparing normal tissue cells. 

Administration to healthy mice revealed no significant abnormalities in any organs or tissues.  
Key Features of CXXC5-Dvl PPI Inhibitors

## 4) Criterion Detail Pages

### 4.1 Target Relevance

**Score: 3점**

**Main line:** CKR-492의 confirmed indication은 Alzheimer’s disease이며, confirmed CXXC5–Dvl/Wnt mechanism은 AD disease biology와 직접 연결되어 SKBP relevance가 높습니다.

**What was checked:**
- Target identity: CXXC5
- Disease/biology relevance: Alzheimer’s disease
- SKBP Theme / Cluster fit: Others / Unknown
- General neurodegeneration / neuroinflammation / epilepsy relevance: AD 자체가 SKBP interest indication

**Evidence trail:**
- CKR-492는 Synapse에서 CK Regeon의 Alzheimer’s disease preclinical drug로 기록됩니다.
- HKN24 인터뷰는 CKR-492를 경구 CXXC5–Dvl inhibitor family의 AD program으로 설명합니다.
- Pharmacodia는 CKR-492 target을 CXXC5, mechanism을 CXXC5 inhibition/Wnt modulation으로 매핑합니다.
- 2023 Pharmacological Research 논문은 AD patient/5xFAD brain에서 CXXC5 증가와 Wnt suppression을 보고하고, Cxxc5 knockout 및 KY19334에 의한 AD phenotype rescue를 제시합니다. 이 논문은 CKR-492 자체가 아니라 **same-target/class biology**입니다.

**Investigation note:** Target Relevance 3점의 핵심 규칙은 “SKBP interest indication + verified target/MoA의 disease-biology linkage”입니다. AD와 CXXC5–Dvl/Wnt linkage는 확인되므로 3점이며, 이는 최대점수입니다. Evidence Type은 CKR-492-specific efficacy가 아니라 target/class-level validation이므로 **E2**입니다.

**What was checked:**

**Evidence trail:**
- DOI 10.1016/j.phrs.2023.106836 논문은 AD patient/5xFAD에서 CXXC5 overexpression과 Wnt suppression을 보고합니다.
- Cxxc5 knockout in 5xFAD와 KY19334 CXXC5–Dvl blockade 모두 AD-related phenotypes를 개선해 functional target validation을 제공합니다.

**Investigation note:** 2점은 functional same-target evidence가 있으므로 충족합니다. 3점에 필요한 CKR-492 자체의 target engagement, mechanism-linked PD/biomarker, direct functional validation은 확인되지 않았습니다.

### 4.4 Platform Attractiveness

**Score: 2점**

**Main line:** CXXC5–Dvl PPI discovery/optimization system은 reusable platform으로 확인되고, platform-derived indoline examples의 quantitative PPI potency advantage가 있습니다.

**What was checked:**
- Is the platform real and reproducible?
- Is differentiation supported by data?
- Is the underlying technical system reusable across candidates/programs or conditions?

**Evidence trail:**
- Company AD deck는 PTD-DBM을 출발점으로 CXXC5–Dvl PPI screening system을 구축하고 약 8,000 compounds를 screen한 뒤 >300 derivatives를 반복적으로 합성/평가했다고 설명합니다.
- 2026 EPO patent EP4674839A1은 indoline examples 1–15의 CXXC5–Dvl binding inhibition IC50를 약 **2.649×10^-9 M ~ 4.516×10^-8 M** 범위로 제시하며, controls인 indirubin **5.386×10^-5 M**, CK090 **4.217×10^-6 M**, 5-cyanoindirubin **1.109×10^-5 M**보다 우수한 activity를 보고합니다. 이는 platform-level quantitative technical advantage입니다.
- 해당 patent/deck data는 CKR-492 code에 직접 연결되지 않으므로 CKR-492 Data Maturity에는 반영하지 않았습니다.

**Investigation note:** 2점 요건인 “appropriate comparator 대비 quantitative technical advantage”는 충족합니다. 3점은 multiple development assets/conditions의 반복 quantitative advantage 또는 cleanly linked FPD가 필요합니다. 2026 company brief의 CKR-051 Phase I 완료 문구는 존재하지만, public 자료의 CKR-501 표기와 code-lineage ambiguity가 있어 3점 근거로 사용하지 않았습니다.

**Platform vs Data Maturity separation:** Platform score는 platform-derived chemistry/patent data를 사용했고, Data Maturity는 CKR-492-specific evidence만 평가했습니다.

- **Target/MoA:** HKN24 and Pharmacodia link CKR-492 to the CXXC5–Dvl/Wnt mechanism; peer-reviewed biology validates the target/class in AD, not CKR-492 itself.

- CKR-492-specific efficacy, PK/BBB, ADMET, safety, target-engagement/PD package가 필요합니다.
- CKR-492의 current rights/license/ownership은 public database상 CK Regeon originator/active organization으로 보이지만, executed licensing agreement 여부는 별도 확인이 필요합니다.
- Marketability를 위해 lead clinical positioning, target population, dosing/duration, entry timing, benchmark net price, penetration/competition assumptions 또는 credible asset-specific forecast가 필요합니다.

## 6) Final Take

**One-line summary:** CXXC5–Dvl/Wnt biology와 reusable platform은 차별화 포인트가 있으나, **CKR-492 자체 data가 없고 2026 CKR-519와의 asset lineage가 unresolved**되어 현재 단계에서는 deal-grade evidence가 부족합니다.

**Recommendation:** **Deprioritize**

**Most important diligence question:** **“CKR-492와 CKR-519의 정확한 compound/program lineage는 무엇인가?”** — dated code-mapping 문서와 함께 CKR-492-specific efficacy, PK/BBB, ADMET, current stage/ownership 자료를 받아야 재평가할 수 있습니다.

pipeline_metadata.comment:
TASR (serine and arginine rich splicing factor 10)는 RNA splicing에 관여하는 타겟.
전통적인 amyloid 제거보다 RNA biology 기반 DMT에 가까운 포지셔닝임.
DigmBio의 알츠하이머 후보물질 DM3159는 기존의 베타아밀로이드/타우 표적(주로 증상 완화 중심) 접근과 달리, 신경보호(neuroprotection)와 신경재생(neurogenesis)을 촉진하는 질병수정치료제(DMT)를 목표로 한다.

초기 전임상(preclinical) 데이터에서 차별화된 효능, 독성 프로파일, 그리고 BBB(혈액뇌장벽) 투과성이 관찰되었다.

DigmBio는 한국 정부로부터 연구지원금(그랜트)을 받아 DM3159의 개발을 가속화하고 있으며, 알츠하이머뿐 아니라 파킨슨병 등 다양한 중추신경계(CNS) 질환 치료제 개발도 함께 추진 중이다.

- 다임바이오측은 AD/PD 에서 확인된 efficacy 자체가 novel target 인 T1R3 에 대한 초기 
validation 제공한다고 언급 
- 현재) DM3159 drug potential 확인하는 단계 
●  Agenda 
- DM3159 AD Program 및 주요 연구개발 현황 공유 
- AD efficacy 및 Target/MoA 관련 data 논의 
- 추가 연구 및 preclinical development 방향 논의 
- SKBP Collaboration 가능성 및 후속 검토 방향 논의 
●  질의 응답 
✓  AD Market Positioning / Differentiation 
Q)  현재 AD 는 lecanbemab, Donanemab 등으로 시장이 형성 되어 있는데, DM3159 는 어떤 
시장 또는 환자국으로 진입하고자 하는지? 
→ DM3159 는 현재 market 또는 patient segment 를 확정한 단계 아님. 기존 anti-Ab therapy 와 
동일하게 Ab 만 직접 target 하는 것이 아닌 T1R3 agonism 및 neurogenesis 를 기반으로 Ab, 
Tau phosphorylation, neuroinflammation 등 다양한 AD pathology 를 포괄적으로 개선하는 
새로운 therapeutic concept 을 지향하고 있음. 
→ 또한, 3xTG efficacy 가 매우 의미 있다고 판단하고 있지만, 어떠한 market position 으로 갈지 
정하지 않음. 
✓  Anti-Amyloid beta therapy 대비 경쟁력 
Q)  Lecanemab 등  기존 anti-Ab therapy 와 비교했을 때 DM3159 의 경쟁력은? 
→ 직접적인 head-to-head 비교는 어려움. 
→ 다임바이오는 Lecanemab 이 진행속도를 약 30% 지연시키는 정도인 반면, DM3159 는 
3xTG mouse model (분석: 11month-old, MWM) 인지 개선 효과 및 Ab normalization, tau 
phosphorylation 감소, 및 neuroinflammation inhibition 등 다양한 효과를 나타내고 있다고 언급

(MWM 외 다른 data not shown) 
→ 단순 Ab reduction 목표로 하는 접근 보다는 여러 AD pathology 동시에 개선할 가능성이 
높은 novel target concept 으로 언급 
* SKBP: Preclinical efficacy 가 human 에서 어느정도 translation 될 수 있을지는 확인이 필요함 
✓  Amyloid beta 관련 market  
Q)  DM3159 에 의해 Amyloid beta burden 감소하는 것은 확인 되는데, Ab production inhibition/ 
aggregation inhibition / clearance 증가 중 어떤 mechanism 으로 설명하고 있는지. 추후 market 
positioning 에 핵심 요소가 될 것 
→ 현재 data 로는 명확하게 특정하기 어려움 언급 
* SKBP:  Amyloid burden 감소 정도만 확인할 수 있는 수준이며, 
production/aggregation/clearance 중 어느 mechanism 이 작동하는지를 직접적으로 보여주는 
MoA 가 추가적으로 필요하다고 제안 
특히, AD market/patient segment 를 target 할지에 따라 필요한 MoA 가 달라질 수 있기 때문에 
연계하여 검토할 것을 제안함 
✓  Biomarker strategy 
Q)  향후 clinical development 진행할 경우 biomarker 필요한데, 고려하고 있는 biomarker 가 
있는지? 
→ 구체적인 clinical biomarker strategy 는 아직 확정되지 않았다고 언급 
→ 현재 preclinical study 에서 Ab 가 정상화 되는 양상은 확인하였으며, tau phosphorylation 및 
neuroinflammation 관련 변화 역시 확인 되고 있어서 potential biomarker candidate 가 될 수 
있음 언급 
→ 다임바이오는 현재 biomarker 선정 자체보다는 preclinical study 에서 toxicity 가 없음을 
확인하고 safety package 를 확보하는 것이 우선이라고 언급함. 
* SKBP: Neuroinflammation 관련해서는 Astrocyte/Microglia 변화 뿐만 아니라 IL-1b, TNF-a 등 
cytokines 변화 등을 추가적으로 확인할 것을 제안함 
✓  추가 Efficacy / MoA study 수행 가능성 
Q)  현재 부족한 efficacy/ MoA 에 대해 다임바이오 내부에서 추가 실험이 가능한지? 
→  다임바이오도 dataset 이 부족함 인지 및 추가적인 data package 필요성 동의 
→ SKBP 가 구체적인 실험 list 를 제안 / 기대하는 data 가 있다면 제안 해주면, 다음바이오 
측에서 내부 검토 후 수행 가능 및 우선순위 결정 가능하다고 언급 
* 개인의견:  in vitro 는 대부분 내부에서 실험 진행하는 것으로 보이며, in vivo 는 외부에서 
진행하는 것으로 보임 (FTE 여유롭지 않을 것으로 보임) 
✓  3xTg / 5xFAD in vivo efficacy 
Q)  현재 주요 efficacy 는 3xTG 에서 확인한 것으로 확인되는데, 5xFAD 에서도 추가적으로 
동등 수준으로 평가할 계획이 있는지? 
→ 초기 5xFAD 포함하여 여러 AD model 평가하였으나, 현재 3xTG model 이 DM3159 의 
concept 을 확인하는 데 보다 적합하다고 판단하여 주요 efficacy study 에 사용함 언급 
✓  Behavioral Efficacy  
Q)  11 개월령 3xTg mouse 에서 MWM 결과가 실제 memory improvement 에 의한 것인지,

노령 mouse 의 locomotor activity 차이에 영향을 받은 것인지 확인한 data 가 있는지? 
→ 다임바이오는 동일 study 에서 open filed test 함께 확인했다고 언급.  
✓  T1R3 target validation / human relevance 
Q)  T1R3 가 AD 에서 실제로 Disease-relevant target 이라는 evidence 가 있는지? 
→ 다임바이오는 T1R3/Taste receptor 관련 function 이 AD 환자에게서 정상 노인 대비 
유의하게 감소한다는 연구들이 존재하며, 이러한 관찰이 초기 target 가정의 출발점이었음을 
안내. 
→ K/O mouse 에서 hippocampal impairment 및 AD-like phenotype 과의 연관성이 보고 되어 
있어 T1R3 와 AD pathology 간 biological relevance 를 뒷받침 하는 연구들은 있다고 안내. 
→ 단, T1R3 specific 하게 pharmacological targeting AD 치료 효과 입증한 연구는 
제한적임을 안내 하였으며, 직접적인 validation 은 필요하다고 답변함. 
✓  Target Specificity / Off-target 
Q)  T1R3 통한 effective dose 가 다소 높아 보이는데, off-target 가능성 없는지? 
→ CNS 관련 주요 target 약 20 개를 포함하는 panel assay 수행하였음. T1R3 제외하고 
activation 보이는 target 은 없었음. 
✓  ADMET 
Q)  General Toxicology 에서 200mg/kg 까지 평가한 것으로 보이는데, 200mg/kg 이상 
평가하지 않은 이유가 solubility 또는 safety 때문인지? 
→ long-term toxicity 수행 전 tolerability 를 확인하기 위해 진행한 실험으로, 2 주간 
투여하였을 때 side effect, solubility issue 는 나타나지 않았음 언급 
* SKBP: 현재 PK data 로는 dose linearity 판단하기 어려움 언급. Lower/higher dose 
포함하여 PK linearity 추가적으로 확인할 필요가 있다고 언급. 
✓  IP 
Q)  DM3159 관련 특허 출원/등록 현황? 
→관련 특허 2024 년 출원 되었으며 일부 등록 완료 되었다고 언급. 
Next Step 
●  SKBP: 다임바이오측에 보고자 하는 data list 전달 
●  다임바이오: 내부 논의 후 VDR 에 efficacy / ADME data 공유 + VDR 기간 연장 
Takeaway 
●  T1R3 agonism 을 기반으로 한 novel AD 접근으로, 3xTg model 에서 인지능력 개선과 함께 Aβ, 
tau phosphorylation 및 neuroinflammation 등 multiple AD pathology 에 대한 encouraging efficacy 
일부 data 공유 및 언급 
●  다만 현재 efficacy 대비 T1R3 target engagement/MoA 및 human relevance 에 대한 validation 
이 충분하지 않으며, Ab burden 감소의 구체적인 MoA 역시 증명이 필요함 
●  향후 AD 내 환자/마켓 positioning 을 구체화하고, 이에 기반한 추가 efficacy/MoA study 및 기존 
anti-Ab therapy 대비 differentiation 을 뒷받침할 dataset 확보 필요
