source_report.raw_markdown:
# Orgasis Inc Pipeline Scout Report: **OGS-101**

Original report provenance: researched and scored with GPT instruction 2 — Full Scout v3.8 (schema v3.2); URLs are included for auditability.

**중요:** OGS-101은 공식 회사 자료에서 Parkinson’s disease용 small-molecule mitophagy inducer로 확인되고, 업로드 IR에서 현재 Lead Optimization 및 PINK1/Parkin-dependent mitophagy의 asset-specific 정량·in vivo 데이터가 확인되어 **14/21점, Hard Filter PASS / Shortlist**로 판단합니다. 다만 direct molecular target, brain PK/PK-PD, mammalian efficacy/safety 및 임상단계 mitophagy 경쟁약물 대비 차별성은 핵심 diligence gap입니다.

## 1) Company Profile

| Field | Content | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Company | Orgasis Inc | Official company website [1] |
| Legal name / aliases | (주)오가시스 / ORGASIS, Inc. / Orgasis Corp | 회사 IR 및 patent assignee [1], [5] |
| Location (company HQ) | Suwon-si, Gyeonggi-do, Republic of Korea | Official website [4] |
| Headquarters | #803, 8F, 147 Gwanggyo-ro, Yeongtong-gu, Suwon-si, Gyeonggi-do | Official website [4] |
| Website | https://www.orgasis.co.kr/ | [4] |
| Company type / stage | Private biotech; Pre-Series A | 2026-01 KRW 3.0bn Pre-Series A financing [7] |
| Focus areas | Organelle homeostasis, selective autophagy; neurodegeneration, skin disease, functional ingredients | 회사 IR p.5 및 official platform [2] |
| Platform summary | ORAUTAC™: organelle-selective autophagy monitoring/screening system spanning mitophagy, lysophagy, pexophagy, ER-phagy, Golgiphagy, melanophagy and related systems | [2], [3] |
| Financing / partnership signals | KRW 3.0bn Pre-Series A; multiple government R&D programs and external collaboration activity | [7] |
| Lead pipeline summary | OGS-101 PD; OGS-102 ALS; OGS-901 psoriasis/atopy | Official pipeline [1] |

업로드 IR은 회사가 2022년 설립되었고 세포소기관 선택적 자가포식 및 Parkinson’s disease를 주요 연구영역으로 제시하며 혁신신약과 기능성 소재를 개발한다고 설명합니다. 회사의 2026년 1월 Pre-Series A 투자유치도 외부 보도로 확인됩니다.

## 2) Pipeline Snapshot

| Field | Content | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Company | Orgasis Inc | [1], [4] |
| Lead asset | OGS-101 | [1]; uploaded IR p.18 |
| Target | PINK1/Parkin mitophagy pathway; **direct molecular target/binding partner not publicly disclosed** | [1], [5], [6], [8] |
| Theme / Cluster | Theme: **Protein Homeostasis** / Cluster: **Unknown** | Mitophagy/autophagy directly modulates organelle/proteostasis quality control [8] |
| MoA | Mitophagy inducer; PINK1-dependent Parkin recruitment and mitophagic flux, intended to selectively clear damaged mitochondria | [1]; uploaded IR pp.24–25 |
| Modality / Platform | Small molecule / ORAUTAC™ | [1]–[3] |
| Indication | Parkinson’s disease | [1] |
| Pipeline Stage | **Lead Optimization** | Uploaded IR p.27 explicitly states current Lead Optimization and DMPK optimization |
| Key data | PINK1-dependence, Parkin translocation, mitophagy flux; mitochondrial membrane potential/ATP/cell viability; α-syn-related readout; zebrafish MPTP behavioral efficacy; MTK458 head-to-head plots | Uploaded IR pp.24–27 |

Official Orgasis pipeline independently verifies OGS-101 as a **small-molecule, Parkinson’s disease, Mitophagy Inducer** program and lists future GLP-Tox/P1 IND milestones. The uploaded 2026 IR likewise identifies the asset and indication.

For current-stage canonicalization, the decisive evidence is IR p.27: “현재 Lead Optimization 진행 중” with Pink-Parkin pathway lead DMPK optimization. Future GLP-Tox/IND dates are plans and therefore do not promote the canonical stage.

## 3) Scorecard Summary

| Criterion | Score (maximum 3 points each) | One-line judgment | Evidence used |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Target Relevance | **3점** | PD is an SKBP priority indication | [1] |
| MoA Validity | **3점** | Asset-specific PINK1-dependent/Parkin-linked functional validation | IR pp.24–26; [5], [8] |
| Data Maturity | **3점** | Complementary quantitative mechanistic, cellular-efficacy and in vivo domains | IR pp.26–27 |
| Competitive Landscape | **2점** | Direct MTK458 H2H exists, but no sufficiently documented matched advantage versus current clinical competitors | IR p.27; [9], [11]–[18] |
| Platform Attractiveness | **2점** | Reusable ORAUTAC architecture plus quantitative mitophagy technical validation | IR pp.15–16, p.25; [2], [3] |
| Expansion Potential | **0점** | No second OGS-101-specific indication/program verified | [1], [2] |
| Marketability | **1점** | Calculation; global obtainable peak sales **306.18 million USD** | [13], [14], [17]–[20] |
| **Total** | **14점** | Maximum total: 21점 | **Hard Filter PASS** |

## 4) Criterion Detail Pages

### 4.1 Target Relevance
**Score: 3**

**Main line:** OGS-101의 공식 lead indication은 Parkinson’s disease로, SKBP의 six priority indications 중 하나입니다.

**What was checked:**
- Asset identity and indication on current official pipeline
- Uploaded company IR
- Whether PD is an active/current program rather than a platform hypothesis

**Evidence trail:**
- Orgasis official pipeline: OGS-101 = Small molecule / Parkinson’s disease / Mitophagy Inducer. [1]
- Uploaded IR p.18 independently identifies the same asset-indication-MoA combination.

**Investigation note:**  
Target Relevance는 target biology가 아니라 confirmed indication fit만으로 평가했습니다. PD이므로 rubric상 3점이며 3점이 최고점입니다.

### 4.2 MoA Validity
**Score: 3**

**Main line:** PINK1/Parkin-mediated mitophagy는 독립적 disease biology가 확립되어 있고, OGS-101 자체에서도 PINK1 dependency, Parkin recruitment 및 mitophagic flux가 직접 관찰되어 Score 3 기준을 충족합니다.

**What was checked:**
- PINK1/Parkin independent biology
- PINK1 knockout dependence
- Parkin translocation
- Mitophagy flux
- Mitochondrial-function and disease-linked downstream effects
- Potential mechanism-artifact risk

**Evidence trail:**
- IR p.24: OGS-101/OGS-MA effect is described as PINK1/Parkin-mediated; PINK1 KO cells lose the mitophagy response, supporting pathway dependence.
- IR p.25 contains quantitative Parkin-translocation and mitophagy-flux plots in SH-SY5Y systems, with Urolithin A/UMI-77 comparator conditions.
- IR p.26 links the mechanism to mitochondrial membrane potential, ATP, neuronal viability, α-syn-related signal and zebrafish PD behavior.
- Independent Nature Cell Biology review describes PINK1 as the mitochondrial-damage sensor and Parkin as the effector selectively marking damaged mitochondria for mitophagy, including relevance to dopamine neurons. [8]
- MTK458 provides independent same-pathway pharmacologic validation: direct PINK1 activation increased mitophagy and improved α-syn pathology in PD models. [9]
- Important class-risk caveat: a 2025 study reported that MTK458 and another putative activator can themselves induce mild mitochondrial stress/off-target effects, making orthogonal confirmation of OGS-101’s mechanism particularly important. [10]

**Attachment evidence record:**
- file_name: `오가시스 IR Ver 4.8_SK바이오팜_공유.pdf`
- pages: 24–26
- evidence_summary: PINK1 dependency, Parkin translocation, mitophagic flux and downstream mitochondrial/neuroprotective readouts
- supported_criterion: MoA Validity
- evidence_type: E3_asset_specific_preclinical_or_technical_evidence
- evidence_origin: user_uploaded_file
- source_nature: company_generated

**Investigation note:**  
Scoring evidence는 proximal Parkin/mitophagy marker에 그치지 않고 neuronal viability, α-syn-related readout 및 PD-model behavior까지 disease-relevant phenotype과 연결됩니다. Direct molecular binding target은 아직 공개되지 않았지만 rubric상 direct functional validation으로 Score 3이 가능합니다.

### 4.3 Data Maturity
**Score: 3**

**Main line:** Lead Optimization 단계에 적합한 asset-specific quantitative evidence가 서로 다른 development question을 다루는 복수 domain에서 확인됩니다.

**What was checked:**
- In vitro efficacy
- Mitochondrial function
- Neuroprotection
- α-syn-related signal
- In vivo PD model behavior
- Benchmark comparison
- PK/PD, GLP tox, CMC, human-data gap

**Evidence trail:**
- **Domain 1 — mitochondrial/cellular efficacy:** IR p.26 shows quantitative TMRE membrane-potential, ATP and cell-viability plots under MPP+ stress.
- **Domain 2 — disease-linked/in vivo efficacy:** the same page reports α-syn phosphorylation accumulation suppression and MPTP-induced zebrafish PD-model behavioral recovery.
- **Domain 3 — benchmark/program progression:** p.27 presents OGS-101 versus MTK458 across Parkin-translocation, MPP+ cell viability and zebrafish behavior, and explicitly states current DMPK-oriented Lead Optimization.

For separation from Platform Attractiveness, **Data Maturity is scored primarily from p.26–27 mitochondrial function/neuroprotection/in vivo efficacy**, while p.25 Parkin/mitophagy platform-style comparative readouts are used for Platform Attractiveness.

**Attachment evidence record:**
- file_name: `오가시스 IR Ver 4.8_SK바이오팜_공유.pdf`
- pages: 26–27
- evidence_summary: quantitative mitochondrial/cell efficacy plus zebrafish behavioral efficacy and lead-optimization status
- supported_criterion: Data Maturity
- evidence_type: E3_asset_specific_preclinical_or_technical_evidence
- evidence_origin: user_uploaded_file
- source_nature: company_generated

**Why not higher:**  
3점이 최고점입니다. 그러나 diligence 관점에서는 mammalian brain PK/PK-PD, rodent efficacy with exposure-response, GLP tox, CMC 및 human data가 아직 공개 확인되지 않아 상당한 translational gap이 남습니다.

### 4.4 Competitive Landscape
**Score: 2**

**Main line:** Orgasis has an asset-specific quantitative MTK458 comparison, but the current field contains clinically more advanced mitophagy/mitochondrial-quality-control programs and Score 3에 필요한 sufficiently documented matched material advantage versus a current clinical comparator is not yet established.

**What was checked:**
- OGS-101 / OGS-MA aliases
- Parkinson’s + PINK1/Parkin
- Parkinson’s + mitophagy / mitochondrial quality control
- Direct competitors vs broader PD disease-modifying comparators
- Phase 1/2/3 and clinical registry status
- Recent mechanism and review literature

**Competitor table:**

| Competitor | Company | Modality | Target / MoA | Pipeline Stage | Why it matters | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TJ0113 | Hangzhou PhecdaMed / academic clinical sponsor | Small molecule | Mitophagy inducer; PINK1-Parkin-linked | Phase 2 completed | Closest clinical comparator by PD + small molecule + mitophagy biology | [14], [15] |
| ABBV-1088 / MTK458 lineage | AbbVie / Mitokinin | Small molecule | PINK1 activation / mitophagy | Phase 1; SAD completed, later MAD/DDI study terminated | MTK458 is Orgasis’s explicit H2H benchmark | [9], [11], [12] |
| MTX325 | Mission Therapeutics | Small molecule | USP30 inhibitor → enhanced mitophagy | Phase 1 | Same PD disease-modification/mitophagy thesis via a different proximal target | [13] |
| VNA-318 | Vandria | Small molecule | Mitochondrial-function/quality-control target | Phase 1 | Human brain penetration and target engagement; AD lead, PD broader relevance | [16] |
| Bemdaneprocel | BlueRock / Bayer | Cell therapy | Dopaminergic neuron replacement | Phase 3 | Advanced disease-modifying PD benchmark, different effector mechanism | [17] |
| BIIB122 / DNL151 | Denali / Biogen | Small molecule | LRRK2 inhibition | Phase 2a active in LRRK2-PD; idiopathic Phase 2b failed | Illustrates both field intensity and PD translation risk | [18] |

TJ0113’s registered Phase 2 trial completed with 149 patients, making it materially more advanced than OGS-101. Mission’s MTX325 is already in Phase I and has reported brain penetration after Phase 1a. Bemdaneprocel is in a recruiting Phase 3 PD study, while BIIB122’s idiopathic PD Phase 2b failed in 2026 although its LRRK2-PD Phase 2a remains active.

**Direct H2H:**  
IR p.27 compares OGS-101 with MTK458 under matched cellular conditions and shows quantitative bar plots for Parkin translocation and MPP+-induced cell viability, plus zebrafish behavior. Some efficacy plots visually favor OGS-101. However, the deck does not provide a complete numeric result table/statistical package sufficient to establish a robust, decision-grade material advantage across matched endpoints.

**Investigation note:**  
Search scope included asset/code aliases; same indication + target/MoA; same indication + pathway; approved/Phase 3/clinical/preclinical competitors; registries and recent mechanism reviews. TJ0113 and ABBV-1088/MTK458 are treated as direct/high-similarity comparators; MTX325 as same-indication/same-effector-pathway but different proximal target; VNA-318, BIIB122 and bemdaneprocel as broader references. Score 3 is withheld because a fully documented, matched, statistically interpretable material advantage versus a current clinical comparator is not demonstrated.

### 4.5 Platform Attractiveness
**Score: 2**

**Main line:** ORAUTAC is a genuine reusable multi-organelle screening/monitoring architecture, and linked mitophagy work provides quantitative technical validation versus benchmark activators.

**What was checked:**
- Reusability across organelles
- Cellular and in vivo monitoring systems
- Quantitative comparative technical evidence
- Evidence distinct from Data Maturity
- Cross-asset replication / FPD

**Evidence trail:**
- Orgasis describes ORAUTAC as an imaging-based HTS platform spanning cell and in vivo systems and multiple selective-autophagy types. [3]
- The Mitophagy platform uses multiple monitoring formats including SH-SY5Y/GFP-Parkin and other reporter systems. [2]
- Uploaded IR pp.15–16 describes organelle-specific platforms, novel pathways, screening libraries and selective removal of damaged organelles.
- For the **quantitative platform evidence used here rather than Data Maturity**, p.25 compares OGS-101 with Urolithin A and UMI-77 on Parkin translocation and mitophagic puncta under standardized reporter conditions.

**Attachment evidence record:**
- file_name: `오가시스 IR Ver 4.8_SK바이오팜_공유.pdf`
- pages: 15–16, 25
- evidence_summary: reusable selective-autophagy architecture plus benchmarked mitophagy reporter performance
- supported_criterion: Platform Attractiveness
- evidence_type: E3_asset_specific_preclinical_or_technical_evidence
- evidence_origin: user_uploaded_file
- source_nature: company_generated

**Investigation note:**  
2점은 platform breadth 자체가 아니라 reusable architecture와 explicit quantitative mitophagy comparator data에 근거합니다. 3점은 동일한 quantitative technical advantage가 여러 independent conditions/officially linked assets에서 재현되거나 platform-derived asset FPD까지 확인되어야 하나, 공개 근거가 충분하지 않습니다.

### 4.6 Expansion Potential
**Score: 0**

**Main line:** OGS-101 자체의 Parkinson’s disease 외 추가 indication은 확인되지 않았습니다.

**What was checked:**
- Official OGS-101 indication listings
- Mitophagy platform disease lists
- Whether AD/other disease mentions represent OGS-101-specific active programs
- Asset-specific secondary-indication data

**Evidence trail:**
- Official pipeline currently assigns OGS-101 to Parkinson’s disease. [1]
- Orgasis’s mitophagy platform discusses Alzheimer’s disease and other diseases, but these are platform-level opportunities and are not identified as OGS-101 development programs. [2]
- IR also discusses potential expansion to other mitochondrial-dysfunction diseases, but no separate OGS-101 program/data package was identified.

**Investigation note:**  
Confirmed additional indication: **none**. 따라서 Score 1에 필요한 asset-level second indication with biological rationale 자체가 확인되지 않았으며, platform reuse or future opportunity는 rubric에 따라 제외했습니다.

### 4.7 Marketability
**Score: 1**

**Main line:** Conservative internal calculation yields **306.18 million USD** global obtainable peak sales.

**Assessment method:** calculation  
**Score basis type:** calculation  
**Calculation status:** performed  
**Assessed global peak sales:** **306.18 million USD**

No reliable **OGS-101-specific external peak-sales forecast** was verified. The company’s general PD market-size projection is not an asset-specific forecast and therefore was not used as the score basis.

**What was checked:**
- US PD patient pool
- US medication-cost benchmark
- Competitive intensity
- Peak penetration
- Competition haircut
- Pricing power evidence
- External asset-specific forecast availability

**Calculation assumptions and rationale:**
- US Patient Pool: **1,200,000** people living with PD by 2030, Parkinson’s Foundation. [19]
- Diagnosis Rate: **0.90** — conservative screening assumption.
- Eligibility Rate: **0.80** — analyst screening assumption; excludes patients unsuitable for a future disease-modifying small molecule.
- Treatable Subgroup Rate: **0.70** — analyst screening assumption reflecting eventual label/clinical selection.
- Benchmark Annualized Net Price proxy: **2,500 USD/year**, using Parkinson’s Foundation’s reported average annual PD medication cost. This is a conservative SOC-spend proxy, **not an OGS-101-specific net-price estimate**. [20]
- Peak Penetration: **0.30**.
- Treatment Duration Factor: **1.0**.
- Competition Haircut: **0.45 retained share factor**, reflecting advanced TJ0113, MTX325, ABBV-1088 lineage and broader disease-modifying PD competition.
- Pricing Power Adjustment: **1.0** because no human efficacy/safety/convenience evidence yet supports a premium.
- Global multiplier: **1.5**, applied once per Full Scout policy.

**Worksheet:**

| Step | Formula | Output | Evidence / assumption |
|---|---|---:|---|
| A. US TAP | 1,200,000 × 0.90 × 0.80 × 0.70 | **604,800 patients** | [19] + analyst assumptions |
| B. US Unrisked Peak Sales | 604,800 × 2,500 USD × 0.30 × 1.0 | **453.60 million USD** | [20] + penetration assumption |
| C. US Obtainable Peak Sales | 453.60 × 0.45 × 1.0 | **204.12 million USD** | Competitive landscape |
| D. Global Obtainable Peak Sales | 204.12 × 1.5 | **306.18 million USD** | Screening policy |
| External Peak Sales Reference | None verified for OGS-101 | — | Company market-size claims excluded |
| Final score basis | 306.18 < 1,000 million USD | **1점** | Full Scout threshold |

**Investigation note:**  
This is deliberately conservative because the 2,500 USD benchmark reflects current PD medication spend rather than a future disease-modifying therapy’s negotiated net price. Conversely, OGS-101 has no clinical data to justify a pricing premium. Accordingly, the calculation is suitable for screening but not for valuation.

## 5) Validation Notes

**Cross-checked facts:**
- OGS-101 identity, Parkinson’s disease indication, small-molecule modality and mitophagy MoA agree between the uploaded IR and current official Orgasis pipeline.
- Current company activity around a PINK1-Parkin PD therapeutic strategy is also reported in April 2026. [6]
- PINK1/Parkin’s role in damaged-mitochondria quality control is independently supported by peer-reviewed literature. [8]
- Mitophagy-directed PD competition is not hypothetical: TJ0113 has completed Phase 2, MTX325 is clinical, and ABBV-1088 has entered Phase 1.

**Uncertain points:**
- OGS-101 chemical structure and direct molecular binding target are not publicly disclosed.
- Public OGS-101 brain PK, mammalian PK/PD, rodent exposure-response efficacy, GLP toxicology, CMC and human data were not verified.
- Uploaded IR and current official materials are not fully consistent on future P1 IND timing. Because these are future milestones, **Lead Optimization** remains the canonical current stage.
- ABBV-1088 had a completed SAD study but a subsequent MAD/DDI study was terminated for strategic considerations; this creates competitor-program continuity uncertainty, but is not enough to classify the whole asset as discontinued.
- The marketability price input is a conservative SOC medication-spend proxy, not an OGS-101 net-price forecast.

**Search log:**
- Official company page: checked [1], [4].
- Pipeline page: checked [1].
- Platform page: checked [2], [3].
- Publications / patents: checked [5], [8]–[10], [15], [21].
- Regulatory / trial registry: checked [11], [12], [14], [17], [18].
- Competitor sources: TJ0113, ABBV-1088/MTK458, MTX325, VNA-318, bemdaneprocel, BIIB122.
- Market / epidemiology sources: Parkinson’s Foundation [19], [20].
- Financing / partnership sources: Pre-Series A financing [7].
- Attachment review: IR pp.5, 15–16, 18–27 and company growth/strategy pages were reviewed; quantitative OGS-101 scoring relies specifically on readable pp.24–27.

## 6) Final Take

**One-line summary:**  
OGS-101 is a publicly verified **Lead Optimization-stage Parkinson’s disease small molecule** with unusually relevant asset-specific PINK1/Parkin mitophagy, mitochondrial-function/neuroprotection and zebrafish efficacy evidence for its stage, but it must now de-risk brain exposure, mechanism specificity, mammalian translation and differentiation from clinically advancing mitophagy competitors.

**Recommendation: Shortlist**

**Most important diligence question:**  
Can Orgasis provide the **OGS-101 structure/IP linkage, direct molecular target/biophysical engagement, brain PK and PK-PD relationship, safety margin, mammalian PD efficacy, and orthogonal evidence that PINK1/Parkin activation is a direct therapeutic mechanism rather than compound-induced mitochondrial stress**, together with a matched comparison against TJ0113/ABBV-1088/MTX325-relevant benchmarks?

# Rznomics Inc Pipeline Scout Report: **RZ-003**

Original report provenance: researched and scored with GPT instruction 2 — Full Scout v3.8 (schema v3.2); URLs are included for auditability.

**중요:** RZ-003은 APOE4 RNA를 절단하고 APOE2 또는 APOE3 Christchurch(APOE3ch) 계열의 치료 RNA를 발현시키는 Alzheimer’s disease 유전자치료제이며, 최신 2026 회사 IR 및 독립 리뷰 기준 현재 단계는 사용자 입력의 `Discovery`보다 진전된 **Preclinical unspecified**로 판단합니다. 다만 현재 공개된 RZ-003 자체 데이터는 주로 **in vivo transgene expression**에 머물고, APOE4 knockdown→정확한 trans-splicing→보호적 ApoE 단백질 생성→AD phenotype 개선까지 연결된 asset-specific quantitative package가 없어 **13/21점, REVIEW / Watch**로 평가합니다.

### 4.4 Competitive Landscape
**Score: 2**

**Main line:** APOE-directed gene therapy is no longer a greenfield space: **LX1001 is Phase 1/2**, while **LX1020 is conceptually very close to RZ-003** because it combines protective APOE2 expression with APOE4 suppression. RZ-003 nevertheless has a plausible differentiated RNA-level one-molecule dual-function approach.

**What was checked:**
- RZ-003/APOE4 RNA-editing aliases
- Same-indication + APOE4 gene therapy
- Protective APOE2/APOE3ch strategies
- APOE4 suppression + protective allele combination approaches
- Current clinical and preclinical programs
- Approved AD disease-modifying therapies
- APOE4-specific safety gap in current care
- Recent AD/APOE pipeline reviews

**Competitor table:**

| Competitor | Company | Modality | Target / MoA | Pipeline Stage | Why it matters | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LX1020 | Lexeo Therapeutics | Gene therapy | APOE2 expression + miRNA suppression of APOE4 | Preclinical | Closest publicly current conceptual comparator to RZ-003’s dual reduce-and-replace strategy | [8] |
| LX1001 | Lexeo Therapeutics | Gene therapy | AAVrh10 delivery of protective APOE2 | Phase 1/2 | Clinical-stage APOE-directed benchmark with human target-expression and tau-biomarker data | [8], [9] |
| LX1021 | Lexeo Therapeutics | Gene therapy | Christchurch-modified APOE2 expression | Preclinical | Overlaps with RZ-003’s use of a protective Christchurch-type ApoE strategy | [8] |
| LEQEMBI (lecanemab) | Eisai / Biogen | Antibody | Amyloid-beta-directed antibody | Approved / marketed | Current disease-modifying benchmark and important APOE4 safety comparator | [16] |

Lexeo’s current pipeline states that LX1020 is intended to express APOE2 while concurrently suppressing APOE4, making it particularly close mechanistically to RZ-003. LX1001 is already in Phase 1/2 and has produced human APOE2 expression and tau biomarker data.

The FDA label for LEQEMBI reports ARIA in **45% of treated APOE4 homozygotes**, versus 19% of heterozygotes and 13% of non-carriers, creating a clinically relevant unmet-need rationale for non-amyloid APOE-directed strategies. [16]

The 2025 AD drug-discovery review additionally reports preclinical APOE programs including AMT-240, CLAIRIgene and base-editing approaches. Their present corporate activity/status could not all be independently reconfirmed in 2026, so they are not counted in the primary dashboard competitor graph. [4]

No reliable asset-specific RZ-003 external peak-sales forecast was identified. The company deck’s 2033 AD treatment-market forecast of 10,148 million USD is a disease-market estimate rather than an RZ-003 sales forecast and is therefore excluded as a scoring basis.

**Calculation inputs:**
- US Patient Pool: **7,400,000** Americans age ≥65 living with clinical Alzheimer’s dementia in 2026. [14]
- Diagnosis Rate: **0.75** — analyst screening assumption to account for diagnosis/biomarker confirmation required before a genotype-directed intervention.
- Eligibility Rate: **0.40** — conservative lower-bound APOE4-carrier share; current RZ-003 materials and independent reporting indicate approximately 40% or more of AD patients carry at least one APOE4 allele. [17]
- Treatable Subgroup Rate: **0.30** — analyst assumption representing a peak-year one-time-treatment cohort suitable for an invasive CNS genetic intervention rather than the entire prevalent population.
- Benchmark Annualized Price: **28,270.32 USD** — current public LEQEMBI IV annual list-price proxy for a 165-lb patient. A verified net price and an approved one-time AD gene-therapy benchmark were unavailable. [15]
- Peak Penetration: **0.10** — analyst screening assumption reflecting an invasive one-time modality and substantial competition.
- Treatment Duration Factor: **1.0**.
- Competition Haircut: **0.35 retained factor**, reflecting clinical LX1001, preclinical next-generation APOE programs and established anti-amyloid therapies.
- Pricing Power Adjustment: **1.0**, because RZ-003 lacks human efficacy/safety data sufficient to justify a premium.
- Global multiplier: **1.5**, applied once per Full Scout policy.

|---|---|---:|---|
| A. US TAP | 7,400,000 × 0.75 × 0.40 × 0.30 | **666,000 patients** | [14], [17] + analyst assumptions |
| B. US Unrisked Peak Sales | 666,000 × 28,270.32 USD × 0.10 × 1.0 | **1,882.80 million USD** | [15] + penetration assumption |

The estimate is a screening calculation rather than valuation. The largest limitation is that the closest transparent approved AD benchmark provides a **list price, not verified net price**, and there is no approved one-time AD gene therapy from which to derive a true one-time benchmark.

## 6) Final Take

**One-line summary:**  
RZ-003 is a **verified preclinical APOE4 RNA-replacement gene therapy for Alzheimer’s disease with a strong biological thesis and a clinically validated parent platform, but its own public dataset currently stops at in vivo therapeutic-transgene expression rather than demonstrating complete APOE4 editing and disease modification.**

**Recommendation: Watch**

The program is strategically relevant enough to keep active, but the next diligence step should be data-driven rather than thesis-driven.

**Most important diligence question:**  
Can Rznomics provide an **RZ-003-specific CNS dose-response package** showing, in the same animals and clinically intended construct, (1) brain/vector biodistribution, (2) APOE4 RNA reduction, (3) sequence-confirmed trans-spliced APOE2/APOE3ch RNA and protein, (4) amyloid/tau/neuroinflammation and cognitive efficacy, and (5) safety/toxicology margins—and how does that package compare with LX1001/LX1020?

source_report.raw_markdown:
# Rznomics Inc Pipeline Scout Report: **RZ-005**

Original report provenance: researched and scored with GPT instruction 2 — Full Scout v3.8 (schema v3.2); URLs are included for auditability.

**중요:** RZ-005는 Rett syndrome을 대상으로 하는 Rznomics의 active discovery-stage CNS gene-therapy program으로 확인되며, 초기 입력의 `Target: Undisclosed`와 달리 2026년 회사 자료 및 관련 특허에서는 **mutant MECP2 transcript를 trans-splicing ribozyme으로 절단하고 WT MECP2 RNA로 치환하는 기전**이 공개되었습니다. 다만 RZ-005 자체의 정량 in vivo efficacy/PD/safety 데이터가 아직 공개되지 않았고, NGN-401·TSHA-102가 이미 Phase 3에 진입해 있어 **REVIEW / Watch**로 평가합니다.

**Source: User input (not independently verified):** `Rett Syndrome | Discovery | Seongnam, Korea | Gene therapy | Undisclosed`

**Attachment evidence provenance:** 사용자가 제공한 `Rznomics_Introduction NCD_2026.07.08(1).pdf`를 먼저 검토했습니다. Page 17은 RZ-005를 Rett syndrome/CNS program으로 표시하고 Discovery→Pre-clinical 개발 로드맵을 제시합니다. Page 24는 RZ-005가 mutant MeCP2를 표적하고 WT MeCP2 expression을 유도하며, 5'UTR upstream targeting으로 여러 mutation을 포괄하려는 설계를 명시합니다. 이 자료는 **Evidence Origin: user_uploaded_file / source_nature: company_generated**로 처리했으며 독립 검증자료로 간주하지 않았습니다.

## 1) Company Profile

| Field | Content | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Company | Rznomics Inc | [1], [14] |
| Legal name / aliases | Rznomics Inc / 알지노믹스(주) | [14] |
| Location (company HQ) | Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi-do, Republic of Korea | [1], [14] |
| Headquarters | 801, C Building, Pangyo Innovalley, 253 Pangyo-ro, Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si | [1], [14] |
| Website | https://www.rznomics.com/ | [14] |
| Company type / stage | KOSDAQ-listed RNA therapeutics / gene-therapy company; listed 18 Dec 2025 | [1], [14] |
| Focus areas | RNA editing, trans-splicing ribozyme therapeutics, oncology, CNS/genetic disorders, retinal disease, circular RNA | [1] |
| Platform summary | Disease-associated RNA cleavage + therapeutic RNA ligation in one trans-splicing ribozyme construct; target-RNA-dependent therapeutic gene expression and modular target selection | [1], [3] |
| Financing / partnership signals | Eli Lilly global research collaboration/license for inherited hearing loss; total potential value > USD 1.3B if all options exercised | [5] |
| Lead pipeline summary | RZ-001 clinical; RZ-003 AD; RZ-004 retinitis pigmentosa; RZ-005 Rett syndrome; inherited-hearing-loss platform collaboration | [1], [4], [5] |

Rznomics는 2017년 설립되었고, 회사 IR 자료는 2025년 12월 18일 KOSDAQ 상장을 명시합니다. 공식 KRX 자료에는 본사 위치가 성남시 분당구 판교로 253으로 기재되어 있습니다. Eli Lilly와의 2025년 계약은 Rznomics의 trans-splicing ribozyme platform을 유전성 난청에 적용하는 협력이며, 모든 option 행사 시 계약가치가 USD 1.3B를 초과할 수 있다고 공개되었습니다.

## 2) Pipeline Snapshot

| Field | Content | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Company | Rznomics Inc | [1], [14] |
| Lead asset | RZ-005 | [1], [2] |
| Target | **Mutant MECP2 transcript** | User-uploaded deck p.24; [2], [3] |
| Theme / Cluster | **Theme: Others / Cluster: Others** | MECP2 RNA correction does not directly map to E/I Balance, Neuroimmune, or Protein Homeostasis taxonomy |
| MoA | Mutant MECP2 RNA recognition/cleavage followed by trans-splicing of therapeutic WT MECP2 RNA, reducing mutant product while restoring regulated WT MeCP2 expression | User-uploaded deck p.24; [2], [3] |
| Modality / Platform | **Gene therapy** / trans-splicing ribozyme RNA-editing platform; exact RZ-005 delivery vector and route remain undisclosed | [3] |
| Indication | Rett syndrome | [1], [2], [3] |
| Pipeline Stage | **Hit Discovery**; raw user input = Discovery. Samsung Securities describes “후보물질 도출,” but no official candidate-nomination milestone sufficient to promote to Preclinical Candidate was verified | [1], [2] |
| Key data | No RZ-005-coded quantitative dataset disclosed; aligned Rznomics MECP2 patent shows precise trans-splicing in SH-SY5Y cells and activity assessment in iPSC-derived neurons | [3] |

The initial `Undisclosed` target entry is superseded by newer evidence: the July 2026 company deck explicitly states mutant MeCP2 targeting/WT MeCP2 induction, and Samsung Securities independently records RZ-005 as “mutant MeCP2 RNA를 잘라내고 WT MeCP2로 치환.”

The associated Rznomics patent WO2025147110A1 describes MECP2 transcript-specific trans-splicing ribozymes that replace mutant MECP2 RNA with WT sequence, reduce mutant MeCP2 protein, increase WT MeCP2 and regulate expression to avoid supraphysiologic WT levels. The patent also reports trans-splicing in MeCP2-positive SH-SY5Y cells and testing in iPSC-derived neurons. The patent, however, does **not** explicitly print the RZ-005 code, so this evidence is treated as strongly aligned program evidence rather than unquestioned final-candidate evidence.

**Canonical main-indication note:** the approved dashboard taxonomy does not contain a Rett syndrome bucket. Therefore `structured_table.main_indication = "Unknown"` while the full confirmed disease wording is preserved as `structured_table.indication = "Rett syndrome"`.

## 3) Scorecard Summary

| Criterion | Score (maximum 3 points each) | One-line judgment | Evidence used |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Target Relevance | **2점** | Rett syndrome is clearly CNS/neurodevelopmental, but not one of SKBP's six priority indications | [1], [2] |
| MoA Validity | **2점** | MECP2 RNA replacement has target-specific cellular/neuronal functional support, but no RZ-005-coded direct validation | [3] |
| Data Maturity | **1점** | RZ-005 design/program is confirmed but no asset-specific quantitative efficacy/PD/safety domain is public | [1], [2], [3] |
| Competitive Landscape | **1점** | Phase 3 MECP2 gene therapies and RNA-editing competitors exist; RZ-005 differentiation remains non-quantitative | [6]-[11] |
| Platform Attractiveness | **3점** | Quantitative trans-splicing platform data plus a platform-derived asset already dosed clinically | User-uploaded deck pp.12-13; [1], [4] |
| Expansion Potential | **0점** | No additional indication for RZ-005 itself is confirmed | [1] |
| Marketability | **1점** | Calculation; Global Obtainable Peak Sales ≈ **196.43 million USD** | [3], [11]-[13] |
| **Total** | **10점** | Maximum total: 21점 → **REVIEW** | |

Hard Filter rule상 Total 10점은 FAIL threshold (>8)를 넘지만 PASS threshold 14점에는 미달하고, Target Relevance도 3점이 아니므로 **REVIEW**입니다. TR/MoA/Data 중 0점은 없습니다.

## 4) Criterion Detail Pages

### 4.1 Target Relevance
**Score: 2**

**Main line:** Rett syndrome은 중증 CNS neurodevelopmental disorder로 SKBP의 broader neurological scope에는 명확히 들어가지만, 명시된 6개 priority indication에는 포함되지 않습니다.

**What was checked:**
- Asset indication identity
- CNS/neurodevelopmental classification
- SKBP priority indication list
- MECP2 target biology는 TR score와 분리

**Evidence trail:**
- KRX-filed Rznomics IR: RZ-005 — Rett syndrome / neurodevelopmental disease  
  [1]
- Samsung Securities: RZ-005 — Rett syndrome / neurodevelopmental disease  
  [2]
- User-uploaded company deck, p.17: RZ-005 / Rett syndrome / CNS.

**Why not higher:**
- 3점은 Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, ALS/MND, MS/neuroinflammatory disease, neuropathic pain, epilepsy/seizure disorders 중 하나여야 합니다.
- Rett syndrome은 이 6개 priority bucket에 포함되지 않습니다.

**Investigation note:** MECP2 biology, disease severity 및 플랫폼 novelty는 Target Relevance 점수에 중복 반영하지 않았습니다.

### 4.2 MoA Validity
**Score: 2**

**Main line:** MECP2 mutant transcript를 직접 절단·치환하는 trans-splicing mechanism에는 functional evidence가 있지만, 현재 RZ-005 final candidate를 명시한 direct validation은 확인되지 않았습니다.

**What was checked:**
- MECP2 disease causality
- RNA target recognition/trans-splicing
- WT MECP2 restoration
- Expression-level regulation
- Cellular functional readout
- Neuronal model evidence
- Exact RZ-005 candidate linkage

**Evidence trail:**
- Company deck p.24:
  - mutant MeCP2 target
  - WT MeCP2 gene-expression induction
  - endogenous expression-level maintenance
  - 5'UTR upstream targeting → broad mutation coverage claim
  - mutant-product removal + WT expression  

- WO2025147110A1:
  - MECP2 transcript-specific ribozyme
  - mutant RNA → WT RNA replacement
  - target-RNA-dependent expression regulation
  - multiple mapped MECP2 reaction sites
  - SH-SY5Y target-specific trans-splicing
  - iPSC-derived neuron evaluation  
  [3]

The patent reports that 96–98% of diagnosed Rett syndrome cases are associated with MECP2 mutations and emphasizes that therapeutic WT MeCP2 expression needs to be restored without excessive expression, which directly aligns with RZ-005's proposed controlled replacement concept.

Functional experiments identified multiple MECP2 reaction sites, confirmed generation of trans-splicing products, and showed precise reaction at the intended MECP2 site in SH-SY5Y cells. iPSC-derived neurons were also used to evaluate selected constructs.

**Why not higher:**
- Score 3 requires direct assessed-asset target engagement, mechanism-linked biomarker, or direct functional validation.
- Patent experiments are highly aligned with RZ-005 but do not explicitly identify the tested constructs as `RZ-005`.
- No RZ-005-coded in vivo Rett phenotype, MeCP2 protein rescue, dose-response, or clinically relevant functional endpoint is publicly available.

**Investigation note:** 기존 scoring evidence는 단순 theoretical rationale를 넘어 target-specific trans-splicing 및 neuronal-system evidence까지 연결되지만, **RZ-005-labelled disease-relevant in vivo phenotype은 아직 확인되지 않습니다.**

### 4.3 Data Maturity
**Score: 1**

**Main line:** RZ-005의 program design과 aligned cellular experiments는 존재하지만, discovery-stage asset 자체의 stage-appropriate quantitative development dataset은 공개되지 않았습니다.

**What was checked:**
- RZ-005-specific in vitro quantitative data
- Rett mouse / in vivo data
- Dose-response
- MECP2 protein/rescue biomarker
- Biodistribution
- Safety/toxicology
- Vector/delivery optimization
- CMC
- IND-enabling work
- Clinical/registry status

**Evidence trail:**
- Current company pipeline: RZ-005 / Rett syndrome, Discovery→Pre-clinical roadmap. [1]
- Samsung Securities: RZ-005 mechanism disclosed, “후보물질 도출.” [2]
- MECP2 patent: functional cellular and neuronal experiments, but no RZ-005 code. [3]
- User-uploaded RZ-005 slide: mechanism/design only; no quantitative RZ-005 efficacy graph or numeric result.

**Why not higher:**
- Score 2 requires at least one **asset-specific quantitative evidence domain**.
- No RZ-005-labelled quantitative efficacy, PD, biomarker, safety, biodistribution, CMC, or dose-response dataset was identified.
- Patent experiments were not automatically equated with the final RZ-005 candidate.

**Investigation note:** RZ-00X platform-level quantitative data and clinical RZ-001 data were deliberately excluded from RZ-005 Data Maturity.

### 4.4 Competitive Landscape
**Score: 1**

**Main line:** Rett disease modification is already a late-stage competitive field: two MECP2 replacement gene therapies are in Phase 3, while mutation-specific RNA-editing approaches are entering development; RZ-005 has not yet demonstrated quantitative differentiation.

**What was checked:**
- RZ-005 / Rznomics / MECP2 trans-splicing aliases
- Rett + MECP2 gene replacement
- Rett + RNA editing / transcript repair
- Approved therapy
- Phase 3 / clinical competitors
- Preclinical/discovery RNA-editing competitors
- ClinicalTrials.gov
- International Rett Syndrome Foundation pipeline
- Mutation coverage and expression-control differentiation

NGN-401's ClinicalTrials.gov record explicitly lists Phase 3 and describes an AAV9 full-length MECP2 gene therapy with regulated expression. TSHA-102 is registered as a Phase 1/2/3 program with a Phase 3 dose-expansion/pivotal component. ProQR has selected AX-2402 as a development candidate for MECP2 R270X RNA editing, while Shape Therapeutics has reported preclinical MECP2 R168X RNA-editing activity.

**Competitor table:**

| Competitor | Company | Modality | Target / MoA | Pipeline Stage | Why it matters | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NGN-401 | Neurogene | AAV9 gene therapy | Full-length MECP2 replacement + EXACT expression regulation | Phase 3 | Direct MECP2-restoration competitor; addresses the same overexpression-control problem | [6] |
| TSHA-102 | Taysha Gene Therapies | AAV9 gene therapy | miniMECP2 replacement / regulated expression | Phase 3 | Direct disease-modifying competitor; pivotal dosing completed | [7], [8] |
| AX-2402 | ProQR | RNA therapy | ADAR/Axiomer editing of MECP2 R270X | Preclinical Candidate | Closest RNA-repair class comparator; development candidate selected | [9] |
| Rett RNAfix program | Shape Therapeutics | RNA therapy | gRNA/ADAR editing of MECP2 R168X | Preclinical unspecified | RNA editing competitor; ~39% full-length MECP2-positive brain cells reported in Rett mouse model | [10] |
| DAYBUE (trofinetide) | Acadia Pharmaceuticals | Synthetic peptide analog | Symptomatic therapy; not direct MECP2 correction | Approved / marketed | Current approved treatment and commercial benchmark | [11] |

**Key competitor observations:**
- **NGN-401:** Neurogene reports 100% of the 10 participants at the 1E15 vg dose improved on CGI-I and gained ≥1 developmental milestone as of the June 2026 cutoff; the registrational program has completed dosing.
- **TSHA-102:** Taysha reported that all 12 Part-A patients with ≥12 months follow-up gained/regained at least one developmental milestone; 17 participants had completed pivotal dosing by June 2026.
- **AX-2402:** ProQR reports statistically significant functional improvement in an MECP2-R270X Rett mouse model and selected the program's development candidate.
- **Shape:** IRSF reports restoration of full-length MECP2 in approximately 39% of cells following IV delivery in a Rett mouse model.

**Potential RZ-005 differentiation — currently conceptual:**
- upstream/5' targeting could potentially address many pathogenic MECP2 variants with one construct;
- simultaneous mutant-RNA reduction and WT RNA replacement;
- target-RNA-dependent WT expression may help maintain physiological expression levels;
- RNA-level correction avoids permanent genomic editing.

These are strategically attractive characteristics, but there is no RZ-005-specific quantitative comparison demonstrating superior mutation breadth, expression window, efficacy, safety, route, dose, durability, or manufacturability versus NGN-401, TSHA-102 or RNA-editing competitors.

**Why not higher:**
- Score 2 requires asset-specific quantitative differentiation or a realistic entry-space argument supported by asset-specific efficacy/safety/route/access evidence.
- Current RZ-005 differentiation is design-level.
- Score 3 is excluded because no direct matched head-to-head experiment exists.

**Investigation note:** direct comparators were defined as Rett + MECP2 restoration/editing programs; DAYBUE was retained only as an approved broader/reference comparator. Competitor count itself did not determine the score.

### 4.5 Platform Attractiveness
**Score: 3**

**Main line:** Rznomics' trans-splicing ribozyme is demonstrably reusable, has quantitative editing/selectivity evidence, and a platform-derived asset has already reached patient dosing.

**What was checked:**
- Reusable engineering workflow
- Target-specific RNA cleavage/ligation
- Quantitative editing performance
- Off-target assessment
- Multiple programs
- Clinical translation of a platform-derived asset
- Separation from RZ-005 Data Maturity

**Evidence trail:**
- User-uploaded deck p.12 reports generic `RZ-00X` platform data:
  - Target RNA reduction: **68–90%**
  - correction of reduced RNA to normal RNA: **100%**
  - on-target sequencing reads: **1,234,629**
  - no frameshift/mutation/INDEL in reported on-target analysis
  - off-target: **0/217** in first analysis and **1/105** in second analysis  

- Deck p.13 describes the reusable platform architecture: one-molecule dual function, target-RNA-dependent therapeutic expression, RNA-level editing and modular engineering.
- RZ-001 is an officially linked trans-splicing ribozyme asset in an ongoing Phase 1/2a ClinicalTrials.gov study sponsored by Rznomics. [4]

ClinicalTrials.gov identifies RZ-001 as a recombinant adenovirus containing the modified ribozyme construct, confirming that the platform has progressed from technical/preclinical work into human dosing.

**Why score 3:**
- Score-2 requirement: explicit quantitative technical platform evidence is present.
- Additional score-3 requirement: an officially linked platform-derived asset has reached First Patient Dosed/ongoing clinical development.
- Both requirements are met.

**Why not higher:** 3 is the maximum score.

**Investigation note:** platform score 3 **does not imply RZ-005 itself has clinical or quantitative maturity**; the RZ-005 Data Maturity score remains 1.

### 4.6 Expansion Potential
**Score: 0**

**Main line:** RZ-005 is publicly associated only with Rett syndrome.

**What was checked:**
- Additional disease indications for RZ-005
- Asset-specific quantitative data in another indication
- Additional RZ-005 preclinical/IND-enabling/clinical programs

**Evidence trail:**
- Rznomics pipeline assigns RZ-003, RZ-004 and hearing-loss programs to separate assets/platform collaborations rather than RZ-005 expansion. [1]

**Why not higher:**
- Platform applicability across CNS/genetic diseases does not count.
- MECP2 duplication syndrome discussed in the patent is biological context, not an official RZ-005 development indication.
- No additional RZ-005 indication program is confirmed.

**Investigation note:** Score 0; no confirmed additional RZ-005 indication.

### 4.7 Marketability
**Score: 1**

**Main line:** A conservative indication-based screening calculation produces estimated **Global Obtainable Peak Sales ≈ 196.43 million USD**.

**Assessment method:** calculation  
**Score basis type:** calculation  
**Calculation status:** performed  
**Assessed global peak sales:** **196.43 million USD**

No reliable RZ-005-specific external peak-sales forecast was identified.

The user-uploaded company deck quotes a broader Rett treatment-market estimate of approximately **1,500 million USD in 2025E → 4,590 million USD in 2033E**, CAGR 15%, but this is a market-size forecast rather than an RZ-005 asset-specific peak-sales forecast and therefore was **not** used as the scoring basis.

**US population basis:** Neuren's 2025 annual report states approximately **6,000 diagnosed U.S. Rett patients**, with prevalence studies suggesting **6,000–9,000 total patients**. Midpoint 7,500 was used as the screening patient pool.

**MECP2 eligibility:** Rznomics' patent states that approximately **96–98%** of diagnosed Rett patients are associated with MECP2 mutations; midpoint **97%** was applied.

**Benchmark price:** DAYBUE is the first FDA-approved Rett syndrome therapy. A peer-reviewed commercial analysis reports approximately **0.375 million USD/year** as the U.S. annual price benchmark. This is used solely as the closest approved Rett treatment benchmark; it is **not** an assumed final RZ-005 gene-therapy price.

**Worksheet:**

| Step | Calculation | Evidence / assumption |
|---|---:|---|
| US Patient Pool | **7,500 patients** | midpoint of 6,000–9,000 potential U.S. patients |
| Diagnosis Rate | **0.80** | 6,000 diagnosed / 7,500 midpoint |
| Eligibility Rate | **0.97** | midpoint of 96–98% MECP2-associated Rett |
| Treatable Subgroup Rate | **1.00** | screening assumption; no narrower RZ-005 subgroup disclosed |
| **A. US TAP** | **7,500 × 0.80 × 0.97 × 1.00 = 5,820 patients** | prevalence-based screen |
| Benchmark Annualized Net Price | **0.375 million USD** | DAYBUE annual benchmark; not RZ-005 pricing |
| Peak Penetration | **0.20** | analyst assumption; strong late-stage gene-therapy competition |
| Treatment Duration Factor | **1.00** | default; RZ-005 durability/regimen unknown |
| **B. US Unrisked Peak Sales** | **5,820 × 0.375 × 0.20 × 1.00 = 436.50 million USD** | calculation |
| Competition Haircut | **0.30** | analyst assumption reflecting NGN-401/TSHA-102 Phase 3 lead plus RNA-editing competition |
| Pricing Power Adjustment | **1.00** | no RZ-005 clinical superiority data to justify premium/discount |
| **C. US Obtainable Peak Sales** | **436.50 × 0.30 × 1.00 = 130.95 million USD** | calculation |
| **D. Global Obtainable Peak Sales** | **130.95 × 1.5 = 196.43 million USD** | user-defined global multiplier applied once |
| External Peak Sales Reference | Not identified | Company market-size forecast is not asset-specific peak sales |
| **Final score basis** | **196.43 million USD → Score 1 (<1,000 million USD)** | Full Scout v3.8 threshold |

**Important limitation:** RZ-005 is a gene-therapy concept and could ultimately be priced as a one-time therapy, whereas the available approved benchmark is chronic DAYBUE treatment. Therefore the 0.375 million USD price is a conservative indication benchmark rather than a prediction of RZ-005 pricing. Clinical efficacy, durability, route, manufacturing and payer evidence could materially alter this estimate.

**Investigation note:** Marketability is based on obtainable peak sales, not rNPV; the x1.5 global multiplier was applied exactly once.

## 5) Validation Notes

### Cross-checked facts
- RZ-005 is a real Rznomics pipeline asset for Rett syndrome; confirmed in the uploaded company deck, KRX-filed company IR and independent analyst material.
- RZ-005's target is no longer appropriately characterized as simply “Undisclosed”: July 2026 company material explicitly names mutant MeCP2/WT MeCP2 replacement.
- The Rznomics MECP2 patent independently links the company's trans-splicing approach to Rett syndrome and demonstrates target-specific trans-splicing in cellular systems.
- The reusable platform has advanced to human testing through RZ-001.
- Current Rett development competition includes Phase 3 NGN-401 and TSHA-102 plus emerging RNA-editing approaches.

### Attachment evidence provenance
- `Rznomics_Introduction NCD_2026.07.08(1).pdf`, **p.17**:
  - RZ-005 / Rett syndrome / CNS
  - Discovery → Pre-clinical roadmap
  - Evidence Origin: `user_uploaded_file`
  - source_nature: `company_generated`
  - supports: asset identity, indication, stage context
  - does **not** independently prove that a planned Pre-clinical milestone has started.
- Same file, **p.24**:
  - mutant MeCP2 targeting
  - WT MeCP2 expression
  - expression-level maintenance
  - broad-mutation targeting claim
  - Evidence Origin: `user_uploaded_file`
  - source_nature: `company_generated`
  - supports: Target/MoA rationale
  - no RZ-005 quantitative efficacy result.
- Same file, **pp.12–13**:
  - generic RZ-00X platform target-RNA reduction/editing/off-target metrics
  - Evidence Origin: `user_uploaded_file`
  - source_nature: `company_generated`
  - supports: Platform Attractiveness only
  - explicitly **not** counted as RZ-005 Data Maturity.

### Uncertain points
- **Current stage:** exact RZ-005 transition from Discovery into formal Preclinical execution is unresolved. Samsung Securities says “후보물질 도출,” while the latest company roadmap still presents Discovery followed by Pre-clinical. Because no explicit official candidate nomination/selection or completed preclinical-start milestone was verified, canonical stage remains **Hit Discovery**.
- **Delivery:** exact RZ-005 vector serotype, route, dose, CNS distribution strategy and manufacturing configuration are not public.
- **Patent linkage:** WO2025147110A1 is highly aligned with RZ-005 but does not explicitly use the RZ-005 code.
- **Asset-specific data:** no RZ-005-coded in vivo Rett model, MeCP2 protein-rescue, behavioral efficacy, dose-response, biodistribution, NHP, toxicology, CMC or IND-enabling result was identified.
- **Competitive differentiation:** mutation coverage and physiological expression-control advantages are conceptually attractive but have not been quantitatively compared with NGN-401, TSHA-102, AX-2402 or Shape RNAfix.
- **Commercial assumptions:** penetration 20%, competition haircut 30% and Pricing Power Adjustment 1.0 are analyst screening assumptions.

### Search log
- **Official company / KRX:** June 2026 Rznomics IR reviewed and RZ-005 identity/pipeline checked.
- **Uploaded company material:** July 8, 2026 NCD deck reviewed, including pp.12–13, 17 and 24.
- **Analyst source:** Samsung Securities March 2026 Rznomics pipeline table reviewed.
- **Patent:** WO2025147110A1 MECP2 trans-splicing patent reviewed for target, mechanism and experimental evidence.
- **Clinical registry:** RZ-001, NGN-401 and TSHA-102 registry records checked.
- **Competitor sources:** Neurogene, Taysha, ProQR, IRSF and FDA sources reviewed.
- **Market / epidemiology:** Neuren annual report, FDA and peer-reviewed Daybue commercial benchmark reviewed.
- **Partnership:** Rznomics–Eli Lilly licensing announcement reviewed.
- **RZ-005 clinical registry:** no RZ-005 human trial registration was identified; this is consistent with its current discovery status but does not itself prove development inactivity.

## 6) Final Take

**One-line summary:** RZ-005 combines a biologically compelling MECP2 correction strategy with a clinically translated trans-splicing platform and a potentially valuable mutation-broad/expression-controlled design, but it remains too early to establish asset-level differentiation against Rett gene therapies that are already in Phase 3.

**Recommendation:**
- **Watch**

**Why:**  
The central attraction is not simply Rett syndrome itself, but whether Rznomics can use trans-splicing to solve two problems faced by MECP2 replacement—**mutation heterogeneity and narrow therapeutic expression window**—with one construct. That thesis is technically plausible and supported at the platform/MECP2-program level, but the investment/BD case needs RZ-005-specific quantitative evidence before promotion to Shortlist.

**Most important diligence question:**  
**Can Rznomics provide the selected RZ-005 construct and delivery configuration together with quantitative iPSC-neuron and Rett in vivo efficacy, WT/mutant MeCP2 protein-expression window, brain biodistribution, dose-response and safety data—and demonstrate a meaningful advantage versus NGN-401/TSHA-102 gene replacement and emerging MECP2 RNA-editing programs?**
